The Collaboration on International ICT Policy in East and Southern Africa (CIPESA),

will host

 the Forum on Internet Freedom in Africa 2026 (FIFAfrica26) set to take place on

Over the past decade, the FIFAfrica conference

As open spaces for human rights conversations continue to shrink, convenings such as these are more important than ever.


Access Now has been a key partner of CIPESA and continues to actively participate in FIFAfrica to strengthen our partnership and expand our network within Africa and beyond. We are happy to be part of this year’s FIFAfrica.

author: JournalAvant
title: Communist Methods of Organization: Notes on the Cell, the Mass Party, Autonomy, & Political Suicide
content:
An article from Avant! journal issue 3.

Author’s Note: A PDF version of this article is attached at the bottom of the page.

“The reigning paradigm of organization among the autonomous revolutionary current today is the “milieu,” or radical scene: a mode of organization premised upon small groups of friends who stand apart from society and attempt to intervene within social struggles…By refusing to stake out a place within the ideological pantheon of existing political forms, by asserting its position in the mode of a non-position, the milieu functions as an axiomatic default that has excused itself from the realm of critique on the grounds that it proffers no ‘models’ of its own: ‘autonomy’ becomes a stand-in for the milieu itself. Yet the organizational form of the milieu stands in the way of its revolutionary potential in a variety of ways. While it imagines itself as standing outside society as a space of purity and safety from the bad ways of society, the milieu continually recreates a tyranny of structurelessness, as its informal organization reproduces existing social hierarchies. While its naive politics of friendship has certain advantages in terms of fostering political intensities, it tends toward a form of cultural and racial closure that prevents political relations from being fostered across social differences. Finally, with the milieu we lack the means to foster the capacities of our comrades. On one hand, we tell ourselves that we are all equal, while at the same time vast differences in experience and inequalities in our relations speak the truth of our situation.”

If we have inherited anything from our milieu’s tradition, it is nothing. Or rather, the absence of any codified idea or tactic, frozen in time for our repeated use. We do not fear organic manifestation as much as rigid ideological premise. We represent the movement of whatever works, at any time, to advance the most radical pole in the movement of communism; This amounts to nothing more but the call for immediate communism itself. This lack of marriage to any born concept rests on the premise of fluidity in struggle, that we must behave like water. At various points in struggle it is necessary to expand, contract, as what matters is not form but the motion of radical content.

From this vantage point, we are disturbed by a lack of obvious formation to come, and question how to tackle organization as a social, rather than political, question. We write this piece to share recent discussions within the movement of our day, as well as to open up a dialogue amongst comrades.

This piece deals with the most popular and fetishized methods of organization of our day: the Cell, the Mass Party, and the varying Autonomous infrastructure projects tucked neatly within the confines of every city. What characterizes our conception of each is their collective gasps for survival after shaky births, nestling within the bourgeois world from different ends of a conservative spectrum, attempting to carve out social, rhetorical, or physical niches to stay alive. Thus, we will recount the current position of each, their appeals and developments, and offer our own thesis on the matter: That we must embark on a political suicide, i.e. an overt renunciation of politics and economics, and break with remnants of half-baked Blanquism and Leninism in the building of a visible communist pole.

Social Conservatism: The Cell in Retrospect

There is nothing more mystified than the modern communist Cell, born in such an epoch of fear and anxiety. An eternally young form, its tracings are minimal, relations typically insular projects of affinity, and its site is implanted at the heart of the mass movement. We strictly refer to the Cell as the construction of a clandestine, self-limiting affinity-based organization with the intent to influence wider ranging social movements. Cells seek the outward imposition of revolutionary ideals and tactics, correcting their own growths for this very reason. While the popularization of insurrectionary Anarchist groups has led to a narrow image of Celldom, such a structure may even swallow the wandering liberal, and not all follow the same guidelines for they make up wide-ranging groups of ideologues. A Cell today can be hierarchical or horizontal, formal or informal, Anarchist or Leninist, and may operate under any medium under the sun; The Cell is not ideological but social-survivalist in nature. They also tend to cast aside any …

author: Mag
title: Proteste, Blockaden und unbefristeter Generalstreik in Bolivien gegen die Erhöhung der Kraftstoffpreise und andere Angriffe auf die Kaufkraft der Löhne
content:
Dossier


„

Die neue Regierung unter Rodrigo Paz hat ein Dekret erlassen, das die Subventionen für Kraftstoffe abschafft. Diese Maßnahme, die die Kaufkraft der Löhne beeinträchtigt, hat direkte Auswirkungen auf die Lebenshaltungskosten von Millionen Menschen und hat bereits zu Protesten geführt. Das am Mittwochabend von der neuen Regierung unter Rodrigo Paz in Bolivien unterzeichnete Dekret Nr. 5503 hat bereits Proteste ausgelöst. Die Streichung der Subventionen für Kraftstoffe bedeutet einen direkten Angriff auf die Kaufkraft der Löhne der Arbeitnehmer und der bolivianischen Bevölkerung. Am Freitag standen mehrere Städte des Landes aufgrund von Streiks und Blockaden ohne öffentliche Verkehrsmittel da. Bereits seit Donnerstag gibt es Blockaden auf der Autobahn La Paz-El Alto, um gegen die „de facto”-Erhöhung der Fahrpreise im öffentlichen Nahverkehr zu protestieren

…“ span.

Meldung der Redaktion LID Bolivien vom 19. Dezember in La Izquierda Diario


 (maschinenübersetzt) mit Fotos – siehe mehr Informationen zur weiteren Entwicklung:


Nach der Annahme eines IWF-Kredites und der Abschaffung der Dieselsubvention verlängert Bolivien aus Angst vor neuen Blockaden den Ausnahmezustand um 90 Tage


„Die Regierung in Bolivien hat mit der Begründung eines weiterhin hohen Konfliktpotenzials im Land den Ausnahmezustand verlängert. Kurz nach dem Beschluss wurde mit der Annahme eines Kredites des Internationalen Währungsfonds (IWF) und der damit einhergehenden Abschaffung der Dieselsubvention eine wirtschaftspolitische Maßnahme umgesetzt, die das Konfliktpotenzial im Land erneut anheizen könnte (…).100 der 158 anwesenden Abgeordneten stimmten am vergangenen Donnerstag nach neunstündiger Debatte für die Verlängerung des Ausnahmezustands. Damit bleibt der am 20. Juni von Präsident Rodrigo Paz verhängte Ausnahmezustand nun bis zum 17. Dezember in Kraft. (…) Der Ausnahmezustand geht auf die schwere politische und soziale Krise im Mai und Juni zurück (…). Über sieben Wochen hinweg blockierten unterschiedliche gesellschaftliche Akteure zahlreiche Straßen im ganzen Land. Besonders La Paz und El Alto waren von Engpässen bei Lebensmitteln, Medikamenten und Treibstoff betroffen. Die Proteste forderten mindestens 16 Todesopfer, davon 13 infolge fehlender medizinischer Versorgung aufgrund der Blockaden. Die wirtschaftlichen Schäden wurden auf mehr als drei Milliarden US-Dollar geschätzt. Der Zeitpunkt der Maßnahme wirkt strategisch gewählt, denn bereits am Freitag kündigte Präsident Paz die sofortige und vollständige Abschaffung der staatlichen Dieselsubventionen an, nachdem der Kongress einen Kredit in Höhe von 1,9 Milliarden US-Dollar des IWF zur Stabilisierung der Wirtschaft bewilligt hatte. (…) Kurz nach der Bekanntgabe der Verlängerung wurden am Wochenende bereits die Hauptverkehrsstrecken zwischen Cochabamba, Oruro und La Paz von 500 Sicherheitsbeamten gesichert, die im Mai und Juni Epizentrum der Blockaden waren. Gegen die Abschaffung der Subventionen hatten sich bereits im Vorfeld mehrere produktive Sektoren, darunter Landwirte und Fahrer, ausgesprochen. Es überrascht daher nicht, dass der Verkehrssektor wegen der Verdopplung des Dieselpreises auf nun 17,95 Bolivianos (1,59 Euro) für Montag bereits zu einem unbefristeten Streik aufgerufen hat. Auch der Gewerkschaftsdachverband COB lehnte in einer öffentlichen Erklärung die vollständige Abschaffung der Dieselsubventionen ab und berief eine Dringlichkeitssitzung auf, um die aktuelle Situation zu beurteilen und gegebenenfalls Gegenmaßnahmen umzusetzen.“


Beitrag von Lia Helguero Kandt vom 21. September 2026 in amerika21


 („Bolivien verlängert den Ausnahmezustand um 90 Tage“)

title: AAVE Terms And What They Mean (Actually)
content:
blackcharacterpolls

:

This was on my toyhouse and i wanted to share here, there are far more words than this but this is what i had written down.

Black Fatigue: 

Black Fatigue is a term coined by author

Mary-Frances Winters

, the term is meant to highlight the mental, physical, emotional, etc, effects that racism has on Black people and how it fatigues us.

It is

NOT

 a term for nonblack people to refer to their “fatigue” of Black people.

Gyatt: 

Gyatt, a shortening\quick wording of “Goddamn”, Often to express surprise, disappointment, frustration or disbelief.

It is 

NOT

 a term for ass or butt.

Woke\Stay Woke: 

Woke 

(Or Stay Woke), is a term originating from AAVE used by Black people since the 1930s for staying aware of racism, discrimination and police brutality, and gained political connections in the 70s and further in the 2010’s during

BLM

 and the 2014

Ferguson Protests

.

It is 

NOT

 a term for right wingers\conservatives to signal anything diverse as “woke, meaning bad”, It is NOT a joke, to be used sarcastically, ironically, or pejoratively, to be woke is a good thing, it is not negative. The wiki states that this word is primarily misused by right wingers and centrists, but there is still a large problem with white leftists using this word jokingly or sarcastically and ignoring or not knowing the meaning of it. Using it ironically\jokingly to combat right wingers is still misusing the word. Use progressive instead of woke unless you are referring to racism.

Ahh “Ass”: “

Ahh” does in fact mean ass, but it is not a way to censor ass or a “funny” way of saying it, it is specifically said this way because of how a Black person might speak, it is because of dialect difference, its not a quirky way to say ass or a censor like often misinterpreted.

It, again, is 

NOT

 a quirky or censoring way to say ass, just say ass white baby

Unc (Meaning Uncle): 

To refer to an (usually older) Black man, blood related or not, that is viewed as a close member of a family, it is a term of endearment (Better explanation

here

)

It is

NOT

 a term to mean

just

 old or older person

Crash Out:

 Crash Out or “crashing out” refers to an individual having an emotional meltdown, presenting reckless aggressive behavior meant to invoke an altercation, or someone willing to engage in self destructive, dangerous behaviors because they have nothing to lose. Basically, it means losing your shit.

You can’t crash out “calmly”, the word is literally based in a strong, often public emotional reaction.

“Crash out” was first used in Baton Rouge, LA, and it derives from  the term “crash dummy.” Following this, the first rapper to use “crash out” in a viral song was Baton Rouge rapper NBA YoungBoy in his 2017 song “Stepped On” via the lyric “Crash out if I’m nervous.”

Non-viral usage of the slang term dates back to 2013 on Twitter / X. Many of the early adopters were from the American south in places like Montgomery, AL, Memphis, TN and Houston, TX.

author: David Swanson
title: The Urgency of Recognizing the Ansar Allah Government in Yemen
content:
Yemenis celebrate as they follow a convoy of freed prisoners from Mokha to Sana’a – AP Photo


By Medea Benjamin and Nicolas J. S. Davies, World BEYOND War, September 22, 2026


The Trump administration came perilously close to launching another bombing campaign against Yemen this weekend. According to a September 20 New York Times

report

, US commanders had approved their targets, American troops were loading bombs onto warplanes, and an attack on Yemen’s Ansar Allah forces was about to begin when President Trump abruptly reversed course.


For two weeks, Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman had been pleading with Trump to intervene as Ansar Allah (Houthi) forces swept through Saudi-backed forces’ positions along Yemen’s Red Sea coast. Trump initially resisted, but after another urgent call from the Saudi crown prince, he instructed the Pentagon to prepare for airstrikes. By Sunday, he had changed his mind again, at least temporarily.


The New York Times reported that many of Trump’s closest advisers opposed joining the Saudi war. U.S. military officials also questioned whether renewed bombing would accomplish anything, given that Ansar Allah had withstood more than 1,000 U.S. strikes during a seven-week campaign in 2025. That operation consumed roughly $1 billion in munitions and other military resources in its first month alone.


Meanwhile, Ansar Allah has assured Washington that it does not intend to attack American ships. U.S. officials recently met Ansar Allah representatives in Oman in an effort to preserve that agreement. A new American bombing campaign could undo those diplomatic gains and threaten shipping through the Bab al-Mandab Strait just as the Strait of Hormuz remains severely disrupted.


The crisis spawned by the US war on Iran spread to this dangerous new front on July 13, when the 2022 ceasefire between Saudi Arabia and the

de facto

Ansar Allah government in Yemen was shattered by a Saudi

 missile strike

 on the airport in Sana’a, Yemen’s capital.


The Saudi attack was designed to prevent the landing of an Iranian Mahan Air civilian plane carrying passengers returning from the funeral of Iran’s assassinated Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei in Tehran. The flight was forced to divert to Hodeidah, 140 miles away on the Red Sea coast.


Yemen’s Ansar Allah forces retaliated by attacking the Saudi airport at Abha, near the Yemeni border, with missiles and drones. Since then, hostilities have escalated dramatically.


Ansar Allah forces have captured the strategic port city of Mocha and the remainder of the Red Sea coast from Saudi-backed forces. They are still fighting to consolidate

 control

 of the Kahbub mountains that overlook the approaches to the Bab el-Mandeb Strait between the Red Sea and the Gulf of Aden, but they are already preventing Saudi ships from sailing through the Red Sea.


The Saudis have responded with

 hundreds

 of air strikes on Yemen. Ansar Allah, in turn, has attacked Saudi airbases and oil infrastructure with missiles and drones. Either the Yemenis or their allies in Iraq struck pumping stations on Saudi Arabia’s East-West Pipeline, which was the Saudis’ best alternative to the Strait of Hormuz as a route for their oil exports,

 shutting

 down the pumping-stations, and full operation of the pipeline, for at least a month.


The United States has

 dispatched

 an estimated 200 additional troops to Saudi Arabia to provide intelligence and targeting expertise for Saudi airstrikes, using programs like Palantir’s Maven AI system, which the

 US and Israel

 also use in Gaza, and which US officials now

admit

 was used in the massacre at the Minab girls’ school in Iran in February.


The US State Department has also

approved

 a $5 billion weapons sale that would provide Saudi Arabia with 5,000 2,000 lb. bombs and 5,000 500 lb. bombs, along with JDAM guidance kits and fuses. This comes in addition to a planned $24 billion sale of 48 F-35 fighter jets to the Saudis and follows

record

 US arms sales to Saudi Arabia for $110 billion in 2018 and $142 billion in 2025.


Congress has not yet consented to these latest Saudi arms sales that can only mean more death and devastation for the people of Yemen. Senator Markey, backed by Senators Merkley and Sanders, has filed a Joint Resolution of Disapproval that can stop the sale if it receives enough votes. Here’s a

link

author: M.P
title: Temuco: Filmoteca Ufro presentará su libro “Memorias en movimiento”
content:
Dos años en el desafío de mediar, catalogar, digitalizar y difundir más de 3 mil rollos cinematográficos, tras la adjudicación del fondo de Salvaguardia del Patrimonio Audiovisual del Ministerio de las Culturas, las Artes y el Patrimonio, es lo que compiló Filmoteca Ufro en su libro “Memorias en movimiento”. La presentación será este miércoles 23 de septiembre a las 17:00 horas, en el Auditorio Selva Saavedra de la Universidad de La Frontera.

En el segundo piso de la Biblioteca Central de la Universidad de la Frontera, frente a la escalera, se encuentra la Filmoteca Ufro. Una sala pequeña donde habitan cámaras filmadoras y cintas de diversos formatos, que “posibilitaron la captura de la memoria”, como le gusta decir a Diego Olivares, periodista, tipógrafo, realizador y archivista audiovisual que coordina este proyecto.

El origen de este archivo fílmico se sitúa en el 2008, cuando Diego se encontraba realizando un documental cuyo protagonista no tenía imágenes de su infancia, por lo que juntaron cerca de cien latas de películas. ”El acuerdo era construir su historia con imágenes de otros niños, con imágenes encontradas que servirían para retratar otra época: las calles, los autos, la moda, los roles de género”, relata.

De cientos de rollos pasaron a miles, lo que comenzó a ser un problema para un coleccionista por la falta de un lugar adecuado para resguardarlos. Años después, Diego Olivares logró hacer un vínculo con la Universidad de la Frontera -donde es docente- para almacenarlos.

Uno de los principales hallazgos en este crecimiento, tiene lugar en el Persa Bío Bío de Santiago, donde Diego se encontraba vitrineando cuando llamaron su atención unas latas escasamente rotuladas en las que podía leer “Budi, Puerto Saavedra”. Volvió a Temuco con 26 latas de cine en 16 mm. filmadas entre 1926 y 1936, lo que resultó ser una sorpresa, porque el modelo de cámaras usadas para su filmación comenzó a ser vendido en el mundo tan solo tres años antes de hechos estos registros en la costa de la Araucanía, por parte de la familia ganadera Duhalde, de origen Vasco Francés. Dato de origen al que llegaron gracias a la observación del profesor Jaime Flores de la Ufro, quien identificó un tipo de ganado particular que se aprecia en algunas de estas cintas.

El 2024 Filmoteca Ufro fue el único proyecto no metropolitano en adjudicarse este fondo para la Salvaguardia del Patrimonio Audiovisual, sin embargo, Diego Olivares destaca la importancia nacional de este trabajo, ya que las imágenes que conservan son desde el norte hasta el sur más extremo de Chile: “Creemos que es un gran aporte a nivel nacional, porque hay muchos lugares que solo están filmados en estos pequeños formatos. Muchas veces el Estado, el cine nacional, propagandístico, político, el cine más comercial no llegó a todos los lugares, porque nuestro cine ha estado súper inconcluso”.

Uno de los pilares de la instalación de Filmoteca Ufro es el programa de mediación que ha relacionado a las comunidades interesadas con el acervo y la labor de este archivo. El artista y realizador audiovisual Ange Cayuman diseñó el plan de mediación de este proyecto y es el encargado de llevarlo a cabo. En estos dos años, han desarrollado actividades de vinculación con colegios a los que han ido a visitar con los elementos del cine fílmico, así como también han recibido a los establecimientos que han solicitado visitar el archivo.

En agosto del 2025, Olivares y Cayuman viajaron hasta Punta Arenas para ser parte del XVII Festival Internacional de Cine Polo Sur Latinoamericano con talleres y exhibiciones. Han realizado muestras de cine en la universidad con la presencia de personas relevantes del mundo documental y los archivos, como la antropóloga y documentalista mexicana Gabriela Zamorano y el estreno en Temuco de su documental Archivo Cordero, sobre uno de los mayores acervos visuales del siglo XX en Bolivia.

Otras de las actividades de mediación, fue Filmoteca Lab, en junio del 2026, que contó “con la presencia de investigadoras/es, cineastas y una gran cantidad de personas que se interesan por el uso de los archivos a nivel de la memoria local, de los procesos de creación artística, de los intereses disciplinares como la antropología, la geografía, y la educación”, señaló Ange Cayuman, agregando que “ha sido un proceso que ha abierto posibilidades de vinculación desde la universidad con el territorio que habita y otros, y de generación de investigación y creación, que es el fin de …

author: webdev@democracynow.org (Democracy Now!)
title: "Pedagogy of the Oppressed" Brazilian Educator Paulo Freire Profiled in Film, "Reading the World"
content:
Reading the World

 is a remarkable new documentary about Paulo Freire, the acclaimed Brazilian educator whose revolutionary approach to teaching connected literacy to critical thinking and democratic participation. It draws on rare archival footage of 1960s Brazil and weaves together the memories of farmers, students and educators who took part in Freire’s culture circles, his method of teaching adults to read in as little as 40 hours by drawing on their own lives, communities and experiences. At the time, Brazil’s illiterate population was barred from voting, so education also opened the door to political participation. The experiment was abruptly halted in 1964 when Brazil’s military overthrew President João Goulart in a U.S.-backed coup that led to Freire’s imprisonment and exile.


“Paulo Freire was one of the most influential educators of the past century and is still widely studied all around the world. But the studies often focus on his ideas, his philosophies, his books, and much less is known about his original praxis,” says co-director Catherine Murphy.


“One of the most important points of his philosophy is that everyone has knowledge,” says Maria Luisa Mendonça, director of the Network for Social Justice and Human Rights in Brazil and a consulting producer.

Förvåning är inte ett användbart redskap i agitationen

I organiseringen är agitationen gnistan som startar branden. Liksom överallt i livet är det våra känslor som leder, våra tankar som samstämmer, och därefter våra beteenden som följer. A-till-E-modellen handlar delvis om att rikta vårt mänskliga handlingssätts naturliga förlopp.

Ett misstag som nya och alltför ivriga organisatörer ibland gör är att de behandlar det inledande agitationssteget – som egentligen syftar till att identifiera problem som påverkar ens arbetskamrater – som en frågelek för att få fram ett viss svar. ”Vad tycker du om schemaläggningen?” ”Visst önskar man att vi fick bättre betalt här?” ”Får du tillräckligt med sjukdagar?” ”Platschefen är verkligen jobbig, eller hur?”

Även om detta vid första anblick kan verka vara ett smidigt sätt att kartlägga deras inställning till potentiella problem, uppfattas detta i själva verket ofta som att man gång på gång gör antaganden om personen som riskerar kväva meningsfulla samtal. Om personen dessutom genomskådar din strategi kan den få intrycket av att du inte alls är intresserad av att faktiskt lyssna vad de har att säga.

Det bästa sättet att ”identifiera problemen” är inte att fastna vid att försöka ställa den perfekta frågan, utan snarare att bygga relationer med dina arbetskamrater. Om relationerna är uppriktiga och öppna kommer de känna sig trygga och naturligt vilja dela med sig av vad de upplever, bland annat om hur de faktiskt känner om jobbet. Att ”bygga relationer” är förstås ofta lättare sagt än gjort, men det är just där vår verkliga styrka ligger.

När vi utvecklar kamratrelationer, och de börjar tala ut om olika problem, så får man möjlighet att skapa utrymmen där man kan utforska problemen tillsammans med dem. Försök att hitta sätt som synliggör hur problemet påverkar oss. Allt för ofta fastnar man som arbetare, inklusive jag själv, i att tänka att det inte finns något annat sätt som arbetsplatsen skulle kunna fungera på. När vi tänker på det sättet lägger vi problemet på oss själva, försöker bita ihop och lägger lock på känslorna som problemet orsakar oss. Bara genom att låta vår nyfikenhet utforska de många sätt som problemet påverkar oss kan vi bilda oss en korrekt uppfattning om problemet. När vi har detta klart för oss kan vi härleda problemets ursprung, inte från oss själva, utan från arbetsplatsens styrsätt, cheferna eller vilken annan aspekt av kapitalismen det nu gäller som får oss att må dåligt och stressa över jobbet.

Känslor av alla slag är drivkraften bakom våra handlingar. När vi går igenom agitationssteget i A-till-E-modellen landar vi oftast i ilska, men på vägen passar vi ofta många andra känslor. Låt mig förklara.

Jag arbetar med ungar. Mitt arbete fungerar bra när jag kan hjälpa till att tillgodose barnens behov och ge dem förutsättningar att lära sig och växa. När arbetet går bra känner jag mig ofta glad, och det gör barnen jag arbetar med också. Vi har nästan alla en referenspunkt för hur vår arbete ser ut när det går bra. Även om det aldrig händer vet vi ofta intuitivt hur det faktiskt borde vara. När arbetet går bra upplever vi en känsla av kompetens, prestation, tillfredsställelse och gemenskap.

När jag inte lyckas göra mitt arbete på grund av underbemanning eller otillräckliga resurser, så är min första reaktion frustration över att försöka men misslyckas att göra det. Denna känsla kan omvandlas till ledsenhet när jag ser ungarna kämpa, tappa motivationen eller få utbrott – en ledsenhet eftersom jag vet att de förtjänar kärlek och stöd, men på grund av omständigheterna misslyckas jag ge dem det de behöver. När det står står klart att det inte är mitt eget misslyckande som skapar dessa situationer, utan snarare de som har makt över mig och min bransch som inte tillhandahåller de nödvändiga resurserna, så blir jag arg. Det är …

title: “Spekülasyon amaçlı paylaşımlar” iddiasıyla çok sayıda X hesabına erişim engeli
content:
Son bir hafta içerisinde, İstanbul ve Ankara Cumhuriyet Başsavcılıkları tarafından yürütülen soruşturmalar kapsamında çok sayıda X hesabı, sermaye piyasası araçları hakkında yatırımcıda korku ve paniğe neden olabilecek nitelikte spekülasyon amaçlı paylaşımlar yapıldığı iddiasıyla, 5651 sayılı Kanun’un 8/A maddesi kapsamında millî güvenlik ve kamu düzeninin korunması gerekçesiyle erişime engellendi.

İFOD’un haberine göre engellenenler arasında ekonomist ve ekonomi yazarı Uğur Gürses, ekonomist ve akademisyen Prof. Dr. Veysel Ulusoy, finans profesörü Prof. Dr. Bilge Yılmaz, kripto para analisti Ted Pillows, yatırım ve finans danışmanı Emre Şirin, gazeteciler Naz Yavuzarslan ve Dinçer Gökçe, Gelecek Partisi kurucularından Yavuz Değirmenci ile tiyatro ve sinema oyuncusu Orhan Aydın’ın hesapları da bulunuyor.

İfade Özgürlüğü Derneği’nin EngelliWeb projesi kapsamında tespit edilen hesapların toplam takipçi sayısı yaklaşık 12 milyon. Hesapların birçoğu ise X tarafından Türkiye’den görünmez kılındı.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

author: Unknown
title: Erdoğan BM'de "Küresel cinsiyetsizleştirme politikalarına karşı" LGBTİ+ operasyonlarını savundu:
content:
⁠Cumhurbaşkanı Recep Tayyip Erdoğan, Birleşmiş Milletler (BM) 81. Genel Kurulu'ndaki konuşmasında Gazze'deki savaşa son verilmesi, Filistin'in tanınması ve BM Güvenlik Konseyi'nin reformu çağrısında bulundu; Suriye'de Ahmed Şara yönetimine desteğini yineledi, Ukrayna'nın toprak bütünlüğünü savundu ve Kuzey Kıbrıs Türk Cumhuriyeti'nin tanınmasını istedi.


Konuşmanın son bölümünde ise Erdoğan, Türkiye'de son dönemde hükümetin LGBTİ+ politikalarının temel söylemini oluşturan “aile ve çocukların korunması” yaklaşımını BM Genel Kurulu'na taşıdı.


Reuters, Erdoğan'ın konuşmasının bu bölümünü ayrıca haberleştirirken, Türkiye'de LGBTİ+ örgütlerini hedef alan “Ailem Güvende” operasyonundan bir hafta sonra yapıldığına dikkat çekti. Operasyon kapsamında 82 kişinin tutuklandığını, 100'den fazla protestocunun da gözaltına alındığını duyurdu. 


“Kadın ve erkekten oluşan aile”


Erdoğan, konuşmasının bu bölümünde sözlerine Batı ülkelerinde İslam düşmanlığı, Müslüman kadınlara yönelik ayrımcılık ve başörtüsü yasaklarını eleştirerek başladı. Müslüman kadın ve kız çocuklarının ayrımcılığa daha fazla maruz kaldığını söyleyen Erdoğan, bazı ülkelerdeki okul başörtüsü yasaklarını “kadınların en temel haklarına yapılmış bir saldırı” olarak nitelendirdi.


Yabancı düşmanlığı, kültürel ırkçılık ve antisemitizmle mücadele edilmesi gerektiğini söyledikten sonra  “cinsiyetsizleştirme” olarak kodladığı LGBTİ+'lara yönelik uygulamalarına geçti:


“Küresel cinsiyetsizleştirme politikaları, aile kurumuyla birlikte masum çocukları da hedef alan bir kuşatmaya dönüşmüştür. Bu kuşatmayı ancak kadın ve erkekten oluşan aileyi koruyarak kırabiliriz.”


Erdoğan ardından Türkiye'nin izleyeceği politikayı şu sözlerle açıkladı:


“Türkiye, lobilerin saldırılarına rağmen aile ve çocukların korunmasında inisiyatif almayı sürdürecektir.”


Erdoğan, “lobiler” ile kimi kastettiğini açıklamadı ve konuşmasının bu bölümünde LGBTİ+ ifadesini kullanmadı. Ancak sözleri, doğrudan LGBTİ+ örgütlerine yönelik son operasyonlar bağlamında haberleştirildi.


Erdoğan aynı konuşması kapsamında “cinsiyetsizleştirme” olarak nitelediği toplumsal cinsiyetin tanınmasına yönelik saldırılarının ardından sosyal medyadaki "dezenformasyon"a, oradan yapay zekâya geçti:


“Toplumsal barışı dinamitleyen bir diğer tehdit, sosyal medyada yaygınlaşan dezenformasyon faaliyetleridir. Hakikati savunmak, bugün daha önce hiç olmadığı kadar önemli hale gelmiştir.”


Ardından, yapay zekâ için uluslararası ortak bir hukuki çerçeve oluşturulmasını ve bir BM Uluslararası Yapay Zekâ Sözleşmesi hazırlanmasını istedi. Konuşmasının sonunda dile getirdiği görüşlerin “birilerini rahatsız edeceğini” söyleyen Erdoğan, “sesimizi kısmak için her türlü algı operasyonuna başvuracaklar" iddiasında bulundu. 


BM ve Avrupa Konseyi operasyonları eleştirmişti


Erdoğan'ın bugünkü sözlerine, Türkiye'de LGBTİ+'lara yönelik operasyonlar sırasında uygulananlara yöneltilen eleştiriler çerçevesinde bir yanıt ortaya çıkmamıştı. Ancak konuşmada kullanılan “aile ve çocukların korunması” gerekçesi, Türkiye hükümetinin geçen hafta LGBTİ+ örgütlerine yönelik operasyonları savunurken kullandığı gerekçeyle örtüşüyor. Operasyonların başlamasının ardından uluslararası insan hakları mekanizmalarından tepkiler gelmişti. 


Salı günü de 65 ülkenin hak kuruluşlarından bir ortak açıklama yayımlandı:


65 ülkeden Türkiye'ye çağrı: LGBTİ+ hareketini kriminalize etmekten vazgeçin


22 Eylül 2026


BM insan hakları mekanizması Türkiye'den LGBTİ+ hak savunucularına yönelik gözaltı ve tutuklamalara son vermesini ve insan hakları faaliyetleri nedeniyle özgürlüğünden yoksun bırakılanların serbest bırakılmasını istemişti.


Altı Avrupa ülkesi ve BM İnsan Hakları Komiseri'nden Türkiye’ye LGBTİ+ operasyonları tepkisi


18 Eylül 2026


Avrupa Konseyi İnsan Hakları Komiseri Michael O'Flaherty, LGBTİ+ sivil toplumunu hedef alan operasyonlardan kaygı duyduğunu açıklamış, aile değerleri ve çocukların korunmasının insan hakları üzerindeki kısıtlamaları haklı gösteremeyeceğini belirtmişti.


Avrupa Konseyi'nden LGBTİ+’lara yönelik operasyonlara tepki


15 Eylül 2026


Avrupa Komisyonu ise gözaltılar, adli işlemler, sosyal medya hesaplarına erişim engelleri ve sivil toplum örgütlerinin finansmanının suçlamalara konu edilmesinden kaygı duyduğunu bildirmiş; Komisyon Sözcüsü Christian Wigand “damgalama ve ayrımcılığın Birliğin değerleriyle bağdaşmadığını” söylemişti.⁠

author: Acratosaurio rex
title: ¿Conocer nuestro pasado impedirá cometer sus errores?
content:
Otro de los grandes mitos del anarquismo español (1), es que su auge a finales de los siglos XIX y principios del XX, proviene del hecho de que los anarquistas no se contentaron con hacer propaganda o actuar de forma individual o en pequeños grupos de afinidad. Nuestros antecesores en España, entraron en organizaciones obreras de carácter sindical, organizaciones que atraían a sus miembros por intereses: mejoras salariales, reducciones de jornada, seguros sociales, educación, ocio… De. Esta manera agruparon desde los sindicatos a cientos de miles de trabajadores que no eran anarquistas, y que entraron así en contacto con la cultura que podemos llamarla libertaria: autonomía de partidos, solidaridad, acción directa, rechazo de representantes parlamentarios, organizaciones confederadas, etc. A diferencia de lo que sucedía en otros países donde había jefes, dirigentes, líderes de origen burgués metidos en partidos a la conquista del Estado, en el mundo sindical libertario había militantes, portavoces y referentes que eran obreros sin excepción, y que miraban con indiferencia en general, la lucha de partidos.

En fin, que el mito de la CNT, nos muestra a anarquistas más o menos convencidos, que lejos de agruparse en pequeñas organizaciones, o como decía Malatesta, en partidos anarquistas compuestos solo por anarquistas, los anarquistas españoles se mezclaron con el mundo sindical, al que dotaron de impulso, creatividad y estatutos. Por supuesto, no fue una organización perfecta la CNT que surge de las sociedades de resistencia, de los sindicatos de oficio y del Sindicato Único. La mezcla de Anarquismo + sindicato de masas + acción directa + autonomía política dio lugar a una criatura portentosa, multifacética, mítica. Hay libros de historiadores que hablan de incompetencias de la CNT, y yo os digo que no: lo hicieron todo bien. Porque como te pongas a buscar errores y a creértelos, seguro que los acabas cometiendo. So pringao, que eres un pringao con ínfulas de historiador.

Los obreros y obreras del siglo XX, adoptaban una serie de consignas que les llenaban la imaginación de posibilidades. Nada de propaganda farragosa. Por ejemplo en el campo, la consigna era la Tierra, la Unión, el Trabajo y Cumplir. No me preguntes que significaba para ellos y ellas ese asunto, os dejo que os lo imaginéis. ¿Eran anarquistas? Tal como puedes serlo tú, no. De hecho en Andalucía la FAI en los años treinta llegó a tener 743 afiliados en toda la región. La CNT tenía más de 300.000. ¿Podían setecientas y pico de personas desperdigadas por un país enorme, sin teléfonos, sin internet, sin coches, sin dinero… Dominar, mandar o dirigir a cientos de miles? Pues en mi opinión, no podían.

Bueno, son esas cosas las que me llaman la atención de este 90 aniversario de la pelea del 36. Y me sorprende como los anarquistas de libro, los de verdad que leen cosas y le dan vueltas a la cabeza todo el puto día, han renunciado a dirigirse a los trabajadores actuales a través de la ventana que les proporciona las franquicias anarcosindicalistas, que no serán perfectas para los exigentes estándares de calidad libertaria que gasta la peña. Vale. Pero tampoco es para enfadarse con ella y echarle la cruz a un amado mito sindical y libertario, que ha resistido –modestamente– los últimos y complejos 90 años.

Recuerda: conocer los errores del pasado, permite repetirlos. Eso es muy cansao.

author: Unknown
title: Le nuove regole della Resistenza
content:
Gli Houthi – o più propriamente

Ansar Allah

 -, negli ultimi giorni hanno colpito e conquistato territori e isole fondamentali per il controllo dello stretto di Bab El-Mandeb, minacciando la chiusura alle petroliere saudite e paventando la possibilità di un inasprimento della crisi energetica globale, andando ad aggiungersi alle significative conseguenze del blocco di Hormuz.


Ricordiamo che a luglio scorso, gli Houthi – che già controllavano la regione della capitale Sana’a – sono riusciti a cacciare le forze filo-governative dalla costa sud-occidentale, prendendo il controllo della città portuale di Mokha, importante centro strategico, dell’isola di Mayyun e delle isole Hanish. Tutti territori già oggetto di contesa, poiché permettono un controllo potenzialmente totale sulla viabilità dello stretto. Tutto questo è avvenuto a seguito della crisi di Hormuz e alla scelta obbligata delle petromonarchie di spostare la circolazione sull’altro lato della penisola arabica (Bab el-Mandeb, appunto), permettendo di attenuare – seppure lievemente – la strozzatura sul mercato petrolifero. La guerra civile era scoppiata nel 2014, dopo l’inizio delle operazioni militari del gruppo sciita zaidita nelle regioni ovest del Paese. Le forze armate yemenite sono state sostenute negli ultimi dodici anni – durante i quali gli Houthi hanno mantenuto pressappoco gli stessi territori fino alla scorsa settimana -, da Arabia Saudita ed Emirati Arabi Uniti, finanziati e aiutati a loro volta dagli Stati Uniti. 


L’Arabia è il maggiore esportatore di petrolio dei paesi OPEC e la sua economia, nonostante i piani di diversificazione della produzione, è ancora basato sull’export di petrolio per il 45% del PIL. Colpire il suo commercio petrolifero significa quindi assestare un colpo durissimo tanto al paese quanto al mercato del petrolio su scala globale. Inoltre il blocco è avvenuto contestualmente al sabotaggio da parte di milizie filo-iraniane in Iraq dell’oleodotto East-West, che aveva permesso, insieme a Bab el-Mandeb, di far fronte alla chiusura di Hormuz. L’offerta di greggio saudita è scesa a circa 6 milioni di barili al giorno, raggiungendo il minimo storico dal 1990 ad oggi. Se poi l’oleodotto non verrà ripristinato in tempi brevi, provocando uno stop pressoché totale all’export saudita, vi è la possibilità di un crollo del 4% dell’intera offerta globale. Attualmente gli Houthi stanno tenendo in scacco, seppur precario, l’Arabia Saudita, tanto nella sua funzione di sostegno al governo Yemenita quanto nel suo ruolo di alleato USA fondamentale per la strategia di gestione del Medio Oriente.


La guerra si inserisce infatti nella spaccatura tra Iran, di cui gli Houthi sono alleati, e paesi arabi allineati alla strategia Israelo-americana di contrasto all’Asse della Resistenza. Strategia che appare sempre più fallimentare man mano che il tempo passa. Trump infatti, dopo le richieste saudite di intervenire in Yemen, ha risposto con un secco diniego: la prospettiva di un’ulteriore campagna fallimentare – utile solo a dimostrare l’inefficienza militare USA in contesti di guerra “ibrida” – sarebbe politicamente ed economicamente insostenibile. Decisione di certo comprensibile se si considerano le elezioni midterm alle porte, ma che ha come conseguenza un rinnovato e, per il momento, sicuro margine di manovra militare per le milizie di Ansar Allah. Il perdurare della crisi potrebbe però spingere gli USA ad intervenire nonostante le imminenti elezioni. Sul versante regionale appare invece evidente lo sfaldamento dell’alleanza Arabia – Emirati, o per lo meno un allontanamento dei loro obiettivi anche sul breve periodo. L’esercito yemenita si trova infatti praticamente spaccato in due parti, una sostenuta dal regno di Saud e l’altra dagli Emirati. Questa divisione, che ha origine dalle divergenze strategiche dei due paesi – come spiegato

qui

 -, si ripercuote sui risultati politici di Israele e degli USA ottenuti con gli accordi di Abramo. Non significa certo che le alleanze USA stiano per crollare definitivamente, ma il frazionamento causato dai conflitti in corso e la resistenza – e il contrattacco – dell’Iran ne mettono a dura prova la tenuta. Come d’altra parte non si parla di una vittoria immediata dell’Asse della Resistenza: sulla carta le possibilità tecniche di colpire gli Houthi ci sarebbero.

author: Redazione_web
title: Questa non è una guerra
content:
Crosetto annuncia l’invio di navi da guerra nello stretto di Bab El Mandeb, e l’Italia è sempre più coinvolta nella guerra globale. È urgente dare una risposta chiara alle politiche di guerra, contro nuove spedizioni militari e per il ritiro di tutte le missioni all’estero. È difficile in questo momento prevedere cosa succederà nei prossimi giorni e quali fatti effettivamente seguiranno alle dichiarazioni del Ministro della Difesa Crosetto. Certo l’avanzata delle truppe del Consiglio politico supremo Huthi in Yemen ha mutato rapidamente la situazione, facendo emergere le difficoltà e le vulnerabilità dell’Arabia Saudita e dei suoi alleati, tra cui l’Italia.


Non è facile inquadrare la vicenda. Per capire cosa sta succedendo in queste settimane può essere utile riassumere alcuni fatti. In Yemen è in corso una guerra civile dal 2014 quando il Consiglio politico supremo degli Huthi, una forza sciita zaydita che negli anni è stata legata all’Iran, ha conquistato la capitale Sana’a iniziando un lungo conflitto prima contro le forze leali al regime del presidente Hādī, sostenuto da USA e Arabia Saudita, e poi dal 2022 – dopo il fallimento delle trattative di pace in seguito al ritiro di Hādī – contro il Consiglio di Leadership Presidenziale, ancora unico governo yementa riconosciuto dalla cosiddetta comunità internazionale. Nel contesto della guerra di Israele a Gaza dal 2023 e poi nel quadro della guerra con l’Iran condotta da Stati Uniti e Israele a partire dal marzo scorso, gli Huthi sono più volte intervenuti a sostegno dei propri alleati. Negli ultimi mesi lo scontro tra USA e Iran per il controllo dello stretto di Hormuz ha dato una nuova centralità strategica al Mar Rosso e allo stretto di Bab El Mandeb. Dallo scorso marzo infatti l’Arabia Saudita ha deciso di trasferire gran parte del traffico di petrolio sull’oleodotto est-ovest Petroline, che dai giacimenti di Aqbaiq nel Golfo Persico arriva fino al porto di Yanbu sul Mar Rosso, fino ad allora sottoutilizzato, iniziando ad impiegarlo al massimo della sua capacità. Da allora si sono intensificati gli attacchi lungo il tracciato di 1201 km che taglia in due la penisola arabica e ha 13 stazioni di pompaggio. La vulnerabilità dell’infrastruttura a sabotaggi ed attacchi militari si inserisce in un contesto già complesso, infatti, per limiti degli impianti, anche in una situazione di pace questa soluzione non avrebbe comunque reso l’Arabia Saudita in grado di fornire la stessa quantità e qualità di oli che potevano passare via nave attraverso Hormuz, mettendo in discussione il suo ruolo di fornitore globale di petrolio. A partire dal 3 settembre, gli Huthi hanno lanciato un’offensiva assumendo il controllo di quasi tutta la costa occidentale dello Yemen, e quindi di fatto anche dello stretto di Bab El Mandeb, occupando le principali isole di questo strategico braccio di mare. In seguito ad attacchi con droni all’oleodotto, l’Arabia Saudita ha chiuso lo scorso 11 settembre l’intera conduttura per motivi di sicurezza. Nei giorni successivi le forze Huthi sono avanzate ulteriormente in Yemen, mentre sono proseguiti i bombardamenti con droni verso l’Arabia Saudita. In questo contesto si colloca l’annuncio sull’invio di navi da guerra nello stretto di Bab El Mandeb, fatto nel pomeriggio del 17 settembre da Crosetto al Forum Risorsa Mare di La Spezia che ha visto la partecipazione di numerosi esponenti del Governo, delle Forze Armate e delle imprese armatoriali, spedizioniere e portuali. Crosetto ha affermato che l’Italia era pronta ad inviare le navi anche da sola e che la “burocrazia” italiana non si sarebbe sovrapposta a quella europea, facendo chiaramente riferimento a problemi interni alla missione europea Aspides. Poche ore dopo, nella notte tra il 17 e il 18 settembre, le forze armate Houthi hanno colpito la base aerea Re Fahd a Taif, in Arabia Saudita vicino a La Mecca. Uno dei quattro Eurofighter italiani schierati nella base, nel quadro della missione Task Force Air Arabia, è stato distrutto nell’attacco. Stando alle notizie diffuse dalle agenzie, nella base, oltre a militari sauditi, statunitensi e di altri paesi, sarebbero presenti 300 militari italiani. Le truppe italiane sono presenti nell’area da tempo, ma è dalla seconda metà di marzo che è in corso questa missione, che nel complesso prevede lo schieramento di 300 militari, 4 eurofighter, un aereo radar e due aerei da trasporto C-130J. title: Лекция Герасимова Н.И. «Язык, безвластие и космос: «всечеловеческий» язык АО братьев Гординых»
content:
6 октября 2026 г. в рамках Международного фестиваля НАУКА 0+ пройдёт лекция «Язык, безвластие и космос: «всечеловеческий» язык АО братьев Гординых».

Лектор: Николай Игоревич Герасимов, к.филос.н., с.н.с. сектора истории русской филоcофии Института философии РАН. В начале XX в. революционная Россия стремилась не только освободить мир от капитализма и империализма, но и покорить космос и объединить человечество в единую социокультурную систему. Тогда же активно обсуждался вопрос о реформе языка.

Среди наиболее радикальных мыслителей, поднимавших вопрос о роли языка в освобождении человечества и покорении космоса, были братья Гордины, анархисты и лингвисты-самоучки.

Языковой проект Гординых создавался с целью освобождения человечества от всякой власти. Абба и Вольф полагали, что все национальные языки содержат в себе «властный элемент» и избавиться от него невозможно. Поэтому единственный выход – предложить новый язык, лишённый этого «властного элемента».

Дата проведения: 6 октября 2026 г. Время: 13:00 Место проведения: Институт философии РАН, ауд. 313.

author: Animal Rising Press
title: Woman Walks Free From Pig Farrowing Crate After 21 Days And Nights In Trafalgar Square
content:
Animal Rising vows further factory farm exposés as group says three-week action marks beginning of long-term campaign to end factory farming.

Animal Rising campaign lead Michelle Farnham has today (22 September) walked free from a pig farrowing crate in Trafalgar Square after spending 21 consecutive days and nights confined inside it, without leaving once.

Michelle emerged from the crate at 11am, after first entering it at 7am on 1 September, completing an extraordinary physical and psychological challenge designed to bring the reality of factory farming into public view.

She greeted a crowd of approximately 100 supporters and was joined by her partner and family following the three weeks of intense isolation.

Thousands of passersby encountered the installation during its three weeks in one of London’s busiest public spaces, with many stopping to speak with Michelle about the action and the conditions faced by animals in factory farms.

The action attracted national and international media attention, with high-profile visitors including former RSPCA president Chris Packham and Green MP Adrian Ramsay. [1]

Animal Rising said at the event that the end of Michelle’s confinement marks only the beginning of a long-term campaign against factory farming. The group is calling on the government to commit to ending factory farming by 2040 and says further investigations and exposés of conditions inside British farms will follow.

Michelle’s action was inspired by Luna, a mother pig whose life Animal Rising documented for a month on a Suffolk factory farm. [2] Michelle was confined in similar farrowing crate, of the type used in around 90% of indoor British pig farming systems to confine mother pigs around giving birth and nursing their piglets. [3]

Around 200,000 mother pigs are confined in farrowing crates in the UK each year. Sows can spend four to five weeks at a time inside the crates, unable even to turn around. [4]

A petition to free Luna is now approaching 30,000 signatures. [5]

Michelle is available for interview about her experience of spending 21 days and nights inside the crate, the physical and psychological impact of this time, and why she believes the UK must move away from factory farming.

To arrange interviews or follow-up coverage, please contact press@animalrising.org or +44 1225 29 6691

High-quality pictures and videos: https://show.pics.io/animal-rising-breaking-news

All images and videos in this file, on our social media and website can be used with credit to Animal Rising under ‘fair use’ for the purposes of reporting.

[2] Luna investigation and footage: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=efbUsgUYUCA

[3] https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/animal-welfare-strategy-for-england/animal-welfare-strategy-for-england

[4] RSPCA information on farrowing crates: https://www.rspca.org.uk/getinvolved/campaign/farmcages

[5] Free Luna petition: https://act.animalrising.org/free_luna_pet

author: Stelinsky
title: Απάντηση του Νίκου Μαζιώτη στις δηλώσεις Γκίλφοϊλ
content:
Επ’ ευκαιρίας των δηλώσεων της πρέσβειρας των ΗΠΑ, Κίμπερλι Γκίλφοϊλ, για την αποφυλάκισή μου, θέλω να πω τα εξής: Όταν ο εχθρός κάνει τέτοιες δηλώσεις, τότε σημαίνει ότι είμαι στον σωστό δρόμο! Θα άρχιζα να ανησυχούσα αν έκανε επαινετικές δηλώσεις για το άτομό μου!

Πράγματι, δεν έχω θέση σε μια κοινωνία και σε ένα σύστημα που μέσα από την ορολογία του «πολιτισμού» εννοούν την υποταγή, την καταπίεση, τη δουλεία, τον ρατσισμό, την ανισότητα, τους πολέμους, τις γενοκτονίες λαών, την καταστροφή της φύσης και της γης. Άτομα όπως η Κίμπερλι Γκίλφοϊλ, αυτά θεωρούν ως «πολιτισμό» και «δημοκρατία».

Από την άλλη μεριά, είναι υποκρισία να με χαρακτηρίζει «τρομοκράτη» η εκπρόσωπος των πραγματικών αρχιτρομοκρατών, των σφαγέων των λαών, των ιμπεριαλιστών, αυτών που βομβαρδίζουν και δολοφονούν αμάχους στο Ιράν, παλιότερα στο Ιράκ και το Αφγανιστάν, αυτών που εξοπλίζουν το Ισραήλ για να δολοφονεί δεκάδες χιλιάδες αμάχους Παλαιστίνιους στη Λωρίδα της Γάζας.

Είναι οι ίδιοι που παλιότερα βομβάρδιζαν το Βιετνάμ και βρίσκονταν πίσω από κάθε φασιστικό-δικτατορικό καθεστώς, στη Λατινική Αμερική, την Ασία, και την Αφρική, αυτοί που εκπαίδευαν τους βασανιστές και στήριζαν τα τάγματα θανάτου. Είναι οι ίδιοι που βασάνιζαν κρατούμενους στο Γκουαντάναμο και στο Αμπού Γκράιμπ μετά την επίθεση της 11/09/2001 και την κήρυξη του πολέμου κατά της «τρομοκρατίας».

Έχει θράσος η εκπρόσωπος της Αυτοκρατορίας να μιλάει, όταν το κράτος της μέσω του ΔΝΤ επέβαλε στον ελληνικό λαό το απεχθές καθεστώς δουλοπαροικίας μέσα από τα μνημόνια που εξόντωσαν χιλιάδες πολίτες, την ίδια στιγμή που η ίδια έκανε αισχρές δηλώσεις για τον ελληνικό λαό, όπως ότι είμαστε τεμπέληδες.

Η πρέσβειρα των ΗΠΑ θα πρέπει να ξέρει ότι πολλοί σ’ αυτήν τη χώρα δεν ξεχνούν τον βρώμικο ρόλο που έπαιξε το κράτος της στην ιστορία αυτού του τόπου όπως στον εμφύλιο του 1947-1949 και τη δικτατορία του 1967-1974. Και θα πρέπει να λάβει υπόψη ότι παρά πολλοί σ’ αυτόν τον τόπο αλλά και διεθνώς χάρηκαν και επικρότησαν την επίθεση του Επαναστατικού Αγώνα με αντιαρματική ρουκέτα RPG στην πρεσβεία των ΗΠΑ το 2007. Με την επίθεση αυτή είχαμε απαντήσει στον τότε πρόεδρο των ΗΠΑ, Τζώρτζ Μπους τζούνιορ –που στο πλαίσιο του «πολέμου κατά της ‘‘τρομοκρατίας’’» είχε πει ότι «όποιος δεν είναι μαζί μας, είναι εναντίον μας»– ότι ΔΕΝ ΕΙΜΑΣΤΕ ΜΑΖΙ ΣΑΣ, ΕΙΜΑΣΤΕ ΕΝΑΝΤΙΟΝ ΣΑΣ! Όπως και πάρα πολλοί σ’ αυτόν τον τόπο!

title: “Λευτεριά στους Sumud 4”, συγκέντρωση αλληλεγγύης την Τρίτη 22/09, 18.00, στην Πρεσβεία της Τυνησίας, Αθήνα
content:
Από March to Gaza Greece:


Στις 23 Σεπτεμβρίου εκδικάζεται η έφεση των 4 Τυνήσιων συντρόφων μας κατά της απόφασης που παρέτεινε την κράτησή τους για 4 μήνες. Γι’ αυτό το Global Sumud Flotilla καλεί σε παγκόσμιες κινητοποιήσεις στις 22 Σεπτεμβρίου.


Η υγεία των 4 συντρόφων είναι σε κρίσιμη κατάσταση. Ο Wael βρίσκεται στην 36η μέρα απεργίας πείνας και κινδυνεύει σοβαρά. Φοβόμαστε ότι το δικαστήριο θα επικυρώσει την παράταση, με καταστροφικές συνέπειες για την υγεία τους.


Οι σύντροφοί μας βρίσκονται πάνω από μισό χρόνο στις φυλακές της Τυνησίας μόνο και μόνο για τη δράση τους υπέρ της Παλαιστίνης. Η αλληλεγγύη δε φυλακίζεται.


Την Τρίτη 22 Σεπτεμβρίου, στις 18.00, συγκεντρωνόμαστε ξανά έξω από την πρεσβεία της Τυνησίας. Μέχρι να αφεθούν ελεύθεροι οι 4 σύντροφοί μας, δεν σταματάμε.

author: Roaa Reda
title: Three months on, citizens await answers after appealing disqualification from subsidies
content:
During an evening visit this week to a

subsidized grocery store

in Giza, Mada Masr asked the employee at the counter about how customers have been affected since the government began cancelling citizens’ ration cards three months ago.


The store employee said around 200 people who used to get their subsidized goods from his shop have had their cards suspended.


He believed many of those customers had been wrongly disqualified from the system.

They include families whose children are enrolled in private schools charging well below

LE20,000 per year and

 people who once owned cars, but sold them long ago.


Yet, none of these customers have had their subsidies reinstated since the window for grievances

opened July 14, he said. 


The government began in June to suspend ration cards for hundreds of thousands of citizens under its new “social justice” eligibility criteria. But three months on, official state bodies have yet to give a definitive answer on when these appeals will be resolved.


This month, when Mada Masr tried to understand whether the grievance system was working, we heard a similar story repeated in conversations with people who work in or with the subsidy system, from the street level to municipal supply offices and governorate authorities. All of them said they had no idea when or how the government would start reviewing grievances and reinstating subsidies for those proven eligible. And most said that none of the citizens who had filed grievances had received a response, with one source citing “seven or eight” restorations at most.


The lack of response leaves the thousands who have filed grievances in limbo, prompting MPs to press the government not only for a clear decision, but also to ask whether there will be compensation for the monthslong wrongful suspensions that have left card holders without access to subsidies.


The confusion in the supply system exposes many families to mounting price pressures, especially as inflation spikes, leaving many uncertain about the future as the government transitions the entire commodities subsidy system to a cash assistance model that relies on digital credit allocations. 


***


To verify whether any

complainants

 have regained access to their subsidies, a Mada Masr correspondent went to a ration office in Giza and asked about the fate of appeals.

 Staff there said that, so far, not a single person who had filed a grievance has been reinstated into the system. The office could only check the status of a ration card and see how far it is in the appeal process.


Another ration office employee in Sohag, Zain al-Abideen, reiterated the same, saying that of the citizens he had helped to file grievances, not a single one was reinstated. 


Mada Masr also spoke to Badawy Dabour, who works independently to support people submitting subsidy appeals in Qalyubiya. Dabour said he had helped a large number of people file grievances, but only seven or eight have had their cards restored.


Dabour also mentioned other cases of wrongful disqualification: people with old cars, or whose children aren’t enrolled in private schools.


While citizens wait for the results of their appeals, no government body has disclosed when they can expect a response. 


In televised statements, Supply Minister Spokesperson Ahmed Kamal

said

 in August that the grievance process happens in two stages, with citizens required to submit data first via the Digital Egypt platform or via post office branches that have been dedicated to supporting grievance requests.


The second stage is going to a

ration office

with a statement confirming that they don’t own the assets for which they have been wrongfully disqualified.

 


Once cards are reactivated, he said, beneficiaries would get a text message notification. He said people would be returned to the system starting August 1, but did not say how long the review process would take. 


But this has not happened in the majority of cases, and when Mada Masr directed the question to Supply Ministry spokesperson Ahmed Kamal, asking whether the ministry has set a specific date for reactivating the cards of citizens whose eligibility has been proven, he said the work of examining and reviewing the grievances was ongoing.


Several MPs

have


directed


the

 same question to ministers via Parliament.
