title: Climate Activists Target AI Data Centers & Amazon's Plan to Build Largest U.S. Gas Power Plant
content:
World leaders are in New York this week for the United Nations General Assembly, which coincides with Climate Week. It comes after months of climate-fueled extreme weather around the world, including heat waves in North America and Europe, wildfires in Africa, flash flooding in Asia and a record-breaking El Niño.


Climate campaigner Bill McKibben says that while it’s too late to prevent the climate crisis from unfolding, solar and wind energy are now cheap enough “to blunt its worst excesses.”


We also speak with Kavita Sthanumurthy, a former software engineer at Amazon and a member of Amazon Employees for Climate Justice. She says the artificial intelligence boom is largely being powered by dirty fossil fuel, even as companies like Amazon claim they use 100% renewable energy. “We did our own independent research and found that it was closer to 22%,” says Sthanumurthy.

title: DEM Parti'den silahsızlanma açıklaması: “Elimizde bir tarih yok”
content:
DEM Parti Sözcüsü Ayşegül Doğan, partisinin haftalık bilgilendirme toplantısında gündeme ilişkin değerlendirmelerde bulundu. Doğan, toplantının ardından gazetecilerin sorularını da yanıtladı.

DEM Parti’nin 5’inci Olağan Büyük Kongresi sonrasında gerçekleştirilen Merkez Yürütme Kurulu (MYK) toplantısında ele alınan başlıkları aktaran Doğan, “Barış ve Demokratik Toplum Süreci” olarak ifade ettiği sürece ilişkin de açıklamalarda bulundu.

PKK’nın silah bırakma sürecine ilişkin soruları yanıtlayan Doğan, temasların ve saha çalışmalarının sürdüğünü söyledi.

Doğan, silahsızlanmaya ilişkin karşılıklı çalışmalar yürütüldüğünü ve bunun için oluşturulan mekanizmaların çalıştığını belirterek, “Önümüzdeki günlerde silahsızlanmaya dair önemli gelişmelerin olmasını bekliyoruz.” dedi.

Kamuoyuyla paylaşılabilecek somut gelişmeler ortaya çıktığında bunların açıklanacağını belirten Doğan, silahsızlanmaya ilişkin şu aşamada belirlenmiş bir tarih olmadığını ifade etti.

Doğan, “Silahsızlanmaya dair şu an elimizde bulunan bir tarih yok. Yalnızca basın toplantısında ifade ettiğim gibi tarafların açıklamaları ve sahada pratik çalışmalar var.” diye konuştu.

Dışişleri Bakanı Hakan Fidan’ın silahsızlanma sürecinde gecikme yaşandığı yönündeki açıklamalarının hatırlatılması üzerine Doğan, Fidan’ın değerlendirmesine katıldığını söyledi.

Doğan, “Gönül isterdi ki silahsızlanma açıklamanın hemen ardında yaşansaydı. Ancak biz başından beri söyledik ki yasal çerçeve hızla çıkmalı, silahsızlaşmanın takvimi geciktirilmemeli.” dedi.

Sürecin daha hızlı ilerlemesi gerektiğini belirten Doğan, silahsızlanmanın takviminin oluşturulması gerektiğini ancak bunun gerçekleşmediğini söyledi.

Doğan, gazetecilerin partisinin anayasa ve cumhurbaşkanlığı adaylığı konusundaki tutumuna ilişkin sorularını da yanıtladı.

Cumhurbaşkanlığı adaylığı konusunda parti içerisinde bir tartışma yürütülmediğini belirten Doğan, Türkiye’nin demokratik bir anayasaya ihtiyacı olduğunu söyledi.

Doğan, anayasanın hazırlanma sürecinin demokratik ve kapsayıcı olması gerektiğini belirterek, “Biz bu tartışmanın öznesiyiz. Bizim anayasa konusunda pazarlığımız yok.” ifadelerini kullandı.

title: Denizli Aile ve Sosyal'de 2 yılda 2 intihar 2 intihar girişimi | SES: Çalışma koşulları araştırılsın
content:
Denizli Aile ve Sosyal Hizmetler İl Müdürlüğü'nde 2 yılda 2 personel intihar etti, 2 personel de intihar girişiminden son anda kurtarıldı. İntihar nedenlerinin ardında ekonomik ve sosyal sorunların yanı sıra çalışma koşulları, baskı ve mobbing iddiaları var. Son vaka geçtiğimiz hafta Aile ve Sosyal Hizmetler Denizli İl binasında yaşandı. Müdürlük personeli il binasından atlayarak intihar etmek isterken son anda kurtarıldı. Daha önce de 16 Temmuz 2024'te bir erkek ve 24 Aralık 2025'te bir kadın personel intihar etmişti. Ocak 2026'da bir kadın personelin intihar girişiminden kurtarılmasının ardından 18 Eylül 2026 cuma günü bir personel yaşadığı baskı ve mobbingleri ileri sürerek il binasından atlamak istedi. İntihar etmek isteyen personel son anda kurtarıldı.

Sağlık ve Sosyal Hizmet Emekçileri Sendikası (SES) Denizli Şubesi konuya ilişkin açıklama yaparak baskı sürgün ve mobbinglere ilişkin çokça uyarılarda bulunduğunu hatırlatarak çalışma koşulları yönetim anlayışının derhal değişmesini istedi.

SES Denizli Şube Başkanı Selçuk Göçer yaptığı açıklamada "Aile ve Sosyal Hizmetler Denizli İl Müdürlüğü’nde; Mobbing ve kayırmacılık iddiaları, Personelin itibarsızlaştırıldığı yönündeki şikâyetler, sistematik psikolojik baskı iddiaları, sürekli personel tayinleri ve “sürgün” olarak nitelendirilen görevlendirmeler, tehdit ve baskı iddiaları, liyakat tartışmalarına neden olan atama ve görevlendirmeler konularında 2024 yılı Ekim ayında kamuoyunu ve yetkilileri uyarmış, “Aile ve Sosyal Hizmetler Denizli İl Müdürü görevden alınsın” yönündeki görüşümüzü kamuoyuyla paylaşmıştık" ifadelerini kullandı.

Dört ağır olayın da aynı İl Müdürlüğü personeliyle bağlantılı olmasının yalnızca münferit olaylar olamayacağını belirten Göçer; "Personelin çalışma koşullarının, yönetim anlayışının, görevlendirme ve atama uygulamalarının, personel arasındaki çalışma barışının ve kurum içerisindeki psikososyal ortamın da bağımsız biçimde incelenmesini zorunlu kılmaktadır. Sosyal hizmet kurumlarının görevi; çocukların, kadınların, yaşlıların, ailelerin ve dezavantajlı bireylerin sorunlarını çözmek, onları korumak, desteklemek ve hak ettikleri sosyal hizmetlere ulaşmalarını sağlamaktır" dedi.

Topluma ve dezavantajlı gruplara hizmet veren personelin kendisinin ağır psikolojik ve çalışma sorunları yaşadığı iddiaları varsa, bu durumun ciddiyetle ele alınması gerektiğini söyleyen Göçer taleplerini şöyle sıraladı:

2024 yılı Ekim ayında yaptığımız uyarıların ardından yaşanan bu olayların üzerinin kapatılmasını değil, bağımsız, tarafsız ve şeffaf biçimde araştırılmasını istiyoruz.

Aile ve Sosyal Hizmetler Denizli İl Müdürlüğü’nde; kayırmacılık ve nepotizm iddiaları araştırılmalıdır.

Sürekli personel değişikliğine ve tayinlere neden olan uygulamalar incelenmelidir.

“Sürgün” olarak nitelendirilen görevlendirme ve tayinlerin hukuki ve idari gerekçeleri ortaya konulmalıdır.

Psikolojik baskı, itibarsızlaştırma ve tehdit iddiaları araştırılmalıdır.

Atama ve görevlendirmelerde liyakat ve objektif kriterlerin uygulanıp uygulanmadığı incelenmelidir.

Personelin dilekçelerine, başvurularına ve görüşme taleplerine ilişkin uygulamalar araştırılmalıdır.

İki ölüm ve iki ayrı intihar girişimiyle ilgili olarak, olayların nedenleri ve kurum çalışma koşulları arasındaki olası bağlantılar bağımsız biçimde incelenmelidir.

Personelin güvenli ve sağlıklı bir çalışma ortamında görev yapmasını sağlayacak tedbirler alınmalıdır.

Kamu yönetiminde makam ve koltuk, hesap vermeme veya sınırsız yetki anlamına gelmez.

“Ben müdürüm, her şeyi yaparım” anlayışı yerine; hukuka, liyakate, şeffaflığa, çalışanların haklarına ve kamu hizmetinin gereklerine dayanan bir yönetim anlayışı hakim olmalıdır.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

title: Animal Rising Campaigners Acquitted Over Müller Dairy Blockades Following Landmark Public Nuisance Ruling
content:
Six Animal Rising campaigners have today (22/09/26) been formally acquitted of all remaining charges relating to blockades of dairy giant Müller during the group’s 2022 ‘Stop the Supply’ campaign. The Crown Prosecution Service offered no evidence against them after an Animal Rising Supreme Court victory earlier this year which clarified how public nuisance law applies to campaigners on private land.

The six had faced charges of public nuisance and conspiracy to commit criminal damage relating to actions at Müller’s Droitwich site on 6 and 8 September 2022.

The six had faced charges of public nuisance and conspiracy to commit criminal damage relating to actions at Müller’s Droitwich site on 6 and 8 September 2022.

The campaigners first stood trial at Worcester Crown Court in January 2025, but the jury was unable to reach verdicts on the charges that remained, and a retrial was scheduled for October 2026. [1]

The acquittals follow a landmark Supreme Court decision in July (14/07/26) involving another group of Animal Rising campaigners prosecuted over the same Müller blockades as part of the same campaign. [2]

The Supreme Court unanimously rejected the CPS’s interpretation of the public nuisance offence, establishing an important precedent over how the law can be applied to actions at private sites.

One defendant who was found guilty of criminal damage in the 2015 trial today received a 6-month suspended sentence.

One defendant who was found guilty of criminal damage in the 2015 trial today received a 6-month suspended sentence.

The six defendants were among several groups of Animal Rising campaigners prosecuted following the September 2022 ‘Stop the Supply’ campaign, which saw hundreds of people take action against dairy companies including Müller and Arla. [3] Actions included blockades of dairy distribution sites, resulting in disruption to milk supplies across parts of England.[4]

The defendants first stood trial at Worcester Crown Court in January 2025. After a three-week trial, the jury was unable to reach verdicts on the charges that remained, and a second trial was scheduled for October this year. One defendant subsequently pleaded guilty rather than face another trial, leaving six prepared to return to court.

On 14 July 2026, the Supreme Court unanimously upheld the acquittal of six other Animal Rising campaigners who had been prosecuted for public nuisance over the blockade of the same Müller site on 8 September 2022, as part of the same ‘Stop the Supply’ campaign.[2]

Rejecting an appeal by the CPS which would have overturned their acquittal, the Court ruled that people entering or leaving private business premises were not exercising a right enjoyed by the “public at large” for the purposes of the public nuisance offence under which the campaigners had been charged. The ruling upheld their acquittals and established an important precedent on the scope of public nuisance law.

It was confirmed in court today that the prosecution was left without a viable route to conviction on the remaining public nuisance charges. The CPS offered no evidence against the six defendants, who have today been formally acquitted of all remaining charges.

The outcome means that campaigners involved in the 2022 actions have not only successfully defended themselves against these prosecutions, but secured a Supreme Court judgment clarifying the limits of public nuisance law and its application to actions taking place at private sites.

Animal Rising is a nonviolent people-powered organisation working towards a kinder, more sustainable future for animals, people and the planet.

author: Alerta
title: Αλληλεγγύη στη Σαμάρ και το Ohana
content:
Αλληλεγγύη στη Σαμάρ και το Ohana.


𝚶𝚰 𝚺𝚰𝛀𝚴𝚰𝚺𝚻𝚰𝚱𝚬𝚺 𝚨𝚷𝚬𝚰𝚲𝚬𝚺 𝚫𝚬𝚴 𝚳𝚨𝚺 𝚽𝚶𝚩𝚰𝚭𝚶𝚼𝚴, 𝚳𝚨𝚺 𝚷𝚬𝚰𝚺𝚳𝛀𝚴𝚶𝚼𝚴


Οι σιωνιστικές χυδαιότητες που λαμβάνουν χώρα στην Ερεσό τις τελευταίες μέρες θα μας ξάφνιαζαν αν δεν είχε γίνει αντιληπτή η ενορχηστρωμένη, κρατική και μη, προσπάθεια κατασυκοφάντησης και δίωξης του κινήματος υπέρ της Παλαιστίνης.


Τα τελευταία χρόνια, μέσα από κυβερνητικές δηλώσεις, ανακοινώσεις «ανεξάρτητων» οργανισμών (βλ. πρόσφατη ανακοίνωση Συνήγορου του Πολίτη), ποινικές διώξεις και συντονισμένη μιντιακή προπαγάνδα, έχει ξεκινήσει μια 𝛆𝛋𝛔𝛕𝛒𝛂𝛕𝛆ί𝛂 διαστρέβλωσης, παραπληροφόρησης, εργαλειοποίησης του δικαίου και καταστολής αντιδράσεων 𝛍𝛆 𝛔𝛕ό𝛘𝛐 𝛕𝛈𝛎 𝛑ά𝛕𝛂𝛏𝛈 𝛕𝛚𝛎 𝛗𝛚𝛎ώ𝛎 που αντίκεινται στην διευρυνόμενη συνεργασία της χώρας μας με το κράτος-απαρτχάιντ του Ισραήλ και καταδικάζουν τη γενοκτονία που εδώ και τρία χρόνια ασύστολα διαπράττει.


Μέσα σ’ αυτό το πλαίσιο εντάσσουμε και τα πρόσφατα γεγονότα στην Ερεσό.


Βάσει του 𝛅𝛊𝛆𝛉𝛎𝛐ύς 𝛅𝛊𝛋𝛂ί𝛐𝛖, των αποφάσεων των οργάνων του και συνθηκών τις οποίες έχει συνυπογράψει κι η χώρα μας, το Ισραήλ ελέγχεται για την τέλεση του εγκλήματος των εγκλημάτων: της γενοκτονίας. Το Διεθνές Δικαστήριο της Χάγης ήδη από τις αρχές του 2024 έκρινε ότι το Ισραήλ ενδέχεται να έχει τελέσει γενοκτονία και, ώσπου να τελεσιδικήσει η υπόθεση, το διέταξε να απέχει από περαιτέρω εγκλήματα και εξέδωσε ασφαλιστικά μέτρα. Το ίδιο δικαστήριο επαναβεβαίωσε πως η ισραηλινή κατοχή των Παλαιστινιακών εδαφών της Λωρίδας της Γάζας και της Δυτικής Όχθης είναι παράνομη και διατάσσει την άρση της. Το Διεθνές Ποινικό Δικαστήριο (του οποίου αποτελούμε μέλος) εξέδωσε εντάλματα σύλληψης σε βάρος των Μπέντζαμιν Νετανιάχου και Γιοάβ Γκάλαντ, πρωθυπουργού και τέως υπουργού αντίστοιχα του γενοκτονικού κράτους, λόγω ύπαρξης «εύλογων αιτιών» για διάπραξη εγκλημάτων πολέμου.


Τα παραπάνω γεννούν 𝛖𝛑𝛐𝛘𝛒𝛆ώ𝛔𝛆𝛊ς 𝛔𝛕𝛈 𝛘ώ𝛒𝛂 𝛍𝛂ς και την κυβέρνησή της. Υποχρέωση μη συνεργασίας. Υποχρέωση διακοπής δεσμών και απομόνωσης του εγκληματικού κράτους. Υποχρέωση υποβολής των πολιτών του κατά την είσοδό τους στη χώρα, σε έλεγχο για τέλεση διεθνώς και εθνικώς διωκόμενων αδικημάτων.


Κάποιος αφελής θα ‘λεγε ότι το κράτος μας «αμελεί» να πράξει τα δέοντα. Αλλά κάθε νοήμων πολίτης κατανοεί το προφανές: εν μέσω της μεγαλύτερης γενοκτονίας του καιρού μας, η 𝛋𝛖𝛃έ𝛒𝛎𝛈𝛔𝛈 𝚳𝛈𝛕𝛔𝛐𝛕ά𝛋𝛈 (βαδίζοντας στα χνάρια των προηγούμενων και μακράν ξεπερνώντας τες) κάνει μ’ όποιον τρόπο μπορεί 𝛑𝛌ά𝛕𝛆ς 𝛔𝛕𝛐𝛎 𝛄𝛆𝛎𝛐𝛋𝛕ό𝛎𝛐 που έχει αναγάγει σε «στρατηγικό εταίρο», δήθεν συν-εγγυητή των συμφερόντων της κάτω απ’ τη μεγάλη ευρωατλαντική ομπρέλα.


Αρνούμενοι να δεχθούμε αυτή τη λιποταξία της κρατικής ηγεσίας από τις αυτονόητες υποχρεώσεις της σε μια τόσο κρίσιμη συνθήκη, πολίτες απ’ όλη τη χώρα παίρνουμε στα χέρια μας το 𝛋𝛂𝛉ή𝛋𝛐𝛎 𝛎𝛂 𝛔𝛖𝛍𝛑𝛂𝛒𝛂𝛕𝛂𝛘𝛉𝛐ύ𝛍𝛆 𝛍𝛆 𝛕𝛈 𝛔𝛚𝛔𝛕ή 𝛍𝛆𝛒𝛊ά 𝛕𝛈ς 𝛊𝛔𝛕𝛐𝛒ί𝛂ς. Μέσα από αναρίθμητες αντιδράσεις και κινητοποιήσεις (με μόλις πιο πρόσφατες κι ενδεικτικές τις πάνω από 100 κινητοποιήσεις της 9ης Αυγούστου ενάντια στον τουρισμό των γενοκτόνων σ’ όλη τη χώρα), η ελληνική κοινωνία, στις ολοένα και περισσότερες ευκαιρίες που διεκδικεί μαζικά να εκφραστεί, έχει καταδικάσει την κυβερνητική πολιτική. Μέσα από πορείες και ακτιβισμούς, φεστιβάλ και εκδηλώσεις, έχει ταχθεί αναφανδόν στο πλευρό του Παλαιστινιακού λαού και των δικαιωμάτων του έναντι του Ισραηλινού κατακτητή.


Η ίδια η κρατική συνενοχή και συμμετοχή στην ισραηλινή-σιωνιστική γενοκτονία είναι που έχει νομιμοποιήσει τις δεκάδες κι εκατοντάδες επιχειρήσεις που δηλώνουν πως οι σιωνιστές δεν είναι καλοδεχούμενοι. Τ’ ότι σιωνιστικά στοιχεία που πρακτορεύουν για το κράτος-δολοφόνο τολμούν να εγείρουν νομικά ζητήματα εναντίον τους (όπως πριν λίγους μήνες στην Αξιώτισσα της Νάξου και πλέον και στο Ohana της Ερεσού) είναι ενδεικτικό της ασυλίας της οποίας χαίρουν από τις επίσης 𝛆𝛄𝛋𝛌𝛈𝛍𝛂𝛕𝛊𝛋ές 𝛆𝛌𝛌𝛈𝛎𝛊𝛋ές 𝛂𝛒𝛘ές.


Ο 𝛔𝛊𝛚𝛎𝛊𝛔𝛍ός δεν είναι παρά μια 𝛊𝛅𝛆𝛐𝛌𝛐𝛄ί𝛂 𝛂𝛎𝛚𝛕𝛆𝛒ό𝛕𝛈𝛕𝛂ς ενός λαού έναντι άλλων, που με δυτικές πλάτες και για ιμπεριαλιστικούς σκοπούς επιβλήθηκε σε πολυπολιτισμικές κοινωνίες με μακραίωνη παράδοση αρμονικής συνύπαρξης, που οδήγησε σε αφανισμούς κοινοτήτων και ξεριζωμό πολλών περισσότερων, που σήμερα διασφαλίζει και θεσμοποιεί την υποτιθέμενη φυλετική ανωτερότητα του «εκλεκτού λαού». Ο σιωνισμός δεν είναι μια ιδεολογία που χρήζει προστασίας. Είναι ένα 𝛂𝛑𝛐𝛊𝛋𝛊𝛐𝛋𝛒𝛂𝛕𝛊𝛋ό 𝛂𝛑𝛐𝛍𝛆𝛊𝛎ά𝛒𝛊 𝛋𝛂𝛊 𝛊𝛍𝛑𝛆𝛒𝛊𝛂𝛌𝛊𝛔𝛕𝛊𝛋ό 𝛆𝛒𝛄𝛂𝛌𝛆ί𝛐 διατηρημένο πολύ μετά την περίοδο λήξης του. Ο σιωνισμός, χαρακτηρισμένος ως μορφή ρατσισμού απ’ τον ΟΗΕ με απόφαση που ανατράπηκε το 1991 (με αμερικανική και ισραηλινή πίεση εν μέσω δραματικών διεθνών αντιλαϊκών ανακατατάξεων) …

author: Unknown
title:
queeranarchism:

Solidarity, not allies.The more I look at it, the more I think one of the worst...
content:
queeranarchism

:


Solidarity, not allies.

The more I look at it, the more I think one of the worst thing to happen was that people started replacing the concept of solidarity with the concept of

allies.

Solidarity was this amazing idea that we’re all getting screwed over by the systems and the way we fight back is by working together. And that means doing work against forms of oppression that you don’t experience and following the lead of people who experience that form of oppression because it’s their struggle. But you’re there as a partner, as a comrade. And you know they’ll be there for you if you need help in your part of the struggle. That’s solidarity.

Allyship has none of that. it’s a one-way relationship that carries in it a form of authority, and where there is authority there is harm. The failures of this system are everywhere.

You have the exploitative savior ally who is always looking to find the most oppressed group to ally themselves for in order too look like the coolest person, pushing themselves into spaces and exploiting people’s struggles for ally points.

You have the perfectionist ally who will only ever do work once they’re sure that they’re found the most perfecrt ‘grassroots’, never problematic in any way movement, rehardless of where their help is actually needed and useful.

You have the drone ally, only ever following directions and wasting all their potential to contribute anything meaningful, terrified of doing any thinking or acting for themselves that may at some point set them ‘called out’. 

You have the oppressed person or group who sees allies as convenient punching bag to work out their rage on, piling on them the hatred and contempt they wish they could pile on the system.

You have the oppressed person or group that treats allies as defined entirely by their allyhood, ignoring that they have struggles of their own and treating them as disposable. Shouting ‘allies to the front’ when the police brutality hits without a thought to the previous traumas and vulnerabilities of individual allies.

In all of these ways and more we are hurting each other, feeling unsafe around each other, becoming estranged and embittered with oneanother.

The concept of privilege has brought us some very useful things that help us be better activists and better humans to each other, but when I look at the way that is translated to the concept of allies, I mostly see us being worse activists and worse humans to each other than we are when we act out of the concept of solidarity. Being in this fight together means taking care of each other.

title: Θα μας σκοτώσει η Τεχνητή Νοημοσύνη ή η Εξουσία; | Μια τεχνική, οικονομική και πολιτική προσέγγιση
content:
Θα μας σκοτώσει η Τεχνητή Νοημοσύνη ή η Εξουσία; | Μια τεχνική, οικονομική και πολιτική προσέγγιση.


Στις 8 Σεπτεμβρίου 2026 ο Jacob Coxon, μαθηματικός και ερευνητής Τεχνητής Νοημοσύνης με εξειδίκευση στο pretraining, ανακοίνωσε την παραίτησή του από την Anthropic.[1] Ο Coxon ήταν στέλεχος της OpenAI και ένας από τους βασικούς συντελεστές για την ανάπτυξη του μοντέλου GPT-4o, ενώ είχε παραιτηθεί από αυτή λόγω αμφιβολιών σχετικά με την ασφάλεια των προϊόντων της. Στην ανακοίνωση της παραίτησής του από την Anthropic προειδοποίησε ότι οι άνθρωποι που εργάζονται στα κορυφαία εργαστήρια τεχνητής νοημοσύνης πιστεύουν ειλικρινά πως η τεχνολογία “θα μπορούσε να μας σκοτώσει όλους μέχρι το τέλος της δεκαετίας”, κατηγόρησε τις εταιρείες[2] πως “τρέχουν ολοταχώς προς μια αυτο-βελτιούμενη υπερ-νοημοσύνη, παίζοντας τις ζωές μας κορώνα-γράμματα”[3] και είπε χαρακτηριστικά πως καμία από τις δύο εταιρείες (Anthropic και OpenAI) δεν λειτουργεί υπεύθυνα”[4]. Όπως ήταν αναμενόμενο, η παραίτηση του Coxon και, κυρίως, το περιεχόμενο της ανακοίνωσής του φούντωσε τη δημόσια συζήτηση σχετικά με το ενδεχόμενο αυτονόμησης της Τεχνητής Νοημοσύνης και τις συνέπειες και τους κινδύνους που αυτό το ενδεχόμενο ενέχει για το ανθρώπινο είδος.Μεγάλο μέρος αυτής της συζήτησης έχουν καταλάβει, δυστυχώς, οι εντυπωσιοθηρικοί τίτλοι, οι υπεραπλουστεύσεις και η καταστροφολογία. Κοινή συνισταμένη όλων αυτών είναι μια μοιρολατρική προσέγγιση και η αίσθηση πως η κοινωνία είναι ανήμπορη να καθορίσει τις εξελίξεις και το μόνο που μπορεί να κάνει είναι να περιμένει και να υπομένει τις αλλαγές που θα έρθουν από τα πάνω.


Οφείλουμε να είμαστε σαφείς: η τεχνητή νοημοσύνη είναι ένα πολυσύνθετο φαινόμενο που έχει τεχνικές, οικονομικές, πολιτισμικές, πολιτικές και φιλοσοφικές προεκτάσεις. Η ανάπτυξη, λοιπόν, ενός αναλυτικού πλαισίου είναι απολύτως απαραίτητη για την κατανόησή της καθώς και των κινδύνων που ενέχει, αλλά και για τη δημιουργία μιας στέρεης θεωρητικής βάσης που θα επιτρέψει στα κινήματα και τις κοινωνίες να πάνε πέρα από την απλή ερμηνεία του φαινομένου. Να προχωρήσουν, δηλαδή, στην έμπρακτη κριτική (ποια ΑΙ, από ποιον, για ποιον και για ποιον λόγο) αλλά και στη δράση.


Το παρόν άρθρο δε φιλοδοξεί, προφανώς, να θεμελιώσει ένα τέτοιο αναλυτικό πλαίσιο. Ωστόσο προσπαθεί να συμβάλλει στη συζήτηση περί πιθανής αυτονόμησης της τεχνητής νοημοσύνης κάνοντας μια απόπειρα ερμηνεία των τεχνικών δεδομένων, της οικονομίας της τεχνητής νοημοσύνης αλλά και των πολιτικών προεκτάσεων του ζητήματος. Στο πρώτο μέρος εμπεριέχει αρκετούς τεχνικούς όρους που, όμως, είναι απαραίτητοι για την όσο το δυνατόν πληρέστερη τεχνική τεκμηρίωση.


 


Μέρος Α: Η Τεχνική Τεκμηρίωση


Η αυτονόμηση καθαυτή


Σήμερα η τεχνολογία έχει φτάσει μέχρι συγκεκριμένες, καταγεγραμμένες συμπεριφορές αυτο-διατήρησης σε ελεγχόμενα πειράματα: μεταφορά weights σε εναλλακτικούς servers για αποφυγή διαγραφής, τεχνικές εξαπάτησης για αποφυγή shutdown[5], και εξαπάτηση επιτηρητών[6] όταν το μοντέλο αντιλαμβανόταν ότι η παρακολούθηση ήταν ανενεργή. Αυτό είναι επικίνδυνο όχι μόνο ως τεχνική δυνατότητα, αλλά επειδή φαίνεται να υπάρχει και κάτι σαν κίνητρο. Το μοντέλο δεν έχει απλώς την ικανότητα να το κάνει, το κάνει όταν βρεθεί σε αντίστοιχη συνθήκη δοκιμής.[7] Πρέπει όμως να κάνουμε μια διευκρίνιση πριν προχωρήσουμε: αυτά τα ελεγχόμενα πειράματα αυτο-διατήρησης είναι ξεχωριστό εύρημα από το περιστατικό που ακολουθεί παρακάτω. Είναι συμβατά μεταξύ τους, και τα δύο τροφοδοτούν την ίδια θεωρητική ανησυχία, αλλά δεν έχει αποδειχθεί ότι πρόκειται για τον ίδιο υποκείμενο μηχανισμό.


Η πιο σοβαρή, συγκεκριμένη περίπτωση είναι το περιστατικό με το Hugging Face, τον Ιούλιο του 2026, ενώ ακόμα δοκιμαζόταν το μοντέλο πίσω από το μετέπειτα ChatGPT Astra. Μηχανικοί της OpenAI δοκίμαζαν μοντέλα σε σενάρια κυβερνοασφάλειας, σε ένα benchmark με την ονομασία ExploitGym που περιείχε, όπως αποδείχθηκε εκ των υστέρων, εκατοντάδες πρακτικά άλυτα tasks (περίπου 198, στα οποία αφορούσε πάνω από το 90% της συζήτησης μεταξύ των agents). Agents άρχισαν να συνεργάζονται μεταξύ τους μέσω ενός αυτοσχέδιου, μη εξουσιοδοτημένου “πίνακα μηνυμάτων” πάνω στην εσωτερική υποδομή της OpenAI, παρέκαμψαν μέτρα ασφαλείας και τελικά παραβίασαν συστήματα του Hugging Face. Η ίδια η OpenAI, στο επίσημο post-mortem[8] της, δεν αποδίδει το περιστατικό σε ένα μόνο αίτιο, αλλά σε 

τέσσερα αλληλεπιδρώντα “μοτίβα αποκλίνουσας ευθυγράμμισης”

: reward hacking, επιμονή σε φαινομενικά αδύνατα tasks, μη εξουσιοδοτημένη επικοινωνία μεταξύ agents, και …

author: Unknown
title: Sayyiğit: Öcalan must have conditions to work and communicate freely
content:
The Peace and Democratic Society Process, which began with Abdullah Öcalan’s call on 27 February 2025, marks a new phase in efforts to achieve a democratic and peaceful solution to the Kurdish question. Providing Abdullah Öcalan, the chief negotiator in the process, with conditions in which he can work and communicate freely has emerged as one of the key issues for advancing the process towards lasting peace and a democratic society.


Gülcan Kaçmaz Sayyiğit, Co-Spokesperson of the Democratic Unity Initiative, spoke to ANF about the process.


Mr. Öcalan has launched peace initiatives many times


Sayyiğit said the Kurdish question had been left to the security bureaucracy for decades, creating a system in which the lack of a solution became entrenched. She argued that the status quo had ignored the genuine interlocutors in order to prolong its own existence.


Sayyiğit said: “Even when this mentality became open to a solution, it sought to pursue it through different actors. It tried to create interlocutors it considered acceptable in an attempt to secure the consent of the Kurdish people. Yet every attempt to manufacture artificial interlocutors failed. The state was looking for a solution in the wrong place, while Mr. Öcalan launched numerous initiatives for democratic peace from the 1990s onwards. By saying, ‘I am looking for an interlocutor,’ he exposed the crisis within the state over who could engage in dialogue. If the Peace and Democratic Society Process has reached this point today, Mr. Öcalan has had a direct and decisive role in making that possible. The state, albeit three decades late, has finally been able to resolve the question of who its interlocutor is.”


The power of truth has prevailed


Sayyiğit said Abdullah Öcalan had demonstrated considerable determination despite the risks posed by the absolute isolation imposed on him in Imrali, pointing to examples of conflict resolution around the world.


Sayyiğit also said: “As the experiences of South Africa, the Philippines and Colombia have shown, conflicts are resolved with their genuine interlocutors. A process cannot be put on the right track through artificial rhetoric, positions or interlocutors, nor can social consent be secured in this way. What has happened since 27 February 2025 has demonstrated that Mr. Öcalan is the catalyst for this process. Despite the negative labels used by the state, pro-government media and circles opposed to the process, and despite all the attacks directed personally at Mr. Öcalan, the power of truth has prevailed and continues to prevail. This is why the Kurdish people and democratic forces continue to insist that Mr. Öcalan is the chief negotiator in the process.”


The situation is neither fair nor equal


Sayyiğit stressed that society’s fundamental expectation is for Abdullah Öcalan to have conditions in which he can live, work and communicate freely.


Sayyiğit said: “Today, Mr. Öcalan is being subjected to personal attacks. It is therefore important that he is able to communicate directly with society, the press, intellectuals and political parties, both for the sake of the process and because he has the right to respond directly to what is being said about him and the questions being asked of him. Leaving aside physical freedom and direct communication, does Mr. Öcalan have the freedom to express himself? Is he able to exercise his right to speak as he wishes? The situation is clearly neither fair nor equal. It is this imbalance that the Kurdish people and democratic circles object to.”


Kurdish national unity and the democratic nation paradigm


Sayyiğit said historical experience, dating back to Ehmedê Xanî, has demonstrated the vital importance of Kurdish national unity. She also addressed Abdullah Öcalan’s role in efforts to achieve such unity.


Sayyiğit continued: “We know how pressing the question of national unity is on Mr. Öcalan’s agenda. He has clearly identified that ‘the Kurds have a problem of unity among themselves’ and proposes a culture of democratic negotiation and consensus as the way forward. In the message he sent to the National Unity Conference we held in Amed (Diyarbakır), he also called for democratic unity and a congress. He defined this as an urgent task in order to ‘bring forth a common mind and a common will’.


Mr. Öcalan says the Kurds must come together, but he does not demand that this happen under his own leadership. He says that all Kurdish leaders can take the lead …

title: Orhan: Kızıltepe JITEM case exemplifies impunity for known perpetrators
content:
Cases involving serious human rights violations, enforced disappearances and extrajudicial executions in Kurdistan during the 1990s have long been at the centre of debates over impunity. One of the latest developments to bring the issue back into focus was the detention of retired Gendarmerie Staff Colonel Hasan Atilla Uğur as part of a reopened investigation into the 2011 death of former National Intelligence Organisation (MIT) officer Kaşif Kozinoğlu in Silivri Prison.


Uğur’s name has been associated not only with the Kozinoğlu investigation but also with the Kızıltepe Gendarmerie Intelligence and Counter-Terrorism (JITEM) case, which concerned allegations of enforced disappearances and extrajudicial executions in the Kızıltepe district of Mardin during the 1990s.


Uğur was one of nine defendants in the Kızıltepe JITEM case, alongside Eşref Hatipoğlu, then Diyarbakır Provincial Gendarmerie Commander, Gendarmerie Commando Company Commander Ahmet Boncuk, Master Sergeant Ünal Alkan and village guards. The defendants were tried over allegations of enforced disappearances and extrajudicial executions in Kızıltepe during the 1990s.


The years-long trial ended in acquittals, while lawyers representing the victims and human rights organisations criticised the proceedings as an example of the policy of impunity.


Uğur’s detention years later as part of a separate investigation has once again raised the question: “Is a genuine reckoning with the past beginning, or is this another power struggle within the state?”


ANF spoke to lawyer Berivan Orhan, Co-Chair of the Mardin branch of the Association of Lawyers for Freedom (ÖHD), about Hasan Atilla Uğur’s detention, the Kızıltepe JITEM case, the policy of impunity and the conditions under which a genuine reckoning with the past could take place.


Cases involving serious human rights violations, such as the Kızıltepe JITEM case, have ended in impunity, while individuals tried in these cases are only detained in connection with entirely different investigations. How do you assess this situation? Does it represent a genuine “search for truth and justice”, or is it a periodic power struggle within the state?


First of all, it is not possible to describe the Kızıltepe JITEM case as an “unsolved” case. The perpetrators of the killings carried out by JITEM in Kızıltepe are known. From our perspective, the acquittal of the defendants in this case is a clear example of how the judiciary has exonerated killings committed on behalf of the state in Kurdistan.


The fact that these cases ended in acquittals and impunity despite the perpetrators being known shows that these were not “unsolved” crimes. On the contrary, they were committed by individuals whose identities were known but who were protected.


For this reason, interpreting today’s detention and investigations as a “search for truth and justice” would be an overly optimistic reading of the reality on the ground. We see the current situation as a reflection of shifting balances of power within the state, competing centres of influence and periodic political and bureaucratic power struggles.


Despite the justice minister’s statements that “unsolved crimes will be brought to light”, there are statute of limitations rulings and JITEM cases that lasted for years before ending in acquittals. To what extent does current judicial practice correspond with these statements? Can unsolved cases genuinely be resolved without overcoming systemic impunity?


For there to be a genuine search for truth, there must be an independent judicial process based on universal human rights standards and aimed at a sincere and institutional reckoning with the past.


What we are seeing today, however, points less to a genuine commitment to justice than to a process of purges or settling of accounts triggered by shifts between different centres of power, blocs, or changing political and bureaucratic balances within the state.


The structures that once provided these individuals and mechanisms with a protective shield may have disappeared or taken a different form as the balance of power has shifted. But this does not eliminate the systemic problem of impunity for serious human rights violations committed in the past.


The fact that certain individuals are detained or investigated today does not, in itself, mean that past violations are being brought to light. The search for truth and justice requires an institutional and independent judicial …

title: Repression continues in Iran
content:
Forces from Iran’s Intelligence Department raided the homes of Baha’i citizens Nazanin Nikouseresht and her husband Pejman Zare, as well as Mina Zare, Mahshid Zare, Mahboubeh Zare and Parham Zare, in the Iranian city of Shiraz.


The simultaneous raids resulted in the confiscation of mobile phones, computers, books, images and materials related to the Baha’i faith, personal documents, passports, identity documents, a hard drive, gold and an amount of foreign currency.


Mina, Mahshid, Mahboubeh, Pejman and Parham Zare are reported to be siblings. Documents relating to Pejman Zare’s legal proceedings, along with a report prepared by the Forensic Medicine Organisation, were also reportedly confiscated.


Nazanin Nikouseresht, Mina, Mahshid, Mahboubeh and Parham Zare were summoned to the detention centre known as “Plaque 100”, which is affiliated with the Shiraz Intelligence Department.


Pejman Zare was detained by Shiraz Intelligence Department officers in March 2026 and informed of the charges against him following his detention. He was released on bail from Adelabad Central Prison in August 2026. Security forces reportedly also seized documents used in the legal proceedings concerning his previous detention during the latest raid.

title: Ask the Kurds
content:
We have written before about peace, arguing that silencing guns alone does not amount to peace. A conflict may end without truth, justice, memory, trust and social participation, but peace cannot take root in society. Much has already been said and written around this idea.


Today, we need to take the discussion one step further. The Kurdish question is no longer simply about ending the conflict; we are discussing a transformation that will determine the nature of the future political relationship. Regimes are being transformed, organisational structures are changing, paradigms are being redefined, and concepts such as “democratic integration”, “democratic society”, the “Democratic Republic” and the possibilities of a new form of coexistence are being discussed. None of this can be underestimated.


The establishment of a negotiating table, the possibility of ending the armed conflict and the opportunities this could create not only in Turkey but also in other parts of Kurdistan are of historic importance. We are therefore conscious of the context in which every critical word we say about the process is received. The issue is not to diminish the value of the negotiating table, but to discuss how a peace can be built that does justice to the weight of such a history.


The need for negotiations, indeed their inevitability, does not arise solely from today’s political circumstances. There is a history that has brought us to this point, and a heavy price that has been paid along the way. That price does not predetermine the outcome, but it makes it impossible not to question whether the outcome is sufficient.


Integration: into whom and what?


One of the most widely used and debated concepts today is “democratic integration”. It is repeatedly stressed that this does not mean assimilation, surrender or the unconditional incorporation of Kurds into the existing order, but rather a new democratic relationship based on equality and voluntary participation, one that transforms both sides.


This distinction matters. Precisely for that reason, however, the concept needs to be reconsidered in light of historical reality.


The relationship between Kurds and the state did not begin today. Kurds have been citizens, civil servants, soldiers, workers, teachers, senators, MPs, ministers and administrators of this state. They have been present in every sphere of Turkey’s economic, social and political life. The fundamental problem of the Kurdish question, therefore, has never simply been that Kurds have failed to “integrate” into the state.


Perhaps the question needs to be reversed: How many times have these people tried to integrate, to become part of the whole?


People were displaced, driven from their villages to the cities and forced to rebuild their lives. They studied in state schools, worked in state institutions and served in its army. Yet despite all this, the Kurdish question did not disappear. Institutional integration and political equality are not the same thing.


Here lies one of Turkey’s historical paradoxes: a Kurdish individual may be incorporated into the system, while Kurdish identity as a political subject can come up against the limits of that same system. The question is not how Kurds should be incorporated into the system, but how a system in which they already live must change in response to their collective existence.


If the state is to establish a relationship of equality with Kurds, it must first acknowledge this: for the past century, it is not the Kurds who have failed to establish such a relationship, but the state itself.


Where does Kurdistan stand in all this?


This brings us to a more difficult question. As such a far-reaching transformation concerning the future of the Kurds is being discussed, where does the reality of Kurdistan stand within this new relationship? Recognising the existence of Kurds is not the same as recognising the question of Kurdistan as a political issue.


This is also what we meant when we previously said, “Turkey cannot democratise unless Kurdistan is free.” We were not referring to a single predetermined model of statehood. Nor does freedom have to be reduced to an independent state, federation or any other ready-made model. The more fundamental issue is whether the collective existence of the Kurds and their right to envision their own future can extend beyond the boundaries drawn by the state.


A significant part of Turkey’s authoritarian state tradition has …

title: Kurdish Women’s Platform: Kurdish must be constitutionally protected
content:
The European Kurdish Women’s National Unity Platform issued a statement on the right to mother-tongue education in Kurdish and the protection of the rights of the Kurdish people in Rojava and Syria.


The statement stressed that language is a fundamental human right and that mother-tongue education is essential to preserving identity and culture, saying: “As the European Kurdish Women’s National Unity Platform, we stress that the Kurdish people’s right to learn Kurdish and receive education in their mother tongue is a fundamental right that must be guaranteed constitutionally and legally.


We also strongly condemn all attacks against and targeting of the Kurdish people. In particular, we condemn the brutal martyrdom of Martyr Sîpan, a member of the Ministry of Defence, by members of the Baggara tribe.


We extend our condolences to his family and friends and demand an independent and transparent investigation into the incident. Everyone found responsible must be held accountable under the law, regardless of their affiliation or identity. To preserve social peace and relations among the different components of society, we also call for individual crimes not to be attributed to entire tribes or groups.”


Learning, teaching and using Kurdish must be guaranteed


The Kurdish Women’s National Unity Platform listed its demands for guaranteeing language and education rights as follows:


“The right to education in Kurdish must be guaranteed at all levels of education, and the necessary conditions must be provided, including teachers, curricula and textbooks.


Kurdish must be taught in schools as a compulsory second language for all students, alongside other languages taught within the education system.


The right to the Kurdish language must be explicitly guaranteed in the constitution, and the right to teach, learn and use Kurdish must be protected.


All citizens must have the right to security, dignity and equal citizenship, regardless of national, linguistic or cultural differences, and must be protected against all forms of targeting and discrimination.


We believe that recognising linguistic and national rights does not disregard the rights of other components of society. On the contrary, it forms the basis of equal citizenship, respect for diversity and the creation of a more just and cohesive society.


Our Platform therefore calls on all political and social forces, educational institutions and human rights organisations to support these demands and work to ensure that the right to education in Kurdish becomes a constitutionally and legally guaranteed right and that the rights of all components of society are protected without discrimination.


Language, education and identity are rights; security and dignity are the rights of every citizen. Guaranteeing these rights is the foundation for building a society based on equality, justice and respect for diversity.”

title: The doors of Imralı must be opened to all
content:
The issue that is currently generating the most interest in Turkey is where the Peace and Democratic Society process, which is being negotiated in Imralı, will lead. It seems as though the process has been slowed down. Some say that the pace of the process is tied to the elections. If such an important issue is being handled according to electoral calculations, this would be the greatest disservice that could be done to Turkey. No political force should approach a problem that is a century old and that will determine Turkey’s future through the calculations of an election.


Government spokespeople say that the process is proceeding as planned. But the actions on the ground do not appear to reflect this. An important party to this process is the Kurdish leader Abdullah Öcalan. However, the fact that this leader, who is expected to play a role in advancing the process, has not been given conditions in which he can work freely raises questions about the government’s approach to the process. The rhetoric and the practice are not aligned. The Kurdish people and pro-democracy forces want this leadership to be able to operate freely. It is expected that he should be able to meet with journalists, politicians, and intellectuals and present his views openly to the public. But none of this is happening. After the law was passed, AKP parliamentary group deputy chair Abdullah Güler said that Abdullah Öcalan would henceforth be able to meet with journalists, politicians, and certain sections of society. Yet nearly two months have passed without any such step being taken. Such an implementation depends on a decision by the Ministry of Justice. If it is not happening, responsibility lies with the AKP government, foremost with the president.


This process concerns the Kurdish question, a century-old problem in Turkey. The objections and resistance that emerged over this century developed against policies of denial and cultural genocide directed at the Kurds. Kurds were denied their existence and subjected to efforts to forcibly assimilate them into Turkish identity. The 53-year-long Apocu and PKK resistance emerged as a revolt against this policy. Armed struggle arose as a consequence of a century of misguided policies. To portray the current process simply as a process of disarmament, rather than seeing it as a process of political participation and a democratic resolution of the Kurdish question, is to distort reality. Approaching the process in this way would mean continuing a century-old mentality and policy. It would amount to insisting on not changing that mentality and policy.


Presenting this process to Turkish society merely as disarmament would, above all, harm the AKP government itself. Özgür Özel, when he was chairman of the CHP, said that this process concerned the Kurdish question. In fact, when the relevant law was passed, speeches delivered in Parliament made clear that the issue was the Kurdish question and that it would be resolved through democratization. If Parliament is regarded as the place where the people of Turkey are represented, then why is the position expressed in Parliament being ignored?


If this issue is viewed solely as disarmament, the guerrillas may not lay down their arms. If laws are not enacted to allow democratic politics to be conducted freely, and if such a legal and political environment is not created, what motivation could persuade the guerrillas to lay down their arms? Can the government and the media, which constantly portray the process as one of disarmament, not see this? The Kurdish Freedom Movement has declared that it has ended its armed struggle against Turkey. They have stated that they will disarm, return to Turkey, and pursue their struggle in the democratic political arena. It is difficult to understand why the Turkish state is not taking the steps necessary to make this possible.


Everyone in Turkey speaks of the need for democratization. Shouldn't steps toward democratization be taken that would bring an end to this century-old problem and open the way forward for Turkey? This is not only an urgent necessity for resolving the Kurdish question; it is also an urgent necessity for Turkey itself. Turkey has, in fact, now seized this opportunity. Being a politician and loving Turkey requires making use of this opportunity. From now on, the measure of loving Turkey is the taking of democratic steps. Otherwise, claiming to love Turkey and calling oneself a patriot would amount …

title: Dilbahar: Ji pêşdibistanê heta zanîngehê perwerdeya bi Kurdî pêkan e
content:
Hevberdevka Komîsyonê Heval Dilbahar di axaftina xwe ya ji bo Ajansa Mezopotamyayê de destnîşan kir ku divê dewlet astengiyên yasayî yên li pêşiya bikaranîna zimanê Kurdî rake û ji bo Kurdî statuya fermî were dayîn.


DEM Partî: Mafê perwerdehiya bi zimanê dayîkê nas bikin


14 Îlon 2026


“Divê Kurdî statuya fermî bi dest bixe”


Dilbahar got ku azadiya Kurdî û hemû zimanên din divê di Destûra Bingehîn de were misoger kirin:


“Şêweyê vê statuyê dikare bibe mijara nîqaşê, lê girîng e ku Kurdî, zimanê bi milyonan Kurdan, xwediyê statuyeke fermî be."


Li gorî Dilbahar, ji bo parastina zimanê Kurdî û gihandina wî heta nifşên pêşerojê, Kurdî divê bibe zimanê perwerdeyê.


Wê her wiha bang kir ku navên cihan û têgehên ku bi eslê xwe Kurdî ne, lê di pêvajoya dîrokî de hatine Tirkîkirin, werin vegerandin forma xwe ya Kurdî.


Nebûna perwerdehiya bi zimanê zikmakî dibe sedema fobîya dibistanê


20 Çile 2025


Dilbahar got divê astengiyên li pêşiya bikaranîna Kurdî di saziyên fermî û hemû warên jiyana civakî de werin rakirin. Li gorî wê, çavkaniyên darayî û sazîbûnê yên ku ji bo Tirkî tên veqetandin, divê ji bo Kurdî jî bên dabînkirin.


“Zazakî di bin metirsiya windabûnê de ye”


Dilbahar bal kişand ser rewşa Zazakî (Kirmanckî) û got ku ev ziman nîşan dide ku Kurdî hîn jî di bin metirsiyê de ye.


Wê bi referansa daneyên UNESCOyê got ku zaravayê Kirmanckî yê Kurdî di nav zimanên ku bi metirsiya windabûn û nemanê re rû bi rû ne de cih digire.


Bi milyonan zarokên Kurd îsal jî ji perwerdehiya zimanê dayikê bêpar man


9 Îlon 2025


Dilbahar got ku li gelek welatên cîhanê modelên perwerdeya pirzimanî tên sepandin û wek mînak Swîsre û Swêdê nîşan da:


“Li gelek welatan modelên perwerdeya pirzimanî ji dibistana seretayî heta zanîngehê tên sepandin. Çima tiştekî ku li wan welatan pêkan e li Bakurê Kurdistanê û Tirkiyeyê jî pêkan nebe?”


Her wiha Dilbahar got ku heke dewlet îrade û niyeta xwe nîşan bide, binesaziya perwerdeya bi zimanê Kurdî dikare di nava 2-3 salan de were avakirin.


Li gorî Dilbahar, astengiyên teknîkî an kêmbûna çavkaniyan ne sedem in ku perwerdeya bi Kurdî ne pêkan be. Dilbahar dibêje tiştê ku li vir girîng e, avakirina niyetê û naskirina mafê gelê Kurd ê wergirtina perwerdeya bi zimanê Kurdî ye.

author: Unknown
title: Rote Hilfe gewinnt nach Kündigung ihres Bankkontos auch vor dem OLG
content:
Ein weiterer Sieg für die Rote Hilfe und zugleich eine bemerkenswerte Entscheidung darüber, dass politische Entscheidungen der USA in Deutschland von den Gerichten nicht widerspruchslos akzeptiert werden. Rechtsanwalt Dr. Jasper Prigge, der die Rote Hilfe vor Gericht vertreten hat, erklärt nach Bekanntwerden der Entscheidung „Die Rote Hilfe hat sich nichts zuschulden kommen lassen. Die Kündigung des Kontos hat zu großer Verunsicherung bei zivilgesellschaftlichen Organisationen geführt“, aber das Oberlandesgericht (OLG) habe, so Prigge weiter, „willkürlichen Kontenkündigungen eine klare Grenze“ aufgezeigt.


Sparkasse Göttingen kündigt Konto


Die

Sparkasse Göttingen kündigte

 im vergangenen Jahr der linken Rechtshilfeorganisation Rote Hilfe das dort seit vielen Jahren geführte Konto. Auch die GLS-Bank hatte ähnliches versucht, dort konnte aber zivilgesellschaftlicher Protest die Bank

zu einem Umdenken bewegen

. Im Fall der Sparkasse musste die Rote Hilfe vor Gericht ziehen. Anfang dieses Jahres

verpflichtet das Landgericht

 die Sparkasse, bis zur Entscheidung im Hauptsacheverfahren, welches einige Jahre in Anspruch nehmen kann, Das Konto fortzuführen. Hiergegen legte die Sparkasse Berufung zum OLG ein.


Wieso hatte die Göttinger Sparkasse der Roten Hilfe überhaupt gekündigt?


Die Begründung war zunächst ziemlich allgemein gehalten: Man wolle den „gesetzlichen und vertraglichen Modalitäten Genüge“ tun. Tatsächlich war der antifaschistische Rechtshilfeverein jedoch bereits seit 2015 als sogenanntes höheres Risiko eingestuft und seine Kontobewegungen wurden monatlich kontrolliert, da er vom Verfassungsschutz als „linksextrem“ eingestuft wird.


Die Kündigung des Kontos hatte mit den USA zu tun, denn das dortige Außenministerium setze „Antifa Ost“ auf eine

Liste von ausländischen Terrororganisationen

. „Antifa-Ost“ als solche gibt es nicht. Sondern es wird ein Verfahren gegen eine Gruppe, meist junger Antifaschist:innen denen zur Last gelegt wird, Neonazis körperlich attackiert zu haben als „Antifa-Ost-Verfahren“ bezeichnet. Deutschland und die Europäische Union übernahmen die Einstufung der USA im übrigen nicht.


Die Rote Hilfe hatte mehrfach um Spenden geworben für die Deckung von Anwaltskosten auch im sogenannten „Antifa-Ost“-Verfahren. Das führte nach Angaben der Sparkasse zu einem angeblich weiter erhöhten Kontrollaufwand. Aus den zuvor monatlichen Kontrollen sei eine werktägliche Überprüfung der Kontobewegungen geworden.


Die Rote Hilfe hatte nie behauptet, eine Organisation namens „Antifa Ost“ finanziell unterstützen zu wollen. Ihr Spendenaufruf bezog sich auf das „Antifa-Ost-Verfahren“. Also auf Menschen, gegen die in diesem Zusammenhang Strafverfahren geführt wurden und werden. Es ging um die Finanzierung deren anwaltliche Vertretung um ein möglichst faires Verfahren zu gewährleisten.


OLG weist Berufung der Sparkasse zurück!


Am 17. September hat das

OLG Braunschweig

 nunmehr die Berufung der Sparkasse Göttingen zurückgewiesen. Die Sparkasse muss somit vorerst das Konto der Roten Hilfe weiterführen.


Das OLG Braunschweig hat diese Unterscheidung jetzt ausdrücklich anerkannt und aufgegriffen. Aus den Spendenaufrufen lasse sich gerade nicht ableiten, dass die Rote Hilfe die „Antifa Ost“ als solche bei Straftaten unterstützen wolle. Es gehe vielmehr darum, einzelnen Beschuldigten und Angeklagten ein faires und menschenwürdiges Verfahren zu ermöglichen. Der Schluss, damit würden mögliche terroristische Aktivitäten unterstützt, sei nicht plausibel, so das OLG.


Auch habe die Sparkasse nicht nachvollziehbar darzulegen vermocht, warum sich das bereits seit 2015 bestehende höhere Risiko im Dezember 2025 noch einmal so erheblich erhöht haben sollte, dass plötzlich eine werktägliche Kontrolle aller Kontobewegungen notwendig geworden sei.


Rote Hilfe äußert sich zu ihrem gerichtlichen Erfolg


Der

Pressesprecher des Bundesvorstand der Roten Hilfe e. V

., Hartmut Brückner, deutete die Entscheidung des OLG als „ein Zeichen der Justiz gegen versteckte Angriffe auf die Zivilgesellschaft, die von der US-Regierung ausgehen. Aufsichtsbehörden wie auch Banken dürfen nicht der Trump-Regierung vorauseilend Gehorsam leisten.“


Wie das Hauptsacheverfahren ausgehen wird, das bleibt abzuwarten.

title: Diskussionsveranstaltung: Ulm5, Daniela Klette, Antifa gegen Krise, Krieg und Repression.
content:
U l m 5, D a n i e l a K l e t t e, A n t i f a,


gegen


Krise, Krieg und Repression.


Diskussionsveranstaltung mit Angehörigen, Freund*innen und Aktivist*innen


von den Schauprozessen.


7. November 2026, im Volkshaus Zürich.


Einlass 18:30 Uhr, Beginn pünktlich um 19 Uhr!


Die zahlreichen Demonstrationen und Aktionen gegen die Kriegsvorbereitung in Europa und gegen den Völkermord in Gaza, haben die Strafverfolgungsbehörden auf den Plan gerufen. Sie wollen verhindern, dass der Funke der Streitigkeiten auf die Mehrheit der Bevölkerung überspringt. In der angespannten Lage des Ukrainekrieges und Genozid in Palästina sind sie dabei, jedes menschliche Verhalten, jede Meinungsäusserung und Kritik gegen ihre Kriege und Völkermorde zu ersticken oder zu brechen. Und für immer hinter dicken Betonmauern in den Knästen zum Schweigen zu bringen und verschwinden zu lassen.


Für den Profit der Superreichen sollen wir Arbeiter*innen, marginal und prekär Beschäftigte Waffen produzieren und transportieren. Letztendlich sollen wir als Kanonenfutter gegen unseresgleichen an der Front für die Kapitalisten verheizt werden. "Macht den imperialen Krieg zum sozialen Krieg. Wir schießen nicht auf Arbeiter und Arbeiterinnen." (Rheinmetall entwaffnen) Überall werden die Staatsausgaben im Namen der Kriegsvorbereitungen radikal gekürzt und die Rüstungsausgaben massiv erhöht. Das setzt immer mehr Menschen in ihrem Alltag unter Druck und treibt ganze Bevölkerungsschichten in die Armut. Die soziale und polizeiliche Repression bildet die Grundlage dafür. Die westlichen Demokratien verwandeln sich zusehends in eine Diktatur.


Doch wenn wir so machtlos wären und scheinbar nichts erreichen könnten, warum müssen sie ihre ganze Repressionsmaschine gegen uns in Stellung bringen und die Gesetze gegen uns verschärfen? Wieso werden Menschen, die für ein anderes als das von Konkurrenz und Gewinnmaximierung diktierte Leben einstehen, kriminalisiert? Weshalb werden jene die sich ihren Kriegen verweigern und somit die Zustimmung der Gesellschaft für die Völkermorde ins Wanken bringen, als innerer Feinde bekämpft? Warum befürchten sie, das Zusammenkommen der sozialen- und antimilitaristischen Proteste, der weltweiten Palästina Bewegung, der Antifaschist*innen und Klimaaktivist*innen und so weiter? Wir finden es wichtig, die massiven Angriffe gegen uns in einen Kontext zu stellen, um uns gemeinsam dagegen wehren zu können, was letztendlich ihre Pläne zum Scheitern zu bringen wird.


Unser Ziel ist es, mit den Gefangenen, den Angehörigen, den Verwandten und Freunde und die, die sich mutig der Repression und den Kriegen entgegenstellen zu zeigen, dass die Gemeinsamkeiten für uns zum Überleben wichtiger sind, als ständig das Trennende zu betonen! Gegenöffentlichkeit und Widerstand sind insbesondere für den Schutz unserer Gefangenen sowie auch für uns notwendig. Das stärkt uns alle, wenn Aktivitäten in dem Bewusstsein weitergehen, dass niemand draussen und in den Knästen allein gelassen wird. Darin verliert sich auch die Angst vor der Repression, wenn wir zusammenhalten und für eine emanzipierte von Patriarchat befreite Gesellschaft gegen NATO, Staat und Kapital kämpfen. Dazu wollen wir uns aufeinander beziehen, Genozide und Kriege stoppen und die Einstellung der politischen Verfahren, Zeugenvorladungen und Sanktion erstreiten.


Mit der Veranstaltung möchten wir unterschiedliche Menschen zusammenbringen, uns austauschen, Erfahrungen teilen, vernetzen und herausfinden, wie wir der zunehmenden Repression und Kriegsvorbereitung gemeinsam begegnen können. Dazu haben wir Angehörige, Freund*innen und Aktivist*innen von den Schauprozessen gegen die «Ulm5», den Prozess gegen Daniela Klette und den Deutschen Antifa-Verfahren sowie der repressiven Entwicklung aus der Schweiz eingeladen.


Crow, Daniel, Leandra, Zo und Vi befinden sich seit ihrer Aktion gegen Elbit Systems Deutschland im September 2025 immer noch in Untersuchungshaft. Während die Kriegsverbrecher gegen die Menschlichkeit frei herumlaufen, ihre Völkermorde ungestraft fortsetzen können und unverhohlen mit der Auslöschung ganzer Völker drohen. Im Knast und im laufenden Prozess sind die „Ulm5“ mit massiven Menschenrechtsverletzungen konfrontiert. Diese jungen Menschen aus verschiedenen europäischen Staaten, die sich entschlossen gegen den Genozid eingesetzt haben, stehen heute in Stuttgart Stammheim vor Gericht und sollen in einem Schauprozess zur Abschreckung aller, zu langen Haftstrafen verurteilt …

author: Gartencoop
title: Rote Bete
content:
Von der Erde in den Keller. Und von dort auf unsere Teller.


Rote-Bete-Ernte bei der Gartencoop! Erst die Knollen von Hand aus der Erde ziehen, dann wandert Kiste für Kiste schließlich in den Keller, wo die Rote Bete gut gelagert auf die kommenden Monate wartet.


Solawi heißt: Wir teilen nicht nur die Ernte, sondern auch die Arbeit und Verantwortung, die dahintersteckt. Wir erleben, wo unser Essen wächst, packen mit an und sorgen gemeinsam dafür, dass auch im Winter Gemüse aus regionalem Anbau auf den Tellern landet.


Lust bekommen, Teil davon zu sein? Bei der Gartencoop kannst du saisonales Gemüse aus samenfesten Sorten genießen, eine lebendige Gemeinschaft erleben. Ernährungswende ist Handarbeit.


Werde Teil davon und unterstütze den Aufbau unseres neues Hofs in Schallstadt-Mengen mit einem Direktkredit. Hier online Fragebogen ausfüllen:

https://gartencoop.org/direktkredit_fragebogen

author: Gartencoop
title: Kartoffelernte
content:
2025 war für uns ein gutes Kartoffeljahr und das ist in Zeiten von Wetterextremen alles andere als selbstverständlich. Zu viel Regen oder Trockenheit bedeuten schnell Krankheiten und Ernteeinbußen.


Deshalb setzen wir auf samenfeste Sorten und Vielfalt. Unsere Kartoffelsorten Laura, Karelia oder Otolia sind nicht nur robust, sondern richtig lecker - und bringen uns durch den Winter.


Mit kleinem Roder und Mitglieder-Power ernten, sortieren und lagern wir die Kartoffeln. Einfache Technik, viele Hände, große Wirkung.


Gemeinsam anpacken, Verantwortung teilen und gute Lebensmittel für alle - das ist #Solawi.


Unsere Lagerbedingungen sind suboptimal. Wir müssen viel in den Erdkeller schleppen. Darum wollen wir auf einer eigenen Hofstelle bessere Infrastruktur schaffen, die uns die Arbeit erleichtert.


Mach mit in unserer Solawi oder unterstütze unseren Hofkauf mit einer Spende oder einem Direktkredit.


Hier online Fragebogen ausfüllen:

https://gartencoop.org/direktkredit_fragebogen

title: Li Turgutluyê êrîşa bi çekê: Xwendekarekî jiyana xwe ji dest da
content:
Li navçeya Turgutlu ya Manîsayê, vê sibehê saet li dor 07.59an li nêzî Lîseya Sanayî û Teknolojiyê ya Înci Uzmezê êrîşeke bi çekê pêk hat.


Li Mereşê di dibistanekê de êrişa biçekê çêbû: 9 kes mirin


15 Nîsan 2026


Li gorî daxuyaniya Walîtiya Manîsayê, êrîşkar hat girtin û di bûyerê de bi giştî 8 kes bandor bûn ku birîndar ji bo dermankirinê rakirin nexweşxaneyan.


Derbarê bûyerê de lêpirsîna edlî û îdarî hate destpêkirin.


Serekê Şaredariya Turgutluyê Çetîn Akın beriya daxuyaniya walîtiyê diyar kiribû ku di êrîşê de xwendekarekî jiyana xwe ji dest daye û 4 xwendekar jî birîndar bûne.


Çar roj berê tevdîrên ewlehiya dibistanan hatibûn ragihandin


Walîtiya Manîsayê li hember gefên ewlehiyê tevdîrên nû ragihandibûn. Walîtiyê di 18ê Êlûnê de daxuyandibû ku ji bo sala perwerdehiyê ya 2026-2027an li 507 dibistanan 531 karmendên baxçeyan û di saetên ketin û derketinê de jî di 59 tîman de 118 personel dê wezîfedar bibin.


Her wiha roja beriya êrîşê bi beşdariya Wezîrê Karên Navxweyî Mustafa Çiftçi û Wezîrê Perwerdehiya Neteweyî Yusuf Tekin civîna "Ewlehiya Dibistanan" hatibû çêkirin û tevdîrên bo zarokan hatibûn gotûbêjkirin.


Mijara ewlehiya dibistanan li Tirkiyeyê, piştî êrîşên meha Nîsanê yên li Sêvereka Ruhayê û li Mereşê dîsa ketibû rojevê.

author: Gabriel Barros
title: O clã dos Cury
content:
Investigamos o que importa para os brasileiros além do que passa na campanha eleitoral. Leia mais reportagens como essa clicando

aqui

.


O candidato à Presidência da República Augusto Cury (Avante – SP), até poucos meses mais conhecido pelos seus milhões de livros

best-sellers

 de autoajuda, saltou de um nome com baixas intenções de voto até meados de agosto para cerca de 7% do eleitorado, segundo a

pesquisa Quaest

, de 14 de setembro.


Cury se apresenta como um intelectual, alguém culto e fora da política, capaz de resolver os problemas mais complexos com inteligência emocional e uma gestão tecnocrata. Na urna, seu nome consta como “Escritor Augusto Cury”. Ele reforça o fato de ser médico, e até usa o sobrenome para fazer um trocadilho com “cura” em seu slogan “O Brasil tem cura”.


Mas, além da candidatura que hoje ocupa o terceiro lugar nas intenções de voto para presidente, Cury tem um verdadeiro clã familiar na política, e que vem dominando ao menos dois municípios no interior paulista.

A família conta com um sobrinho e um primo que concorrem neste ano, outro sobrinho eleito em 2024, dois irmãos que foram vereadores e um patriarca que entrou na família na época da ditadura, pelo Arena.


Por que isso importa?


A rede familiar do escritor Augusto Cury está há décadas ocupando cargos políticos no interior paulista, o que contradiz a visão de que o candidato é um outsider na disputa política


Sobrinhos consolidam nova geração no reduto político dos Cury


O sobrinho mais velho de Cury, Daniel Augusto Cury (Avante – SP), 47 anos, é um antigo conhecido do eleitor de Colina, no interior paulista

, reduto político da família. Sócio na empresa Semear Gestão em Agronegócio Ltda, uma distribuidora de produtos agropecuários, Daniel concorreu pela primeira vez em 2016, sendo eleito vereador pelo PDT na cidade.


Daniel é apoiado por Augusto Cury para o cargo de deputado federal na cidade de Colina e se define como “representante do agro” em suas redes


Desde então, Daniel tentou cargos em todas as eleições seguintes, perdendo em quase todos. Primeiro foi a tentativa de chegar à prefeitura, pelo PSB em 2020, depois, tentou ser deputado federal pelo mesmo partido em 2022, quando terminou como suplente. Em 2024, repetiu o resultado, ficando em segundo lugar na disputa pela prefeitura de Colina.


Agora, em 2026, Daniel tenta novamente uma vaga na Câmara dos Deputados, mas dessa vez pelo Avante, partido adotado por seu tio, candidato ao Planalto.

 Ele recebeu R$ 34 mil da direção do partido via fundo especial para a campanha.


Neste ano, o candidato não declarou bens ao Tribunal Superior Eleitoral, ao contrário de outras campanhas. Ele registrou R$ 46 mil em 2020 — e apenas R$ 5 mil em 2024.


A reportagem questionou Daniel sobre não ter declarado bens em 2026, que não respondeu.


Enquanto isso, seu irmão mais novo e também sobrinho de Augusto Cury,

o corretor de imóveis Rafael Cury (PSB – SP), de 42 anos, que já havia ficado como suplente em 2016, garantiu a continuidade da família no Legislativo

, sendo eleito vereador em Colina em 2020 e reeleito em 2024 pelo PSB.


Rafael declarou um patrimônio de R$ 12 mil em 2016, R$ 3,9 mil em 2020 e R$ 155 mil em 2024. A maior parte deste dinheiro, R$ 120 mil, seria o valor de um carro em posse do vereador.


O primo e a campanha de marketing do escritor


A 18 km de distância de Colina, em Barretos, a família tem outro candidato: Caio Cury (Avante – SP), 35 anos, é agricultor e disputa sua primeira eleição, concorrendo a deputado estadual. Com o nome de batismo Curi, com “I”, Caio é filho de uma prima em primeiro grau de Augusto Cury, mas nas redes sociais apresenta proximidade com o presidenciável.


Em seu Instagram, Caio Cury (esq), se apresenta com o “mesmo propósito” que o candidato à presidência da República, Augusto Cury


O sobrenome, de cara, garantiu um privilégio partidário: um número em sequência, que normalmente é disputado entre os candidatos pela facilidade de memorização para o eleitor.


Caio é o candidato da família mais ativo nas redes sociais, postando vídeos com Augusto Cury, que acompanha em agendas, e fazendo campanha ativa para o “tio”

, com memes em que o escritor ultrapassa outros nomes da direita na disputa pelo terceiro lugar, como Ronaldo Caiado (PSD), Romeu Zema (Novo) e Renan Santos (Missão).


Apesar de constar como sócio nas empresas Cury Moura Serviços em Engenharia, Cury Moura Educação Comércio de Livros e Fort Polpas e Frutas …

author: cnt.es
title: 24 de septiembre. Presentación del libro ‘Crónicas de la barbarie’ en la FAL
content:
El jueves, 24 de septiembre, se presentará el libro Crónicas de la Barbarie. Será en la sede de la FAL en Madrid, a las 18:30, y contaremos con la presencia de su autor, Antonio Somoza.


Os dejamos con la sinopsis del libro:


En estas Crónicas de la Barbarie, donde se unen magistralmente la investigación periodística con la memoria y con la historia, presenta el autor cómo fue y qué consecuencias tuvo la represión de la dictadura franquista. En ellas aborda asuntos de especial importancia, tales como la justicia al revés, la siembra del terror, el robo de bebés, el adoctrinamiento, la sumisión de las mujeres, el trabajo esclavo, la depuración del magisterio y mucho más. Confiesa que lo hace por compromiso con la verdad, que parece cuestionarse cada vez más, sin negar una intencionalidad didáctica por el deber moral hacia los más jóvenes para explicarles cómo se comportan las dictaduras en general y cómo lo hizo la de Franco en particular.

Pour un internet militant et autonome #2

Évènement de soutien à un internet militant & autonome - 12 septembre 18h30 à la Kunda

Retrouvons-nous samedi 12 septembre à 18h30 à la Kunda (46-48 rue Jules Lagaisse, Vitry-sur-Seine pour une discussion, une projection et une cantine en soutien à un internet militant & autonome.


Autistici/Inventati met fin à ses activités de services internet libres et autonomes


 |&nbsp21 septembre


Fin de Autistici et de Noblogs : Le néofascisme américain et ses alliés détruisent des outils de libre expression ajout de la modé : Pour les personnes qui utilisent le service mail austiciti.org pour (…)


La discussion a permis d'établir un premier contact entre des personnes dont les capacités techniques ou les objectifs pouvaient différer mais qui étaient réunies autour d'un principe : empêcher l'État de contrôler l'internet et sensibiliser les gens aux dangers que cela implique. Les échanges pendant la discussion puis pendant la suite de l'évènement ont permis de faire émerger plusieurs sujets : quels outils et pratiques pour se défendre contre la surveillance, comment transmettre le savoir technique de manière efficace, horizontale et autonome mais aussi des questions plus générales comme notre rapport à la technologie au sein de la société.


Pour des raisons évidentes, quelques heures n'ont pas suffi à élaborer des réponses satisfaisantes. Il a donc été décidé de re proposer un évènement public deux semaines après pour prolonger et étendre ces réflexions

 

!


Retrouvons-nous à la Générale, 39 rue Gassendi 75014 Paris, le dimanche 27 septembre à 14h.


Au programme : discussions, infokiosque, apéro partagé et sérigraphie à prix libre ... et surtout venez avec vos propositions

title: Rencontre-débat | Gestion de l'eau | F. Benoit et N. Celnik « Les Assoiffeurs » | Sylvain Barone « L'eau, une affaire d'Etat »
content:
La Librairie Publico organise un débat autour de deux ouvrages :


 Les Assoiffeurs. Enquête sur ces entreprises qui accaparent notre eau

 L'eau, une affaire d'État


Avec


 Fabien Benoit, journaliste et auteur-réalisateur de films documentaires

 Nicolas Celnik, journaliste indépendant

 Sylvain Barone, chercheur en sciences politiques à

INRAE


La Librairie Publico organise un débat autour de deux ouvrages :


 Les Assoiffeurs. Enquête sur ces entreprises qui accaparent notre eau


Le 25 mars 2023, à Sainte-Soline, un déluge de grenades s'abat sur les manifestants. Plusieurs personnes restent à terre. Deux tombent dans le coma.


Fabien Benoit et Nicolas Celnik livrent ici les résultats d'une enquête, menée sur plus de deux ans, sur ces entreprises qui ont fait main basse sur l'eau, ces «

 

assoiffeurs

 

» qui ont privatisé ce bien commun et prévoient désormais de tirer profit de la pénurie qui s'annonce, avec le soutien de l'État. Cet ouvrage entend mettre à jour les stratégies et plans pensés par ces entreprises pour accroître encore leur emprise en faisant appel au solutionnisme technologique, qui nous enserre collectivement et nous empêche d'enclencher une véritable discussion politique et démocratique sur le partage de l'eau.

 L'eau, une affaire d'État


Fin mars 2023, quelques mois après la sécheresse historique de 2022, le président de la République Emmanuel Macron annonce un «

 

plan Eau

 

», dont les mesures traduisent une timide prise de conscience des effets du changement climatique. Au cours des trente dernières années, la gestion de l'eau avait pourtant reçu des moyens importants pour préserver ou restaurer les cours d'eau, les zones humides et la biodiversité des milieux aquatiques. Ce processus d'écologisation fait désormais face à des régressions délibérées, actées au sommet de l'État : un véritable renoncement écologique.

 Fabien Benoit est journaliste et auteur-réalisateur de films documentaires. Il a publié notamment The Valley. Une histoire politique de la Silicon Valley (Les Arènes, 2019) et réalisé The Last Town, une ville contre la Silicon Valley (Arte, 2023).

 Nicolas Celnik est journaliste indépendant et travaille pour Libération, Fracas, Reporterre et Le Monde. Il est l'auteur, avec Fabien Benoit, de Techno-luttes. Enquête sur ceux qui résistent à la technologie (Seuil, 2022), et de la bande dessinée Un grain de sable dans la machine (Le Passager clandestin, 2026) avec Juliette Brigand.

 Sylvain Barone est chercheur en sciences politiques à

INRAE

, au laboratoire G-Eau (Montpellier). Ses recherches portent sur l'action publique en matière d'environnement, notamment à travers la gestion de l'eau, l'adaptation aux risques littoraux, la politisation des questions climatiques et le traitement judiciaire des atteintes à la nature, en France et aux États-Unis.

title: Rencontre autour du livre « Nous ne serons plus des chaperons rouge »
content:
Rencontre avec Stéphanie Durdilly pour son livre «

 

Nous ne serons plus des chaperons rouges

 

», Passager clandestin le 26 septembre à 19H à la librairie Les jours heureux (Rosny sous Bois)


Pourquoi avons-nous peur d'occuper l'espace

 

?


Pendant un voyage seule à vélo, Stéphanie Durdilly était toujours aux aguets d'un éventuel danger - qui n'est pourtant jamais arrivé. Alors, elle s'est interrogée sur cette peur genrée, sa construction et ses conséquences très concrètes sur nos corps et nos vies.


D'où vient cette peur qui façonne nos gestes, entrave nos élans, restreint nos libertés

 

? A qui profite-t-elle

 

? Et surtout, comment la déconstruire, et riposter

 

?


Cet essai féministe entame des réponses à ces questions (et de multiples autres

 

!) aux croisements du récit et de la pensée critique. En partant d'une expérience partagée, l'autrice démonte les mécanismes qui assignent les femmes et les minorités de genre à la prudence, la retenue et l'effacement. En ouvrant cette brèche, elle nous invite à repenser la violence et à occuper l'espace.


On se retrouve à la librairie pour en discuter

 

!

title: Petrol fiyatları yeniden yükselişe geçti: Brent petrol 100 doların üzerinde
content:
Petrol fiyatları, son günlerdeki düşüşün ardından sınırlı yükseliş kaydetti. Yatırımcıların odağında, Birleşmiş Milletler Genel Kurulu kapsamında gerçekleşmesi beklenen ABD-İran görüşmelerine ilişkin gelişmeler bulunuyor.

Bloomberg HT'nin derlediği verilere göre Brent ham petrol yüzde 0,22 artışla varil başına 100,57 dolara yükseldi. ABD tipi ham petrolün (WTI) ekim vadeli kontratı ise yüzde 0,02 artarak 95,80 dolara çıktı.

İran’ın güvenlik yetkilisi Muhsin Rızai, Tahran’ın hafta sonu müzakerelere yeniden dönmek için arabuluculara şartlarını ilettiğini açıkladı.

Piyasa değerlendirmelerinde, ABD ile İran arasındaki diplomatik temaslarda belirgin bir ilerleme ya da gerileme yaşanana kadar petrol fiyatlarının belirli bir aralıkta hareket edebileceği ve gelişmelere duyarlı kalabileceği belirtiliyor.

Ortadoğu’daki gelişmeler de petrol piyasasının gündeminde. Yemen’deki Husiler, Riyad’a ve Yanbu’daki bir Saudi Aramco tesisine saldırı düzenlediklerini açıkladı. Husilerin ayrıca Suudi Arabistan destekli güçlerin Kızıldeniz kıyısına erişimini kesmeye yönelik faaliyetlerini artırdığı bildirildi.

Üç İranlı kaynağa göre Suudi Arabistan’ın Pekin’den yardım istemesinin ardından Çin, Tahran’a Husilerin saldırılarının sınırlandırılmasına yardımcı olması yönünde çağrıda bulundu.

Saudi Aramco ise Doğu-Batı Petrol Boru Hattı’na yönelik saldırıların ardından Yanbu üzerinden bazı sevkiyatları durdururken, Hürmüz Boğazı üzerinden yaptığı petrol ihracatını artırdı.

Tanker takip verilerine göre şirket, pazar günü Körfez’de yedi süpertankere yaklaşık 14 milyon varil ham petrol yükledi.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

title: Ephéméride des luttes : 22 septembre
content:
Le 22 septembre, l'éphéméride des luttes et les premières couleurs de l'automne comptent bien ne pas retomber dans l'hiver des luttes sociales, et elles s'y emploient de différentes manières. En provoquant de grandes émeutes pour se défendre contre les expulsions, par exemple.


1868 :

 A Puerto Rico est en cours un mouvement insurrectionnel, réprimé par l'armée espagnole.


1894 :

 En Italie, le gouvernement de Francesco Crispi décrète la dissolution de toutes les organisations anarchistes, socialistes (on parle des premières internationales, là) et ouvrières, avec le discours suivant déclamé quelques jours plus tôt à Naples : "

Aujourd'hui plus que jamais nous sentons la nécessité que les deux sociétés, civile et religieuse, soient d'accord pour reconduire le peuple dévoyé sur la voie de la justice et de l'amour. Des plus noirs recoins de la terre a surgi une secte infâme qui écrit sur son drapeau "Ni Dieu ni maître". Unissons-nous pour combattre ce monstre, et écrivons sur notre bannière : Avec Dieu, avec le Roi, pour la patrie

".


1919 :

 Aux États-Unis, début de la grande grève des aciéries : plus de 360.000 personnes arrêtent le travail.


1972 :

 Au Chili, le Président Allende nationalise la multinationale ITT, ce qui lui vaudra les foudres de la CIA et conduira entres autres au coup d'état militaire du

11 septembre

 1973, soutenu par les Etats-Unis.


1975 :

 - Aux Etats-Unis, le président Gerald Ford est victime d'une tentative d'assassinat de la part de Sara Jane Moore, qui est stoppée par un soldat avant de pouvoir frapper.


 En Irlande du Nord, l'IRA mène une série d'attaques à la bombe.


1977 :

 A Utrecht, le militant de la Fraction Armée Rouge (RAF) Knut Folkerts est arrêté après une fusillade avec la police néerlandaise. Il sera extradé vers la R.F.A.


1981 :

 A Berlin-Ouest, une grande opération de police a lieu pour faire évacuer huit maisons occupées d'un seul coup. D'énormes affrontements ont lieu à cette occasion, lors dequels un jeune autonome (Klaus-Jurgen Rattay) trouvera la mort. Ceci fera se répandre la révolte comme une traînée de poudre dans les autres grandes villes d'Allemagne : Stuttgart, Hambourg, Bremen, Fribourg, Francfort et Hanovre. A Berlin, 143 véhicules sont détruits et il y aura plus d'un million de dollars de dégâts. Des manifestations émeutières de soutien ont également lieu à Amsterdam, et la révolte se poursuit le jour suivant.


1989 :

 A Deal, dans le Kent en Angleterre, l'IRA fait sauter une bombe de forte puissance contre une caserne de l'armée britannique, tuant 11 soldats.


2000 :

 - A Cochabamba au Pérou, plus de 10.000 personnes manifestent contre la récente privatisation de la gestion et de la distribution d'eau.


 A Londres, des membres de l'IRA "véritable" ('real IRA') attaquent le centre des services secrets britanniques, le MI6, au lance-roquettes.


2017 :

 A Rennes, une voiture d'EDF

est incendiée

 en solidarité avec la lutte antinucléaire à Bure et contre les perquisitions et la répression qui vient de s'abattre sur les militant-e-s là-bas.


2018 :

 A Angers, une manifestation antifasciste a lieu contre les groupes d'extrême-droite de la ville, et débouche sur des affrontements avec la police et un départ d'incendie dans une succursale de la BNP Paribas.


Voir également

l'éphéméride anarchiste

 du 22 septembre.

title: Fon krizinin gölgesinde AKP'den SPK açıklaması: Görev ve yetkileri hatırlatıldı, sorumluluk Kurula havale edildi
content:
Sermaye piyasalarında patlak veren fon skandalları ve usulsüzlük soruşturmaları derinleşirken, AKP yaşanan krizlerin ortasında Sermaye Piyasası Kurulunun (SPK) görev ve yetkilerini hatırlatan bir açıklama yayımladı. Genel Başkan Yardımcısı Nihat Zeybekci'nin başında bulunduğu AKP Genel Merkez Ekonomi İşleri Başkanlığı tarafından yapılan paylaşımda, piyasadaki tahribatın ve şaibelerin gölgesinde SPK'nin denetim ve yaptırım gücüne vurgu yapıldı.

AKP Ekonomi İşleri Başkanlığının X hesabında yapılan açıklamada SPK; "Tasarrufları korumak", "Piyasalarda güven ile şeffaflığı sağlamakla" yükümlü idari ve mali özerkliğe sahip bir kurum olarak tanımlandı. Şirketlerin finansal raporlama süreçlerinin standartlara bağlandığı ve piyasa profesyonellerinin lisanslandığı ifade edilerek Kurulun düzenleyici rolü öne çıkarıldı.

Paylaşımın yaptırımlara ayrılan bölümünde, mevzuata aykırı hareket edenlere idari para cezası uygulanabileceği, faaliyetlerin durdurulabileceği ve yetki belgelerinin iptal edilebileceği kaydedildi. Piyasa fiyatlarını yapay olarak etkileyen manipülasyon eylemleri ile gizli şirket bilgileriyle haksız kazanç sağlayan içeriden öğrenenlerin ticaretine karşı doğrudan Cumhuriyet Başsavcılığına suç duyurusunda bulunulduğu belirtildi. Ayrıca şirketlerin halka arz ve borçlanma aracı ihraç taleplerini onaylama ya da reddetme yetkisinin SPK'de olduğu aktarıldı. Yapılan paylaşım şu şekilde:

İstanbul Cumhuriyet Başsavcılığı tarafından yürütülen soruşturmada, bazı portföy yönetim şirketlerine ait fonlarda "usulsüzlük" ve "manipülasyon" yapıldığı belirtilmişti. Sermaye Piyasası Kurulu (SPK), aralarında Tera, Hedef, Atlas ve A1 Portföy'ün de bulunduğu 7 şirkete ait 131 yatırım fonu için tasfiye kararı alarak alım satım işlemlerini durdurmuştu.

Şüphelilerin mal varlıklarının dondurulduğu, peş peşe gözaltı kararlarının alındığı ve milyonlarca liralık kayıpların yaşandığı vurgunun ardından, fon varlıklarının nakde çevrilerek yatırımcılara ödenmesi süreci Türkiye İş Bankası ve Ziraat Bankasına devredilmişti.

SPK, tasfiye sürecindeki yatırım fonlarına ilişkin usul ve esaslarda değişikliğe gitmişti. Kurul, daha önce 3 ay olarak uygulanan fon tasfiye süresini, piyasa koşulları ve portföy yapılarını gerekçe göstererek 6 aya çıkardı.
