Peut-être avez-vous entendu parler des « Fury room », ce nouveau loisir qui propose de vous enfermer dans une pièce dans laquelle vous pourrez vous défouler en cassant toutes sortes d'objets. Patrick Condé s'interroge ici sur ce que sont mais surtout

ne sont pas

 ces Fury room.


Je suis en retard d'au moins trois guerres. Je me demandais : pourquoi ne se passe -t-il plus rien ou presque dans ce pays, rien de significatif, d'engageant, de risqué, bref pas le moindre petit bout de soulèvement à hauteur ? Ce ne sont pourtant pas les raisons qui manquent. Mais les raisons… Justement je me disais que la raison a failli elle aussi, vaincue par le festival des pulsions (une nouvelle écriture de l'histoire des vaincus), ou encore qu'elle est entièrement dévorée par le légitimisme et le réformisme, « Mélenchon freine les luttes en inoculant l'espoir d'une victoire en 2027 », la répression violente des Gilets Jaunes en aura paralysé et intimidé plus d'un.e, le consentement gagne sur une multitude de formes, le management fait des enfants à gogo dans le dos du peuple, tout le monde-chacun-chacune est pris dans le moule de l'entrepreneur de soi-même, la propagande scélérate d'un égoïsme le plus mortel est au zénith, la guerre est réellement l'horizon indépassable de notre temps, qui n'est pas plus le nôtre d'ailleurs que celui d'hier.


Soit. Mais je n'avais pas connaissance de quelque chose que je découvre aujourd'hui, un peu par hasard, une vidéo datant de 2018 présentant un

Fury room

. Vous connaissez peut-être ? bravo. Moi, comme un imbécile, je reste sidéré devant le spectacle de cette promotion d'un défouloir individuel, tarifé, et visiblement jouissif pour ses participants. J'ai longtemps pensé que le sport était le meilleur défouloir, capable de détourner depuis toujours la rage et l'agressivité (dont celles de la révolte) et ce à longueur de journée, de manière systémique, balisée, fliquée, et honorée depuis le parent d'un môme de 3 ans jusqu'au président de la République. Les esthètes de l'art sportif ont depuis longtemps battu en brèche cette vision noire et réductrice, et ils ont sans doute raison. Mais il faut croire que, par-delà le bien et le mal, ça ne suffit plus. Ou bien plutôt la boxe, le catch, le MMA, le Krav Maga et autres sports de combat, le rugby et le foot sont-ils en passe d'être détrônés de leur prise en charge d'une agressivité régulée et positivée dans l'agon, au profit d'une pulsion de destruction vengeresse, « qui ne fait de mal à personne » ni aux biens ni au mobilier urbain, mais s'adonne en vase clos à une destruction d'objets usuels, usagés bien sûr, avec toute la panoplie et le costume ad hoc de protection et d'action ? Destruction qui ressemble à s'y méprendre aux coups et bastonnage que les flics infligent eux à une foule de cibles désignées délinquantes ou rebelles ou simplement manifestantes, terreur exercée à même la chair et l'esprit, que le permis de tuer récemment voté en guise de loi au parlement ne manquera pas d'aggraver dans des proportions inouïes.


Les participants ont l'air bon enfant sur cette vidéo aux commentaires mièvres et débiles, peut-être n'est-ce pas toujours le cas. D'autant que la prestation est tarifiée, et le prix augmente à la mesure du volume de destructions désirées (essentiellement des objets, dont l'ordinateur cible de prédilection, symbole de la soumission et de l'oppression généralisées). Autrement dit, il y a là encore, dans le défoulement annihilateur de la révolte qui devrait se retourner contre l'ennemi hiérarchique quotidien (car les frustrations accumulées semblent tout de même largement provenir du milieu de travail, et parmi la clientèle beaucoup de femmes apparemment, un indice de quelque chose ?), une inégalité d'accès qui pousserait, en toute logique, l'utilisateur.trice peu fortuné.e à se retourner contre les murs du Fury room pour les péter, et péter également le secrétariat d'accueil. En effet le service rendu est encore frustrant car limité par l'argent en poche, la pire de toutes les frustrations ressenties depuis des lustres que l'argent existe. Bref, rien de plus frustrant que ce défoulement. title: AB, Google’a konum verileri nedeniyle 403 milyon avro ceza kesti
content:
Fotoğraf: Pawel Czerwinski/Unsplash

Avrupa Birliği'nin (AB) kişisel veri düzenleyici kurumu, kullanıcıların konum verilerini AB kurallarına aykırı biçimde işlediği gerekçesiyle Google'a 403 milyon avro para cezası verdi.

AB'de kişisel verilerin korunmasından sorumlu olan İrlanda Veri Koruma Komisyonu (DPC), Google Ireland Limited hakkında yürüttüğü soruşturmaya ilişkin nihai kararını açıkladı.

Buna göre, çeşitli Avrupa tüketici hakları kuruluşlarından gelen şikayetlerin ardından, 25 Mayıs 2018-4 Şubat 2020 dönemini kapsayan soruşturma kapsamında, Google'a kullanıcıların konum verilerini AB kurallarına aykırı şekilde işlediği gerekçesiyle 403 milyon avro ceza verilmesine karar verildi.

Google, "web uygulama etkinliği" ile "konum geçmişi"ndeki konum verilerinin işlenmesinin hukuka uygunluğu ve adilliği, "konum doğruluğu"ndaki kişisel verilerin işlenmesine ilişkin hukuka uygunluk, adillik ve şeffaflık ilkelerine uyumu kanıtlayamaması ve bu üç özelliğin tümüne ilişkin şeffaflık yükümlülükleri nedeniyle cezaya çarptırıldı.

İrlanda DPC, Google'ın 6 ay içinde veri işleme faaliyetlerini mevzuata uygun hale getirmesini istedi.

İrlanda DPC, Google'ın Avrupa'daki merkezinin bu ülkede bulunması nedeniyle şirketin AB'deki kişisel veri işleme faaliyetleri bakımından başlıca denetleyici otorite konumunda bulunuyor.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

title: Infrastructure
content:
En masse, l'infrastructure a dépassé ce qui vit, et l'étouffe. Elle est signe humain. Par elle et le déchet notre signe est partout.


// Rue d'Aubervilliers. 2020 //


humain tu plies sous le meurtre


tu sais ce que tu es, de toute ta fibre


rouge et grevée sous les émoticônes,


sèche de langue, comme des loofahs —


 // Fleuve Rhône, viaduc, génocide. 2026 //


la route est le bourdon des veines

 qui leur portent leurs grappes


de bombes — on n'entend pas les bombes,

 que le bourdon des veines, la route —


// Lignes scintillantes //


c'est le premier matin


c'est la nappe de l'ogre —


le fret prend ton génome aux yeux tirés,


l'écouteur pénètre l'oreille,


c'est la ressource humaine —


// Attentat //


leurs jupes tranchent et saignent à la fois.


Silvia MAJERSKA


qui coupe la nappe de l'ogre ?


dorée ? —


tu rêves


coquelicots rasant —


// Fleuve Rhône. La renouée //


tout ce qui est proche avorte —


elle nous ressemble — se déverse


maigre mauve de bras, de dernier homme


tueuse et creuse —


// En bout de piste //


il passe, ventre-en-croix assourdissant


le feu latéral ventral caudal


ses couleurs séchées par la saison humaine ·


derniers havres séchés.


dernier havre : langue de guerre —


// Couchant //


carlingue rougie


sous la feuille de figuier — milliards d'insectes


à prendre le vent chez les morts —


// Banlieue. Puy natal. Chanson //


1 feu rouge 1 ciel


long plat-de-rouge


où l'on a jeté une crasse


de stratus · un seurat fait


avec les bords du mégafeu ·


ici la fraîcheur ! mon chiot


aime avaler le déchet, et révoque


dans l'autre dimension dorée


les petits amas puants.


tu voudrais comme un gosse


un printemps pulsant


les sécrétions de frai les


bêtes faites d'eaux noires ·


tes enfants brûleront


ton puy sèche


au lieu qu'ils cerclent leur feu


au lieu que tu chies ton ciel, enfin


ce que je veux


la haine dressée sur ton rêve


la honte que tu trouves


la honte d'un ciel plein de nerfs —


rougir & détruire —


// 17 août //


retournement il y aura —


d'abord endurer ce puits de feu — ce crépuscule — la lumière couchante avec un ogre


Benoit Sudreau

title: Armut als Mileis Erfolg: Argentinien hat die niedrigsten Löhne in Lateinamerika und einen Mindestlohn unter dem von 2001
content:
Dossier


„

Argentinische Arbeitnehmer erhalten die niedrigsten Löhne in Lateinamerika, und der Rückgang ist historisch, so ein Bericht des Lateinamerikanischen Strategiezentrums für Geopolitik (Celag). Im September 2025 lag der Realmindestlohn unter dem Niveau von 2001, vor dem Zusammenbruch der Konvertibilität. In der Casa Rosada gibt man zu, dass die Regierung von Javier Milei das Einkommen der Arbeiter als“Anker der Anpassung und der Verlangsamung der Inflation“ benutzt hat. Und die Zahlen belegen dies.Die Celag hat herausgefunden, dass der argentinische Mindestlohn (Stand November 2025) der niedrigste in der gesamten Region ist. Mit nur 225 Dollar rangiert er am unteren Ende der Tabelle, hinter Bolivien, Paraguay und weit hinter Costa Rica, das mit 729 Dollar an der Spitze liegt. (…) Ein Bericht der Facultad de Ciencias Económicas de la UBA weist zudem darauf hin, dass der Salario Mínimo, Vital y Móvil zwischen November 2023 und September 2025 34 % seiner Kaufkraft verlieren wird

…“ span.

Beitrag vom 17. November 2025 in Página|12

Auf den „Marsch der Verschuldeten“ gegen Mileis System der Grausamkeit gegenüber den Ärmsten rufen Gewerkschaften und soziale Organisationen nun zum „Marsch der Wut“ am 19. September auf


Die Wut auf Mileis Sparpolitik erfasste die Straßen: Alle von der Regierung benachteiligten sozialen Gruppen waren landesweit am 19. September massiv vertreten


Die Wut auf Milei erfasste die Straßen: Der Demonstrationszug führte vom Kongress zur Plaza de Mayo. Die von der Regierung benachteiligten sozialen Gruppen waren vertreten.


„Die meisten Sektoren, die unter den Sparmaßnahmen von Javier Milei zu leiden hatten, brachten am Samstagnachmittag bei einem Marsch vom Kongress zur Plaza de Mayo ihre Wut über den Plan des Libertären „und seiner Komplizen“ zum Ausdruck. Die Kundgebung wurde von mehr als 350 sozialen, gewerkschaftlichen und linken politischen Organisationen einberufen. Anwesend waren die wichtigsten Führer der Bewegung, die auf einer vor der Casa Rosada errichteten Bühne eine Kundgebung abhielten, bei der sie ein gemeinsam verfasstes Dokument verlasen. Es gab Nachahmungen in verschiedenen Provinzen des Landes und im Landesinneren der Provinz Buenos Aires.


Im Gespräch mit „Página/12“ erklärte die Abgeordnete der „Frente de Izquierda“ im Nationalkongress, Myriam Bregman, die große Beteiligung an der Demonstration sei darauf zurückzuführen, dass „es große Wut auslöst, dass (Milei) so viel gelogen hat“, denn „es wurde ganz deutlich, dass das mit der Kaste nur ein Märchen war“, sagte sie. „Er ist gekommen, um für die wichtigste Kaste dieses Landes zu regieren, nämlich die wirtschaftliche Kaste, die von der Diktatur profitiert hat, die vom Militärputsch profitiert hat und die immer auf die Beine kommt“, führte die Abgeordnete weiter aus.


Hätte Milei sich vor Ort umgesehen, hätte er all jene Gruppen gesehen, die er während seiner fast dreijährigen Amtszeit systematisch benachteiligt und angegriffen hat: Rentner, Menschen mit Behinderung, Mitarbeiter des Garrahan-Krankenhauses, Entlassene von Fate, Angehörige und Kollegen von Milton Ptolomeo und Eneas Gallo – die wegen ihrer Proteste gegen die Arbeitsrechtsreform festgenommen worden waren –, Landrechtsbewegungen, Studenten, Wissenschaftler, Medienmitarbeiter, unter anderem – machten ihrer Wut Luft. Ebenfalls anwesend waren die Hochschullehrer, die mit dem berühmten „Trencito de la Alegría“ angereist waren

title: 21. yüzyılda elektriksiz yaşama tepki: 100 yıl önce dedelerimiz böyle yaşıyordu
content:
Osmaniye'nin Kadirli ilçesine bağlı Değirmendere Köyü'nde elektrikleri olmayan vatandaşlar, mum ve çıra ışığında yaşamaya çalışıyor. Köylülerden Fatma İspenoğlu, elektriksiz bırakılmalarına tepki göstererek "Neden bize elektrik verilmiyor? Hangi çağda yaşıyoruz? Dedelerimiz de böyle yaşıyordu 100 yıl önce, biz de yaşıyoruz" diye konuştu.

40 yıldır elektriksiz yaşayan vatandaşlar, dört yıl önce mahallelerine elektrik gelmesine rağmen bazı evlere halen elektrik verilmemesini eleştirerek, elektrik dağıtım şirketine müracaatta bulunmalarına rağmen bir sonuç alamadıklarını söyledi.

Hayvanlarına mum ışığında yem vermek durumunda kaldığını söyleyen Fatma İspenoğlu, yaşadığı mağduriyeti, "Işığımız yok, makinemiz yok, dolabımız yok... Çamaşır makinesi yok, ellerimde sızı var çamaşır yıkayamıyorum. Elektriği istiyorum büyük adamlardan. Neden bize elektrik verilmiyor?” diye sordu.

Elektriksiz hayata tepki gösteren Muharrem İspenoğlu, "Bundan dört yıl önce Durna Mahallesi'ne elektrik telleri çekildi ama yarı çekildi. Bizim elektrik tellerimiz çekilmedi. Mum ışığında böyle karanlıkta yaşıyoruz. Çıra yakıyoruz, mum yakıyoruz" ifadelerini kullandı.

Büyükdurna Mahallesi'nde 5-6 evin 40 yıldır elektriksiz olduğuna dikkati çeken Mustafa Yağız şunları söyledi: “Komşulara geldi 600-700 metre mesafeye. Bizim burada 5-6 eve gelmedi. Müracaatımızı yaptık, proje alındı TOROSLAR EDAŞ tarafından fakat bize '2026'nın yaz ayında kesin gelecek' dediler hâlâ bir gelişme olmadı. Şu anda çıra ışığında, mum ışığında işte böyle uğraşıp duruyoruz. Yıl 2026, 50'nin üzerinde benim yaşım hâla elektriksiz yaşıyoruz."

title: AKP’li Yavuz’dan Erdoğan’ın adaylığı için 'tarih' formülü: "Bir hafta öne alınsa bile yeterli"
content:
AKP Genel Başkan Yardımcısı ve Seçim İşleri Başkanı Ali İhsan Yavuz, "Türkiye Yüzyılı Buluşmaları" etkinliği kapsamında Ağrı'da önümüzdeki seçim takvimi tartışmalarına ilişkin açıklamalarda bulundu.

Seçim tarihine ilişkin konuşan Yavuz, "Seçimler normal zamanda olacaksa kanun gereği Mayıs 2028'de olacak. Ama biz Meclis'in seçim yenileme kararı almasını arzu ediyoruz. Çünkü Meclis seçim yenileme kararı alırsa Cumhurbaşkanımız Sayın Recep Tayyip Erdoğan bir dönem daha aday olabilecek. Ama bu öne alma 6 ay, 1 yıl olması gerekmiyor. Çok net söylüyorum bu bir hafta bile olsa maksat hasıl oluyor. O zaman niye biz acele edelim ki şimdi iş yapma zamanı" ifadesini kullandı.

Adalet Bakanı Gürlek 2028'i işaret etti: 'Cumhurbaşkanımızı tekrar seçmek için seçim düzenlenecek'

Erdoğan'ın seçimin zamanında yapılacağı yönündeki açıklamalarına işaret eden Yavuz, seçimi bir iki hafta öne almanın zamanında yapılmış sayılacağını öne sürdü. TBMM’nin 360 milletvekilinin oyuyla bu yönde bir adım atması durumunda Erdoğan’ın adaylığının önünün açılacağını vurgulayan Yavuz, “Ama onun için acelemiz yok" diye konuştu.

AKP'li Yavuz, "Seçim tarihi mayıs, ondan çok kısa bir süre önce seçim yenileme kararının alınabileceğini ve Sayın Cumhurbaşkanımızın da aday olacağını öngörüyorum" diye konuştu.

author: Dominique Gené - Local Journalism Initiative Reporter
title: Five candidates run for Ungava riding in Quebec election
content:
Five candidates are running in Quebec’s largest riding by land mass, which includes Nunavik, in the Oct. 5 provincial election.


Ungava MNA Denis Lamothe, who has held that seat since 2018, announced in January he would not seek re-election. His Coalition Avenir Québec party has nominated Amélie Béchard instead.


Originally from Matagami, she is a forestry engineer who specializes in operations management and forest planning. She has served on several boards of directors including the Matagami Commercial Development Corp.


The Parti Québécois nominated Sonia Caron, who manages the Baie-James Vocational Training Centre in Chibougamau.


In a statement posted on the party’s website, Caron said she hopes to give more decision-making power to northern communities, protect Indigenous Peoples’ ways of life, and ensure communities benefit from the North’s resources.


“I will be proud to be the first woman elected Member of the National Assembly for Ungava, and the first Indigenous person to represent this voice,” she said.


Antoine Côté will represent Québec Solidaire.


Côté ran for councillor in Montreal in the 2025 municipal election. Parti Solitaire’s website does not yet list a biography or campaign priorities for Côté but says the information will be added.


Marc Damant is the candidate for the Conservative Party of Quebec.


As an airport operator, Damant serves several communities in Nunavik, including Kuujjuaq, Inukjuak and Umiujaq. He also served as a reservist in the Canadian Armed Forces for 11 years.


On July 15, the Quebec Liberal Party nominated Sandrine Rioux, a 30-year-old digital marketing specialist originally from Chibougamau, Northern Quebec’s largest town.


”Ungava isn’t just the region where I grew up — it’s the place that shaped my values and my perspective on Quebec,” Rioux said in a news release. “I understand the unique challenges our communities face, but also their immense potential.”


The polls will be open on Oct. 5.

title: El Frente Sindical de Universidades Nacionales llama a paros, marcha universitaria y 23 días de protestas en todo el país
content:
Ante un nuevo fracaso de las paritarias docente y no docente de las Universidades nacionales, luego de que el Ejecutivo nacional repitiera su propuesta insuficiente e incumpliera una vez más la Ley de Financiamiento Universitario, el Frente Sindical de Universidades Nacionales llama a paros, marcha universitaria y 23 días de protestas en todo el país.


Tras 46 días de paro por tiempo indeterminado, el gremio docente SUTEF comunicó la aceptación por mayoría del acuerdo discutido con los funcionarios provinciales de Tierra del Fuego el pasado 14 de septiembre


Por Mario Hernandez


En la última reunión paritaria realizada la semana pasada, el ministerio de Capital Humano hizo la misma oferta que había hecho a principio de mes, 3% en septiembre y 3% en octubre, que fue rechazada por los gremios docentes y no docentes universitarios que reclaman una recomposición salarial del 32,5%.


Desde los gremios afirman que el 3% que el Gobierno impone está muy lejos de cumplir la cautelar que lo obliga a hacer efectivo el artículo 5 de la Ley de Financiamiento Universitario sobre el que hay que calcular tanto el retraso salarial (33,4%) como la deuda salarial del orden de los cuatro salarios.


Es por esto que ya se llamó un nuevo paro conjunto de 48 horas, la primera jornada fue este 18 de septiembre, y la segunda será el martes 22.


Además se convoca a la quinta marcha universitaria para el jueves 15 de octubre al Palacio de Tribunales.


Mientras habrá 23 días de protesta en todo el país para sostener el conflicto.


“La defensa de la universidad pública con salarios dignos, becas estudiantiles que garanticen ingreso, permanencia y graduación, fondos para sostener las misiones sustantivas -docencia, investigación y extensión- y para hospitales universitarios es lo que nos impulsa a sostener esta larga lucha”, expresaron desde el Frente Sindical de Universidades Nacionales.


Desde la Federación de Docentes de las Universidades Nacionales (FEDUN), su secretario general, Daniel Ricci, cuestionó la propuesta oficial y sostuvo que el porcentaje ofrecido está lejos de permitir una recuperación de los salarios.


“El Gobierno vuelve a presentar una propuesta que está completamente alejada de lo que necesitamos para recuperar nuestros salarios”, afirmó Ricci. Y agregó: “No vamos a naturalizar esta pérdida ni aceptar que se incumpla una ley vigente”.


Según el planteo del Frente Sindical, la pérdida salarial acumulada sería equivalente a alrededor de cuatro salarios, aunque se trata de un cálculo realizado por las propias organizaciones gremiales.


La Federación Argentina de Trabajadores de las Universidades Nacionales (FATUN), que representa al personal no docente, también confirmó su adhesión a las medidas y ratificó la continuidad de la estrategia conjunta frente al conflicto salarial y presupuestario.


El presupuesto 2027 que envió el Gobierno al Congreso profundiza el ajuste en Ciencia y Universidades.


La posición del Gobierno


Desde el Gobierno sostienen una interpretación diferente sobre el cumplimiento de las obligaciones salariales. El Ejecutivo afirma que el incremento del 3% correspondiente a septiembre se aplicará aun sin acuerdo paritario y que, sumado a los aumentos previamente otorgados, permite avanzar en el cumplimiento de la medida cautelar vinculada con la Ley de Financiamiento Universitario.


La administración nacional toma como referencia el acuerdo alcanzado el 10 de junio y el incremento del 3% previsto para septiembre. Los gremios, en cambio, cuestionan esa metodología de cálculo y sostienen que debe contemplarse la pérdida acumulada desde diciembre de 2023.


La discusión salarial se encuentra además atravesada por una disputa más amplia en torno al financiamiento de las universidades nacionales y el Presupuesto 2027.


Según datos oficiales, el proyecto de Presupuesto enviado por el Gobierno contempla alrededor de $7.349 billones para funcionamiento, inversión y programas especiales de las universidades nacionales. El Consejo Interuniversitario Nacional (CIN), por su parte, calcula que el sistema requeriría cerca de $11 billones para 2027.


La falta de acuerdo en la última reunión paritaria dejó planteadas dos posiciones contrapuestas. Mientras el Gobierno sostiene que el aumento ofrecido forma parte de una secuencia de recomposición salarial y que permite avanzar en el cumplimiento de las obligaciones establecidas, los sindicatos consideran que la propuesta no alcanza para recuperar el poder …

author: Christoph Schmon
title: EU Kids Act Won't Keep the Internet Accountable and Trustworthy
content:
The EU Commission draft law to restrict young people’s access to the internet that it

presented

 last week will

come at a high cost: it will put online services behind age gates, expand the use of intrusive age verification, and undermine the privacy of all users.

 


The

EU Kids Act

 aims to protect children from risks associated with social media, video games, and AI systems by introducing age-based access rules, safety requirements, and stronger enforcement and oversight measures. It presents itself as building on the Digital Services Act (DSA) and puts into “hard law” some of the

safety-by-design measures

 specified in the non-binding DSA guidelines on minors’ protection.

 


The proposal is built around the following elements: social media age “delay”, safety by design, age assurance and parental responsibility, and strong enforcement. Each of these measures are concerning.

 


Mandatory Age Gates for Social Media and Video-Sharing Platforms

 


Following the

advice of an expert panel

, the proposal would create a phased access to social media and video-sharing platforms deemed risky—a threshold met simply by relying on personalized recommender systems or offering “uninterrupted content consumption”: no service accounts for children under 13; restricted accounts under tight parental supervision from 13 to 15; and autonomous accounts in a safe-by-design environment from 15 to 18. Full online access is therefore reserved for adults.

 


However they’re designed, age gates undermine civil liberties, reduce safety, and create barriers to internet entry, often at the expense of marginalized groups.


If this sounds complex and like a compliance nightmare, that’s because it is. The access delay comes with

privacy-intrusive

 age verification across the board, relying on the EU age verification scheme. For teenagers, this law means significant control in the hands of their parents, who must set up accounts and prove that they are, in fact, parents, adding yet another problematic layer of verification.

 


In fairness, the Kids Act’s gradual approach at least appears to be designed with some proportionality considerations, rather than imposing a blanket social media ban. J

ust last month a French court

declared

 such undifferentiated bans unconstitutional. The EU Kids Act

 distinguishes between age groups and certain services and follows a risk-based approach. This means, for example, that age verification is not required for existing accounts if the provider can tell with a “high degree of confidence” that the user is above the age threshold—a vaguely specified standard. 

 


Yet, the law still indiscriminately covers social media and video-sharing, with virtually all mainstream services being covered by the proposal. The broad scope also sits uneasy with the use of age thresholds, which remain a blunt proxy for maturity. What is more, by focusing heavily on safety and harms, the EU Kids Act pays little attention to the privacy and freedom of expression rights of users, as well as the right of children themselves to access information and to participate online.

However they’re designed, age gates undermine civil liberties, reduce safety, and create barriers to internet entry

, often

at the expense of marginalized groups

. They also create a powerful infrastructure for control and further entrench the power of big tech.

 


The proposal exempts not-for-profit encyclopedias, scientific repositories and educational services, as well as open-source software-developing and-sharing platforms. However, no exceptions are foreseen for small and medium-sized enterprises, which will only foster the dominance of resource-laden tech companies that were already investing in similar measures. And we know that most companies are well-advised to play it safe and use privacy-unfriendly age checks across their platforms.

 


Safety by Design Across Covered Services

 


The proposal’s second pillar, “safety by design”, casts a wider net. It applies across social media, video-sharing, online games, AI companions, chatbots and even app stores—with varying requirements. Providers must generally make child-safe design the default and can relax from the requirements only if they use age assurance to establish that the user is an adult.

 


For example, rules on addictive features such as infinite scrolling, safe account settings, and more choice over recommender systems are to provide a safe internet experience to …

title: "War on the Press": Trump Bans CNN, MS NOW & Politico from White House over Critical Coverage
content:
News organizations

CNN

, MS

NOW

 and

Politico

 are suing the Trump administration over the banning of their reporters from the White House on Friday. Their credentials were confiscated or deactivated when they attempted to enter White House grounds over the weekend. Trump’s decision is “sending the message that if you write stories that are critical of the president, you’re going to lose your access,” says Katie Fallow, a deputy litigation director at Columbia University’s Knight First Amendment Institute, where she focuses on threats to freedom of speech and of the press. “The real victims of this war on the press are members of the public, which are entitled to know about what their government is doing.”


Fallow says the White House press briefing room is a “public forum” and that “the courts have said repeatedly the government is not allowed to kick people out of that forum based on their viewpoint.”

title: „An euren Händen klebt Blut!“: Studentische Proteste gegen tödliche Korruption weiten sich in Serbien zu Streiks gegen die neoliberale Regierung aus
content:
Dossier


„

In Serbien finden derzeit die größten Straßenproteste seit Jahrzehnten statt. Der Anlass: Anfang November stürzte in der nordserbischen Stadt Novi Sad das Vordach des Bahnhofs ein. Bei dem Unglück kamen 15 Menschen ums Leben. Studierende organisieren seit dem Vorfall Proteste und fordern von der Regierung, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und den Fall aufzuklären. Die Demonstrierenden sehen die tief verwurzelte Korruption im Land als Ursache für den Einsturz. (…) Die Proteste weiteten sich über das ganze Land aus. Den Protesten haben sich Oppositionelle, Schüler und Schülerinnen, Professorinnen, Künstler und Bauern angeschlossen. Im Dezember wurde ein weiterer Skandal öffentlich, der das Vertrauen in die Regierung erschütterte: Die Menschenrechtsorganisation Amnesty International berichtete, dass die serbische Polizei und Geheimdienste die Handys von Aktivisten und Journalisten mit einer israelischen Spionagesoftware infiziert haben.

..“ Umfangreicher

Beitrag vom 26.12.2024 im Deutschlandfunk


 („Jugend vereint sich gegen Korruption“), siehe die weitere Entwicklung:


Vor den vorgezogenen Neuwahlen in Serbien findet die Wahlliste der Studierendenbewegung mit ihren 250 Kandidat*innen viel Zuspruch – und ins Visier von Überwachungssoftware


Serbien: Oppositionelle stehen im Visier von Überwachungssoftware


„… Für Ende Oktober hat der serbische Präsident Aleksandar Vučić vorgezogene Neuwahlen angesetzt. Seit fast zwei Jahren befindet sich der EU-Beitrittskandidat Serbien in einer innenpolitischen Krise. Nun wurde bekannt, dass die Opposition in Serbien mit einer Welle digitaler Überwachung konfrontiert ist. Die Share Foundation verzeichnet seit Beginn des Jahres 14 Fälle, in denen Personen zu Zielen von Spyware wurden. Zu ihnen gehören Mitglieder von Serbiens Studierendenbewegung, Aktivist:innen, ein Oppositionsabgeordneter und ein Gemeinderatsmitglied. Allein im August haben zwölf Personen die NGO kontaktiert, welche sich für den Schutz von Grundrechten und Freiheiten im digitalen Raum einsetzt. (…) Zusätzlich stellt Share zwei Infektionen mit NoviSpy fest, wobei eine davon auch das Security Lab von Amnesty International bestätigt. (…) Mehrere Sonderberichterstatter:innen der UN haben daher „große Sorge“ geäußert. „Ohne die uneingeschränkte Achtung der Versammlungs- und Meinungsfreiheit vor, während und nach den Wahlen kann der Wahlprozess nicht als frei und fair angesehen werden“, so die UN-Fachleute. Spyware-Technologien seien „vollständig inkompatibel“ mit Menschenrechten. Der europäische Dachverband digitaler Bürgerrechtsorganisationen EDRi beurteilt den Einsatz solcher Technologien als eine schwerwiegende Verletzung des Rechts auf Privatsphäre. Darüber hinaus verweist EDRi auf den „chilling effect“ – die Bürger:innen würden eingeschüchtert. Das wirke sich etwa auf ihre Meinungsfreiheit aus.“


Beitrag von Jette Scheibchen vom 16. September 2026 bei Netzpolitik.org

 


„

Die Student*innen in #Serbien haben gestern Abend ihre Wahlliste bzw. Ihre 250 Kandidat*innen für das Parlament veröffentlicht. Sie ist das Ergebnis von über einem Jahr demokratischer Prozesse. (Im Vorfeld wurde öffentlich viel und kontrovers diskutiert, wer auf ihr sein sollte und wer nicht.)


Die Liste setzt bewusst nicht auf Berufspolitiker*innen. Stattdessen stehen Bürger*innen (mit interdisziplinären Expertisen und Perspektiven) im Fokus, die Verantwortung in den Institutionen übernehmen wollen: Professor*innen, Ärzt*innen, Künstler*innen, Aktivist*innen, Unternehmer*innen usw.


Ein bekannterer Name ist Dejan Bodiroga, eine Basketball-Legende und eine (kluge) Person, die die Student*innen und Schüler*innen stets unterstützte. Das Signal der Studierenden: Ein Parlamentsmandat ist kein Karrieresprungbrett, sondern ein öffentl. Auftrag. Das Mandat gehört den Bürger*innen. (…)


Der Plan setzt auf 3 Kernpfeiler:


1) Serbien statt Mafia: Korruption bekämpfen & hunderte Millionen € für Bürger*innen freisetzen


2) Wissen ist Macht: Universitäten schützen, Entpolitisierung und Bildung als Zukunftsmotor


3) Gerechtes Wachstum: Eine Wirtschaft für alle, statt Hinterzimmer-Deals

title: And just strategically we can look at the past 5 years of talking about how Harry Potter is sucky…
content:
Not to be a weakass hater but uh. Yeah I have actually come around to the idea that talking about how Harry Potter is sucky and cringe and harmful constantly and, when it comes out, that the new show is bad and why, has some weight.

Millions of people still just unironically like Harry Potter. I have started interacting way more with other parents of toddlers - a great way to get a read on the average views of average cishet adults in your area, btw - and like. They mostly just fully like Harry Potter and mostly have minimal to no conflicted feelings about it. There’s new collaborations coming out all the time! They’re opening new official merch shops in London and Edinburgh and no, it’s not just for all the foreign tourists who don’t know better! People still do just like this stuff!!

The dead horse is only really dead in a handful of trans inclusive spaces, it is very much alive and trotting around in the general population. So alas I think we probably need to keep talking about how you shouldn’t read Harry Potter and it’s sort of embarrassing that you do. Consider it an outreach program

I actually think shaming people for liking or enjoying different kinds of media or art is a great way to make them not listen to you about the actual concerns underlying why supporting a children’s book series somehow tangentially affects trans people. People who are not chronically online or in trans spaces don’t understand how the two are related and frequently do need the dots drawn for them and bullying them about the things they enjoy doesn’t actually achieve that.

I think pointing out the influence JKR has on politics and the impact she has over social media and how her using the money she made from me buying her books when I was in middle school has allowed her to impact legislation that impacts trans people’s actual lives and let me sit with that and come to my own conclusion that it was no longer possible for me to separate the art from the artist or enjoy her are is a more effective way of interacting with people but I understand that that takes time and building relationships and ultimately trusts other people to be the person you think or hope they are and isn’t as easy as just, like, telling Millenials they are cringe for liking Harry Potter on the internet.

I really think it’s a stupid approach to tell people that one of the most universally enjoyed and popular book series ever published is actually not that great and sucks because the author is a shitty person. There is a REASON people enjoy(ed) these books and the world building and the magic and the lore and the movies and want to share that with their kids and acting as if the billions of people who have enjoyed the series were just wrong to do so because you don’t think the books are written well or something isn’t really going to achieve what you’re hoping it to. Bullying people by telling them they should be embarrassed for ever (or still) liking Harry Potter like it wasn’t a huge pop culture influence makes you easy to write off as an annoying troll on the internet while they continue to engage with and provide monetary support to JKR, which is what you’re actually upset about.

I saw a guy make a video once about how he loved Harry Potter, shared it with his kids, going to the Harry Potter World theme park was a huge bucket list item for him, etc. and he talked about how quickly and easily his love for the series and his views on it changed when he was talking to one of his trans friends about it. And the conversation basically evolved to him asking this trans friend about if his love for Harry Potter made them feel like he was a bad friend or didn’t support them or if they thought it was transphobic for him to love it so much and his trans friend was basically like “No…you’re my friend. I know what’s in your heart, I know you care about me as a trans person and my community and I’ve known you for years and I know who you are and your love for Harry Potter isn’t something I view as a greater outlook on me and your politics. But that’s because I know you. If I didn’t know you and I saw how much you love Harry Potter I don’t think I would be able to view you as a safe person.” And that, for him, changed how he viewed his relationship with Harry Potter, almost immediately. He could no longer bring himself to feel the joy it used to bring him knowing it was sending a message to other trans people or the trans community that follows him on social media that …

Eolico a Londa, il bilancio della Coalizione ambientale TESS dopo un anno di attività.


La rete di associazioni e comitati ripercorre le tappe della mobilitazione contro il progetto industriale e pubblica una nota integrale sul percorso svolto e sulle prospettive future


A un anno dall’inizio delle mobilitazioni contro l’installazione di impianti eolici industriali al confine del

Parco Nazionale Foreste Casentinesi

Grande soddisfazione per un anno di continuo impegno e per gli obiettivi raggiunti nella difesa dei crinali della Montagna Fiorentina da parte dei Comitati e delle Associazioni della Coalizione ambientale TESS (Transizione Energetica Senza Speculazione) e di tutti i cittadini contrari all’industrializzazione dei Crinali di Londa, che da subito hanno dato tempestiva, puntuale e corretta informazione sulle criticità insanabili di questa imponente opera in un Comune che è porta di accesso al Parco Nazionale Foreste Casentinesi.

La Coalizione ambientale TESS ha realizzato numerose iniziative aperte alla popolazione, con invito alle Associazioni e alle Istituzioni del territorio sui temi delle Comunità energetiche, delle alternative energetiche concrete alla cementificazione e alla devastazione degli ecosistemi montani, iniziative per la difesa legale dei crinali, dei territori e della popolazione dalla colonizzazione speculativa energetica, iniziative sul tema rinnovabili e legalità, fra cui il 12 luglio un incontro pubblico con il patrocinio del Comune di San Godenzo.


Il 4 luglio nel Comune di Rufina, alla Villa Poggio Reale, la Coalizione ambientale TESS con la collaborazione dell’Osservatorio Biodiversità ha organizzato un Convegno molto partecipato presentando il Crinale di Croce a Mori come soggetto di diritto dell’Appennino Montagna Fiorentina a rischio di industrializzazione eolica.

title: Assemblea pubblica “Giustizia per Lince” verso la mobilitazione del 2 ottobre a Bologna
content:
Quello che è “successo” a Ramy, a Fakir, a Lince e mol3 altr3 non sono episodi isolati.


Sono parte di un problema più grande che riguarda il modo in cui vengono gestiti e controllati determinati corpi, determinate comunità, determinati territori. Riguarda la brutalità e gli abusi delle forze dell’ordine, la criminalizzazione delle persone migranti e non bianche, la repressione del dissenso e un modello securitario che presenta il controllo come unica risposta possibile.


È dentro questo quadro che la campagna Lince ci chiede di attraversare il 2 ottobre insieme. Non come una semplice giornata di memoria, ma come un momento per mettere in relazione esperienze diverse, costruire una rete e provare a dare continuità a un percorso di mobilitazione che non si esaurisca nella risposta a un singolo episodio.


Non chiediamo verità. La verità è già molto chiara e sotto gli occhi di tutt3. È tempo di chiedere giustizia. E chiedere giustizia significa anche interrogare le condizioni che rendono possibile la violenza, la sua normalizzazione e l’impunità. Significa non accettare che ogni episodio venga isolato dagli altri, come se non esistesse un filo che li attraversa.


Da mesi, a Bologna e in altre città, diverse realtà stanno provando a reagire a questa situazione. Lo abbiamo visto nelle mobilitazioni, nelle assemblee, nei percorsi nati attorno a Fakir e ad altri episodi di violenza e repressione. Ma troppo spesso queste esperienze rimangono separate, mentre proprio la frammentazione rischia di indebolire la possibilità di costruire una risposta comune.


A partire da quanto emerso dall’assemblea di piazza Lucio Dalla di luglio, vogliamo quindi provare a costruire uno spazio cittadino e, allo stesso tempo, a metterlo in relazione con le esperienze che attraversano altri territori.

Uno spazio orizzontale e trasversale che parta dalle comunità direttamente coinvolte, a partire dal Pilastro e dalle comunità migranti e che sappia tenere insieme le diverse forme di resistenza alla violenza istituzionale, alla repressione e alla deriva securitaria.


Il 21 settembre alle 18.30, in piazza Lucio Dalla, ci incontriamo per discutere insieme come costruire la piazza del 2 ottobre e, soprattutto, come dare continuità a questo percorso.


Perché oggi più che mai, mentre i fascismi avanzano e la repressione si fa sempre più pervasiva, abbiamo bisogno di costruire connessioni, non ulteriori divisioni. Di riconoscere le differenze tra le nostre esperienze senza trasformarle in frammentazione. Di stare insieme, organizzarci e costruire una forza collettiva capace di non lasciare sole le persone e le comunità che subiscono violenza.

Ramy, Fakir, Lince e tutte le esperienze che in questi mesi hanno attraversato le nostre città ci parlano della stessa necessità: trasformare la rabbia e la resistenza in organizzazione, relazione e mobilitazione. Insomma in comunità.


Questa è una proposta. Il resto si costruisce insieme.

title: Referéndum 2026: ¡ya tenemos los resultados!
content:
Como ya ha quedado claro a estas alturas, en CIT todas las decisiones se toman de abajo hacia arriba. Eso quiere decir que todas las personas afiliadas en cualquier sección participan en el proceso y que los organismos formales (como los Grupos de Trabajo o el Comité de Relaciones) solo tienen el encargo de hacerlas efectivas. Esto se logra mediante congresos y referéndums.


Coordinar compañeros y compañeras de tantos países diferentes puede llevar su tiempo y el Comité de Relaciones debe elaborar un calendario que permita la consideración de todas las cuestiones en los niveles local y nacional. Por supuesto, las fechas pueden variar de un año a otro, aunque los plazos son siempre los mismos (estipulados por nuestros estatutos, que se pueden consultar en este enlace:

Estatutos – ICL-CIT

). Nos complace decir que el procedimiento ha vuelto a funcionar a la perfección y que ya disponemos de los resultados de este referéndum.


En esta ocasión, se sometieron varias cuestiones a consideración de la afiliación, pero sin duda las más importantes han sido la inclusión formal de las nuevas secciones en el seno de la internacional:


Adhesión de FGWM de Myanmar

: aprobada por unanimidad. Como sabéis, hace tiempo que la International colabora con este sindicato y apoya sus iniciativas. Sin embargo, hasta hace unos meses no habían solicitado su inclusión formal en CIT, la cual se ha producido ahora. ¡Nos alegra dar la bienvenida a esta nueva sección!


Adhesión de FOB de Brasil:

 aprobada por unanimidad, con abstención de una sección. En su día ya se informó de la solicitud de este sindicato, para convertirse en miembro formal de la International. Con esta decisión, se ratifica dicha adhesión.


Una vez más, solo cabe alegrarnos de estas decisiones. No solo por el resultado en sí, sino por el hecho de que hayamos sido capaces de alcanzar consensos en todos los puntos, demostrando una vez más que es posible tomar decisiones de abajo hacia arriba, y de la constatación innegable de que la organización de la clase trabajadora mundial siga adelante de manera imparable.


Será un placer contar con estos compañeros y estas compañeras en nuestras filas y esperamos con ansia sus contribuciones al trabajo de la internacional. ¡Bienvenidos! ¡Bienvenidas!


La entrada

Referéndum 2026: ¡ya tenemos los resultados!

 se publicó primero en

Confederación Nacional del Trabajo

.

Birayê Zehra Kisaoglu, Abdullah Kisaoglu ku ji bo wergirtina cenazeyê xwişka xwe hatibû goristanê axivî û got: “Her sal polîsan bi ser mal me de digirt û li kelûpelan digeriya. Xwişka min piştî qedandina lîseyê çûbû. Li ku derê goristana komî hebûya, me gelek caran nimûneyên DNA’yê didan. Di dawiyê de em 4 roj berê hîn bûn ku li vir e.”


Tê payîn ku cenaze îro ji Goristana Kilyosê bêne wergirtin û ji bo navçeya Kanîreşê ya Çewlîgê bêne şandin.


Çi qewimîbû?


282 cenazeyên PKKiyan ku li deverên cuda yên Bedlîsê hatibûn veşartin, di pêvajoya çareseriyê ya 2013-2015an de li Goristana Xerzanê ya gundê Oleka Jorîn hatibûn veşartin. Bi biryara Walîtiya Bedlîsê re di 19ê Kanûna 2017an de gelek gorên li Goristana Xerzanê hatin vekirin. Cenaze ji bo tespîtkirina nasnameyan ji Saziya Tiba Edlî (ATK) ya Stenbolê re hatin şandin.


Piştî ku cenazeyên 21 kesên DNA’ya wan li hev hat da teslîmê malbatan hat kirin, hatibû diyarkirin ku cenazeyên din li Goristana Kilyosê hatine veşartin. Lêbelê piştre derket holê ku cenazeyên 261 endamên PKK’ê li Kilyos a Stenbolê li peyareyê hatine veşartin.


(FY)

author: Fozzie
title: Chapter 27: The Expropriation of the Agricultural Population from the Land
content:
Harry Cleaver's study guide to chapter 27 of Capital volume 1.

This historical analysis of the first step in the creation of the working class centers on the forcible expropriation of the means of livelihood of peasants and craftspeople. In England some 6,000,000 acres or 1/4 of the cultivated acreage was enclosed by direct act of parliament. Another 4-7 million acres are estimated to have been enclosed privately. (1) The second step—forcing them into the factories—comes in the next chapter. This expropriation of the land was a long process, 300 to 400 years, and only through considerable violence were these changes accomplished. Vast numbers resisted and had to be forcibly dispossessed, a violence that forced them to seek refuge in woodland or cities or even flee abroad.

One area of dispossession, which Marx highlights, is the highlands in Scotland where the Dutchess of Sutherland and others drove their clansmen from the land. Such enclosures and the human misery produced were fought by those directly victimized and protested by sympathizers.

The long and tragic history of the enclosures with their terrible costs to humans and to nature left an indelible mark on the various cultures of the "British" Isles. These costs were a central issue in the transformation wrought by the rise of capitalism, the commercialization of agriculture and the industrialization of manufacturing. Not surprisingly, they have also become the inspiration of folk music that remembers and laments. "The Highland Clearances" written by Andy Stewart, blasts Queen Victoria for sanctioning the kind of highland clearances carried out by the duchess of Sutherland, evokes the burning of the peasant crofts and recalls those who were forced to take ship for the New, and hopefully better, World.(2)

Ah, for the Glens are lyin' bare And the wee bit farm deserted, And the woods of Germany, Grow in rows o'er the broken hearted.

Black is the wood on the roof ance was braw (ance was braw = once was grand) But blacker still is your heart Victoria Sent your men untae our glens You'll need the Good Lord Lookin' o'er ye.

Many hae gane tae Americay. You burnt their hames and garred them wander (hames = homes, garred = forced) For a' would have stayed wi' the deil himsel' (deil = devil) As bide an hour wi' the cruel Gillanders.

Ah for the Glens are lyin' bare And the wee bit farm deserted, And the woods of Germany, Grows in rows o'er the broken hearted.

Silly Wizard, So Many Partings, 1989 Shanachie 79016

While the new capitalist farmers were on the offensive, they found it no easy task to drive off and pauperize the population. There was violent resistance to physical removal; there were polemics written by economists and others, and from time to time, there was even legislation against the process—though largely ignored and unenforced. As we see in the subsequent chapter, the dispossessed also turned to "vagabondage and brigandry" out of desperation and to avenge themselves for the loss of their land and livelihoods.

This process that Marx analyzes in Britain has been universal throughout the bloody history of the creation of the capitalist world. Marx mentions Germany, Sweden and France in passing, but it has been employed everywhere capitalists invaded, from Asia, through the Middle East and Africa to the Western Hemisphere. In all those regions, British capitalists, backed by their government’s army and navy, established private property by force and fiat against the indigenous peoples and their customs, no matter how varied. So too did the Dutch in the East Indies. In the lands of the Incas and Aztecs, the violence of the Spanish conquistadors and expropriators is well known. Both Spaniards and Portuguese established huge colonial empires in South America, bequeathing the region the title of Latin America following the imposition of their own languages on indigenous peoples. (3) The Dutch also carved out pieces of South America and Southern Africa. Throughout the “Age of Imperialism,” capitalists, backed by their governments, competed, both economically and militarily, frequently displacing one another in wars for the control of the peoples, resources, markets and investment opportunities throughout the world.

Over time, “primitive” accumulation became a recurrent aspect of capitalist development. Despite capitalist efforts to extend their control throughout the world, that world was just too large and its people too numerous and too resisting for …

author: Novara Media
title: Nobel Economist Warns: AI Will Destroy Democracy
content:
In the West, liberal democracy, or social democracy, has over the past century become the dominant political system: the water we swim in. But in an age of climate change, runaway inequality, big tech oligopolies, and rising fascism, the system that once promised so much to so many is breaking under the strain. On Downstream this week is Daron Acemoglu, winner of the Nobel Prize in Economics.


His 2012 book ‘Why Nations Fail’ sold over a million copies. This week, he’s here to discuss his latest work, ‘What Happened to Liberal Democracy?’ – a data-packed book that seeks to diagnose and remedy democracy before it’s too late. When and why did liberal democracy stop working for the many? What happened during the transition from an industrial to a post-industrial economy?


How important has the loss of community been? When did progressive politics become overrun by middle-class interests? How does AI further threaten our capacity to self-govern and lead flourishing lives? What could a pro-worker AI look like, and how can we achieve it?

author: Fozzie
title: Chapter 26:  The Secret of Primitive Accumulation
content:
Harry Cleaver's study guide to chapter 26 of Capital.

The capitalists gained control of the means of production via "conquest enslavement, robbery, murder, in short, force" (1)

"So-called primitive accumulation, therefore, is nothing else than the historical process of divorcing the producer from the means of production." (2)

Workers are freed in a double sense: 1. neither are they owned (i.e., as slaves) as means of production 2. nor do they own the means of production: change in form of servitude,

Capitalist era dates from the 16th Century.

What makes capitalism a new kind of society has been the creation of two new classes: a capitalist one made up of those who seek to organize most people's lives around the work of producing commodities and another, a class of workers, made up of those whose lives are subordinated to that organization. The secret of this creation—hidden by pro-capitalist political apologists in the telling of history—is that the emerging class of capitalists imposed this social order with brutality and violence, forcibly serparating people from their means of livelihood and destroying their ways of life. Those means included: privately owned tools, formal and informal land tenure and commons, such as pastures, fishing waters, forests and often language and culture to which everyone in a community had acess. Although this forcible separation created a situation where the reality (and threat) of destitution and starvation would largely replace the lash as a coercive instrument of control, violence continued to provide capitalists with a supplementary weapon for keeping people subordinated, right down to the present. This is true whether the violence has been wielded by corporate goons, paramilitary thugs or by government police and military.

Marx both critiques political economy by showing it to be at once apologetic and false and gives an overview of the actual processes through which capitalism emerged as a new kind of social order—an outline of the history he examines more thoroughly in the subsequent chapters.(3)

His analysis temporarily ignores the central subjects of political economy —the interactions of "money and commodities"—to focus on the social social conflicts that shaped the new world in which those things came to figure so centrally. The violence that capitalists required to impose their order reveals the depth of resistance. The agents of this new order, the "knights of industry", exploited every opportunity to achieve power, to subordinate the exploited classes of the old order in a new way and to usurp the power of the feudal lords, the "knights of the sword." Here the nascent capitalist class is portrayed as using "base" means, of "making use of events in which they played no part whatsoever" and of using various "revolutions"as "levers."

Myths about the class structure of capitalism have served to justify its historical origins and on-going class disparities. The central myth, still promulgated today, is a morality tale that portrays capitalists as obtaining their wealth by frugally saving and investing. It suggests that everyone has always been able to become a capitalist by the same means, and those who do not, have no one to blame but themselves.

In 19th Century English literature, this myth was already the object of ridicule far more ascerbic than that of Marx's. For example, in Charles Dickens's (1812–70) 1854 novel Hard Times, which narrates the lives and tragedies of several people in a fictional Manchester-style, manufacturing city called Coketown, we find many passages where various persons are repeating this myth. Examples include the self-praising speeches of Mr. Josiah Bounderby—the novel's central capitalist—constantly bragging (falsely it turns out) about how he raised himself out of the mud to his present august position as mill owner and banker. (4) More concise, however, is a pretty exchange between Bounderby's ex-housekeeper Mrs. Sparsit and Bitzer, his light porter, general spy and informer at the bank, in which the repetition of the myth reveals both a distain for those irrational creatures (the workers) who put human relationships before personal profit and a self-delusion about the origins of wealth. Both, of course, are merely repeating the self-justifying truisms of Bounderby in an almost ritual, and mutually reinforcing, manner. (5) The effect is both comic and appalling.

This, again, was among the fictions of Coketown. Any capitalist there …

author: Extremadura Libre
title: CNT Extremadura presenta alegaciones contra la declaración BIC de la cruz de los caídos de Cáceres y reclama su retirada del espacio público
content:
La Confederación Nacional del Trabajo (CNT) de Extremadura ha presentado alegaciones contra el expediente iniciado por la Junta de Extremadura para declarar Bien de Interés Cultural (BIC), con categoría de Monumento, la denominada “Cruz de los Caídos” situada en la Plaza de América de Cáceres. La organización considera que la declaración no está suficientemente justificada y que la protección patrimonial de este elemento no puede utilizarse para impedir el cumplimiento de la legislación de memoria democrática.


Las alegaciones de CNT cuestionan que el expediente acredite los valores históricos, artísticos o culturales necesarios para otorgar a la cruz la máxima figura de protección patrimonial de Extremadura. La organización señala que existen informes y valoraciones contradictorias entre especialistas y reclama que la Administración analice esas discrepancias con rigor antes de tomar una decisión definitiva.


Para CNT Extremadura, la historia de este monumento no puede separarse del contexto en el que fue levantado. La cruz fue instalada en septiembre de 1937, durante la Guerra Civil, como homenaje a los “caídos de Cáceres”, en un periodo marcado por la violencia política y la represión. La organización sostiene que no puede valorarse únicamente como una construcción arquitectónica, sino teniendo en cuenta su origen, su finalidad conmemorativa y el significado político y simbólico que tuvo durante la dictadura franquista.


CNT rechaza que la modificación posterior de la inscripción del monumento pueda considerarse una verdadera “resignificación” capaz de borrar su origen histórico. A juicio de la organización, cambiar una leyenda no elimina los hechos que explican la construcción de la cruz ni transforma automáticamente el significado que tuvo durante el franquismo.


Uno de los argumentos centrales de las alegaciones es que la Cruz de los Caídos de Cáceres ya ha sido incluida en el Catálogo de Símbolos y Elementos contrarios a la Memoria Democrática, con código CAT-7-2025, mediante resolución de la Secretaría de Estado de Memoria Democrática. Según CNT, esta circunstancia debe ser tenida en cuenta por la Junta de Extremadura antes de continuar con la tramitación del BIC, ya que existe una resolución estatal que establece su retirada del espacio público.


La organización sindical también incide en que la Ley 20/2022 de Memoria Democrática establece la retirada o eliminación de estos elementos, y no su traslado a otro espacio público. CNT considera que no debe confundirse retirar un símbolo contrario a la memoria democrática con conservarlo en otra ubicación.


En este sentido, las alegaciones recuerdan que una declaración como Bien de Interés Cultural no puede convertirse en una vía para evitar una obligación legal. La normativa únicamente contempla excepciones cuando existan razones artísticas o arquitectónicas singulares y protegidas, algo que CNT considera que no ha quedado acreditado en este caso.


La organización recuerda además que el Ayuntamiento de Cáceres ya había abordado en el pasado la cuestión de la retirada de la cruz y que existen antecedentes administrativos sobre su eliminación del espacio público. Para CNT, estos antecedentes muestran que el debate no es nuevo y que la modificación de la inscripción no ha resuelto la naturaleza del monumento ni su significado histórico.


Por todo ello, CNT Extremadura solicita a la Junta de Extremadura que archive el expediente de declaración BIC al considerar que no se han acreditado valores patrimoniales singulares suficientes y que incorpore al procedimiento la resolución estatal que establece la retirada de la cruz. Asimismo, reclama que se valore la aplicación de la Ley de Memoria Democrática y que, finalmente, se proceda a la retirada completa del monumento de la Plaza de América.


Para CNT Extremadura, la defensa del patrimonio histórico debe realizarse desde el rigor y el conocimiento del pasado, no mediante la descontextualización de símbolos vinculados a la dictadura. La memoria democrática, sostiene la organización, exige que los espacios públicos no sean utilizados para mantener elementos asociados a la exaltación del franquismo.


La entrada

CNT Extremadura presenta alegaciones contra la declaración BIC de la cruz de los caídos de Cáceres y reclama su retirada del espacio público

Confederación Nacional del Trabajo

.

author: Unknown
title: Buroya Hiqûqê ya Sedsalê: Nefreta li dijî Ocalan nefreta li dijî gelê Kurd e
content:
Buroya Hiqûqê ya Sedsalê ku parêzeriya Abdullah Ocalan dike, daxuyaniyek nivîskî belav kir û bal kişand ser rewşa Ocalan û neheqî û heqareta ku lê tê kirin.


Daxuyaniya Buroya Hiqûqê ya Sedsalê bi vî rengî ye:


Em niha di serdemeke girîng re derbas dibin ku tê de hewl tên dayîn da ku şert û merc werin afirandin ku pirsgirêka Kurd a ku xwedî paşxaneyeke dîrokî û siyasî ya nêzîkî du sedsalan e, li şûna ku di çarçoveyeke pevçûn û tundûtûjiyê de were sînordarkirin, li ser bingeheke siyasî û yasayî were çareserkirin. Ev demek e, hin derdorên curbecur gotinên manîpulatîf û provokatîf belav dikin ku li dijî birêz Ocalan in. Birêz Ocalan kesayeteke sereke ya pêvajoyê ye û derfeta nû da afirandin. Hemû hewldanên wî li ser wê yekê kom kirine ku vê derfetê veguherîne aştiyeke mayînde û çareseriyeke demokratîk.


Em baş di wê ferqê de ne ku ev zîhniyet a ku hewl dide giraniya dîrokî û siyasî ya pirsgirêka Kurd veşêre û pêvajoya berdewam ji çarçoveya wê ya bingehîn qut bike. Ev helwest dixwaze peşkê li lêgerîna aştî û demokrasiya civakê bixe. Ev bêtehamulî jî naxwaze şer û tundî biqede û dixwaze xwe li ser vê yekê bi rê ve bibe.


Kesên ku herî zêde ji dawîlêanîna şer aciz in, dixwazin pêvajoyê bikin ber rojevên xwe yên magazînî yên erzan. Ev kesên aciziya wan li hemberî pêvajoyê heye, ne ew kes in ku bedela mirovî aborî û civakî dabin. Rastiya ku ew kesên ku bi hemaseta ‘Malên bêsewax’ şovenîzmê gur dikin û di heman demê de naxwazin tawîzê bidin konfortiya xwe. Ew dixwazin ku her tim mirovên ku bedel dane, dîsa bedel bidin. Dixwazin xwe li ser rijandina xwîna mirovan bi rê ve bibin.


Ev çembera ku nijadperestî û gotinên nefretê geş dike, wisa difikire ku civaka Tirkiyê bi çend dirûşman, agahiyên şaş û gotarên provokatîf dikare bi hêsanî were manîpulekirin. Ev tiştê ku ew kesên ku wêrekiyê dikin bîranîn û şiyana ramanên rexneyî ya gel biçûk bibînin û siyaseta xwe li ser texmînên wiha ava dikin ji bo vê civakê vê yekê rewa dibînin.


Li herêmeke wekî Rojhilata Navîn ku tê de birêz Ocalan, bi rêberiya felsefeya ‘Jin, Jiyan, Azadî’, azadiya jinan wekî hêmaneke bingehîn a azadiya civakî dibîne û li gorî vê yekê têkoşînê kiriye, divê mirov hêvî bike ku kesên li ser wî diaxivin, qet nebe divê derbarê wî de xwedî zanîn bin û xwedî wê astê bin ku dikaribin tiştekî bêjin. Lê belê di heman demê de ev jî xuya ye ku em ji zîhnihiyetek wiha ku nijadperestiyê dike û dijminê jinan e jî ne li benda wê astê ne.


Mijarek din a manîpulasyonê jî nîqaşa li ser ‘mal-konuta’ li Îmraliyê ye. Ev mal ji bo pêşvebirina pêvajoyê û xebatên siyasî û hiqûqî li pêş bikevin hewcedariyek sereke ye. Lê belê vê malê ku tê nîqaşkirin ji rastiya wê dûr dixin û veguherandine amûra sorkirinê û dixwazin bi meseleya malê reşkirinê bikin.


Bêguman, înkara gelê Kurd a ku sed sal in tê domandin, têgihiştina li ser Ocalan a ku ji aliyê dewletê ve di 50 salên borî de hatiye avakirin û rejîma Îmraliyê ya ku 27 sal in li cih e, derfet daye van hêzan ku bêperwa tevbigerin. Hêzên siyasî yên ku hewl didin pirsgirêka Kurd di çarçoveya rejîmeke înkar û tundûtûjiyê de çareser bikin, heta îro, di şexsê birêz Ocalan de êrişkirina têkoşîna gelê Kurd a mafdar û belavkirina gotinên nefretê wek rêbaz pejirandine. Ji aliyê hemû çavdêrên bêalî ve tê qebûlkirin ku Birêz Ocalan di nav civaka Kurd ya ku li erdnîgariyeke berfireh belav bûye de xwedî hêza temsîliyeteke xurt e, kesayetekî xwedî pêbawerî û piştgiriya herî mezin e. Ji ber vê yekê, aşkere ye ku armanca sereke ya kampanyaya nêrîna neyînî ya ku li dijî Birêz Ocalan tê meşandin, gelê Kurd e.


Em van înîsiyatîfên ku mafên şexsî yên birêz Ocalan binpê dikin, di şexsê wî de gelê Kurd piçûk dixin, rûmeta wî dikin armanc, û nêrîneke nijadperest û kolonyalîst nîşan didin, red dikin.


Em bi tevahî haydar in ji armancên provokasyona ku ji aliyê wan kesên ku, bêyî ku girêdana wan a siyasî çi be, zimanekî faşîzan, helwestên dijcivakî û zayendperestiya baviksalarî tawanbar kirine, ji bo hedefgirtina Ocalan bi kar tînin.


Û tam ji ber vê sedemê ye ku nîqaşa li ser statuyê girîng û biqîmet e. Ji ber ku derfetên birêz Ocalan ên ji bo xweîfadekirin û parastina helwesta xwe ewqas bi berfirehî hatine paşguhkirin, divê şert û merc werin afirandin da ku ew bikaribe rêya aştiyê nîşan bide. Daxwaza statuyê pêdiviya afirandina wan şertan e ku bi rêya wan her tiştê ku divê gel bizanibe, bikaribe rasterast ji aliyê partiya têkildar ve, ji çavkaniyên yekem û bi awayekî şefaf were pêşkêşkirin. Her wiha statu tê wateya ku divê ev derdorên gendel destên …

author: Fozzie
title: Part VIII: So-called Primitive Accumulation
content:
The first part of Harry Cleaver's Study Guide to Marx's Capital Volume I, which covers the later sections of the book.

We begin with Part VIII of Capital instead of Part I for two reasons. In the first place, Part VIII is a lot easier to read, being less abstract and richer with historical detail. The chapters of Part I, which deal with "value" and money, tend to be very abstract and terse. In the second place, the study of Part VIII, which shows how the capitalist system originated, i.e., how capital originally created the working class and imposed its system on it, provides a very useful point of reference for the careful dissection of value in Part I.

Once we have seen how people were driven off the land and otherwise dispoiled of their means of production and reproduction, how their existing social and cultural relations were destroyed, how they were thus forced to sell their life-time as the commodity labor-power, and found their lives subordinated to work, then it is much easier to understand why Marx elaborated a "labor" theory of value (because the substance of the social relations of capitalism is imposed work) and why he pays so much attention to the "commodity form" (the form of the imposition of work). At each step of his abstract discussion of the substance, measure and form of value, we will find it easier to explore the social and class meaning of their various aspects thanks to our reading of Part VIII. If the imposition of work on most members of society through the commodity form, i.e., through the process of forcing them into the labor market, is the defining case of exchange in society, then we can see how every aspect of exchange, including the role of money, is an aspect of that central class relationship. To remember this after stating it as an abstraction is difficult. To remember it after having explored the historical period of the inception of the commodity form is much easier.

When we examine the structure of Part VIII we see that the material is organized in such a manner as to highlight the creation of the classes as the central issue in primitive accumulation:

Chap. 26: The Secret of Primitive Accumulation

Creation of the Working Class, two chapters:

Chap. 27: The Expropriation of the Agricultural Population Chap. 28: Bloody Legislation Against the Expropriated

Creation of the Capitalist Class, three chapters:

Chap. 29: Genesis of the Capitalist Farmer Chap. 30: Creation of a Home Market for Industry Chap. 31: Genesis of the Industrial Capitalist

Conclusion of Book, one chapter:

Chap. 32: Historical Tendency of Capitalist Accumulation Nota Bene: Chapter 32 is the logical end of the book, as it evokes the overthrow of capital and the quotation of the Communist Manifesto for revolution.

"Appendix" to Chapter 31, one chapter

Chap. 33: Modern Theory of Colonialism Nota Bene: Chapter 33 logically goes after Chapter 28 or 31 in so far as it discusses the creation of the working class in the colonies and through immigration. Chapters 33 and 31 both deal with the international aspects of the emergence of capitalism.

In what follows, the commentaries on the chapters will not only highlight those aspects of primitive accumulation emphasized by Marx but will also draw attention to what I feel are two important aspects of primative accumulation that are not dealt with adequately in his treatment: 1) the social and cultural destruction caused by the spreading imposition of capitalist social relations, and 2) the fierce resistance to that imposition by those who did not want to be reduced to the status of "mere worker" in a class of workers. Marx used the expression "mere worker" in the Grundrisse (the manuscripts of 1857) when discussing the possibilities of moving beyond capitalism to a situation where people can become multidimensional. His negative view of the one-dimensionality of a life of imposed work, however, permeates all of his writing.

author: Adaobi Rosemary Ogueli
title: Agaekwe Bound To A Price
content:
Chapter One


With both knees bent near the bathroom door, Agaekwe held a wooden brush in her right hand. Its bristles, scattered and weak, bore witness to years of service. She sprinkled more soapy water across the remains of the old, cemented floor and squatted once more to scrub the bathroom floor, 

shi shi shi

. She moved the brush in circular patterns as she scrubbed, stepping backward carefully with each stroke to avoid treading on the freshly cleaned surface. As the only girl in a family of five children, the burden of the Saturday clean-up fell largely on her, regardless of her brothers’ ages.


The street hummed with the noise of children queuing up at Mama Chidera’s shop for akara and akamu. In most African homes, this was the traditional Saturday meal: beans ground with a mortar and pestle until smooth, seasoned with onion, pepper, and crayfish, then molded by hand and dropped into hot oil until golden brown. Though akara was often seen as a staple for the poor due to its affordability, Mama Chidera’s was exceptional, stuffed with boiled eggs that only the middle class could truly afford.


No one detested akara; it might have seemed like food for the poor because it was very affordable, yet the rich equally queued for this particular akara ball. Mama Chidera added boiled eggs to hers, which made it exceptional, and only the middle class could afford to buy the akara with boiled egg, while those who could not bought the normal akara, which tasted just as great. Agaekwe stretched her aching back. “I am almost done,” she murmured to herself. Only the toilet was left, then the market.


She lived in a duplex in the heart of Edorji Ojoto village, a home typical of a wealthy Igbo man. Though she had grown up surrounded by the half-baked love of her family, she still struggled to be truly recognized as the only daughter of the Pidou’s household. Her name, Agaekwe, was a hereditary one signifying a reincarnated soul. She was named after her great-grandfather’s mother to signify a woman of greatness. Yet the name had not shielded her from the emotional wounds inflicted by her family, leading her to wonder if her birth had somehow taken a life.


As she rinsed her cleaning buckets, she held both buckets upside down while the lids clattered and water slipped off. She hung the mop on a wire line stretched across the vegetable garden, where scarecrows stood guard against the birds. Suddenly, a message beeped from her work clothes pocket. With wet, trembling hands, she fumbled with her phone, failing the password three times before finally accessing her email. It was from the University of Science and Technology China, an update on the scholarship she had applied for months ago and nearly forgotten during her youth service year. She read through the content; surprisingly, it was an acceptance letter to study in China on scholarship. A rush of excitement hit her, followed immediately by an indescribable, heavy silence as she was buried in thought. “Will Father recognize this?” she wondered. She pushed open the kitchen door, its broken knob requiring the weight of her hip to yield, and entered the room. One could also view the interior of the kitchen through the hole in the broken doorknob.


Agaekwe struggled slightly to pull the kitchen mortar from beneath the sink. Weighing roughly 15kg and carved from heavy wood, the vessel had sat gathering dust for years. It had been a long time since her father decided to stop eating cassava for dinner, and without his demand for it, the rhythmic sound of pounding had ceased in their home. In an African home, particularly one where the parents are traditionally married, the mortar is more than a tool; it is a cultural cornerstone. It serves as a traditional parting gift from a mother to her daughter on her wedding day. It is essential for the daily preparation of myriad ingredients beyond just cassava and yam. This specific mortar carried the weight of generations, having been passed from Agaekwe’s grandmother to her mother.


After scrubbing the cracked, cemented kitchen floor until it sparkled, meticulously piercing the bristles of her soapy brush into every crevice, Agaekwe felt a brief surge of pride in her hygiene. The truth I learned at a great cost reveals that being the same person does not mean you have solidarity. It is not safety. It is not kinship. It is not protection.

Before I lost everything I thought that being Black, trans, queer or poor with political awareness formed a sacred bond with others. Some secret vow. Some unspoken agreement which stated: I have your back, you have mine. Throughout my life I brought this notion to meetings that consumed me before delivering cheerful smiles to everyone.

They said “we got you,” but what they meant was: as long as you’re not too loud, not too angry, not too messy, not too critical of our favorite personalities, not too visibly poor, not too femme, not too different.

People who resemble us but betray us create deeper emotional wounds. It has layers. The experience suddenly interrupts moments of happiness to reveal that being close to someone does not guarantee safety. It stings because it shouldn’t happen, and yet it does. Over and over again.

The most destructive actions against me have originated from people who identify as radical.

The most devastating experiences of elimination emerged from people who shared my pronouns and maintained organizational abilities.

The truth about shared values is that they do not correlate with shared identity.

title: So students and teachers are both making mostly rational decisions based on the intense time…
content:
A couple of years ago we were all terribly concerned about the fact that a lot of American high schools are assigning such crushing homework loads that some kids literally don’t have enough time to eat or sleep (and all this in spite of the fact that there’s no good evidence that assigning homework actually improves academic outcomes at the pre-university level), but now we’re hearing stories about those same schools struggling to stop kids from using ChatGPT to write their essays and suddenly It’s The Children Who Are Wrong. Like, do you think maybe there’s a certain level of cause and effect in play here?

i keep trying to explain to people that teenagers are making mostly rational decisions based on the information they have, and no one seems to believe me

you probably won’t be surprised at the pushback I’ve gotten from teachers at the college level (who by and large don’t have to worry about NCLB guidelines and tests) at suggesting that if critical thinking is the problem being lost, maybe we should change our testing and assessment styles to directly measure critical thinking on the fly rather than throwing up our hands and blaming TECHNOLOGY

the trick is that these assessment styles often require more work to think about and construct assessments for and that is work that college instructors are typically compensated very poorly if at all for, so like, I get it. but that’s how you fix this shit. and I think if you are invested in the project of education for its own sake, you have to consider the ways in which incentivizing your students not to rely on chatgpt involves changing the structure of your shared activities together such that failing to learn and digest material is routinely boring or unpleasant and that knowing it is the only way to feel that one is succeeding in class in small, low-stakes, frequent interactions rather than single high-stakes ones.

So students and teachers are both making mostly rational decisions based on the intense time pressure they are under, and neither the learning style nor the assessment style is likely to change on a society wide scale unless the system changes to allow teachers and students to do less work in more time.

Εκδηλώσεις – συζητήσεις τη  Δευτέρα 21/9:


“Ανοιχτή εκδήλωση – συζήτηση για τον ιδιωτικό κερδοσκοπισμό στην Υγεία

“, Αριστερή Κίνηση Περιστερίου, στις 19.00, Ακροπόλεως 18 και Ιάσονος


“Η κοινωνική οικολογία στην πράξη”, 19.30, εντευκτήριο της Ευτοπίας, Ναυαρίνου 17, Εξάρχεια


“Mira Cuba”, 20.00, στην Εργατική Λέσχη Νέας Σμύρνης


“Ανοιχτή εκδήλωση – συζήτηση για τον ιδιωτικό κερδοσκοπισμό στην Υγεία

“:


 Η υπόθεση του θανάτου του Γιώργου Μαζωνάκη άνοιξε μια πολύ μεγαλύτερη συζήτηση από την ευθύνη δύο συγκεκριμένων γιατρών.


 Πώς μπορεί να λειτουργούν και να διαφημίζονται «θεραπείες» αμφίβολης επιστημονικής τεκμηρίωσης και ποιος έχει τελικά την ευθύνη να ελέγχει τι συμβαίνει στον ιδιωτικό τομέα της Υγείας;


 Πώς φτάσαμε σε μια τόσο μεγάλη εξάπλωση της εμπορευματοποίησης της Υγείας και τι συνέπειες έχει η συνεχής υποβάθμιση του δημόσιου συστήματος;


 Ποιος ελέγχει στην πράξη τα ιδιωτικά ιατρεία, τις κλινικές και τα κέντρα που προσφέρουν «εναλλακτικές», «αναγεννητικές», «αντιγηραντικές» και άλλες αμφιλεγόμενες θεραπείες;


 Γιατί μπορούν να διαφημίζονται τόσο εύκολα ιατρικές υπηρεσίες και θεραπείες με αμφίβολη ή ανεπαρκή επιστημονική τεκμηρίωση;


 Ποια είναι η ευθύνη της κυβέρνησης και του Υπουργείου Υγείας για το θεσμικό πλαίσιο, την εποπτεία και τους κρατικούς ελέγχους στον ιδιωτικό τομέα της Υγείας;


 Ποιος είναι ο ρόλος του Πανελλήνιου Ιατρικού Συλλόγου και των Ιατρικών Συλλόγων και τι θα έπρεπε να κάνουν απέναντι στην ψευδοεπιστήμη, την παραϊατρική και την εμπορευματοποίηση της ιατρικής;


 Πώς συνδέεται η ανάπτυξη του λεγόμενου «ιατρικού τουρισμού» και των ιδιαίτερα κερδοφόρων ιδιωτικών υπηρεσιών με το μοντέλο Υγείας που προωθείται τα τελευταία χρόνια;


 Και τελικά: μπορεί η Υγεία να αντιμετωπίζεται ως εμπόρευμα ή χρειαζόμαστε ένα ισχυρό, αποκλειστικά δημόσιο και δωρεάν σύστημα Υγείας με ουσιαστικούς ελέγχους και πρόσβαση όλων στη σύγχρονη επιστημονική ιατρική;


 Αυτά και πολλά ακόμη θα συζητήσουμε στην ανοιχτή εκδήλωση της Αριστερής Κίνησης Περιστερίου, τη Δευτέρα 21 Σεπτέμβρη στις 19:00, Ακροπόλεως 18 & Ιάσονος, με κεντρικό ομιλητή τον νευροχειρουργό και Γενικό Γραμματέα της ΟΕΝΓΕ Πάνο Παπανικολάου.

Δευτέρα 21/9 στις 8.00μμ
